title: Solution Architect (Digital Banking)
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Hybrid working; Flexible time; Macbook Pro
L&D programs; 17 days off 
13.7 million B2C users; 140,000+ business customer
The Job
About the position
As a new initiative, Money Forward has begun considering the provision of BaaS/digital banking in collaboration with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation.
We are seeking an experienced
Technical Solutions Architect
with deep expertise in modern enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and core banking domains. In this role, you will lead the architectural vision, strategy, and hands-on execution for high-throughput, highly resilient banking and financial platforms. You will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, translating complex financial requirements into scalable microservices architectures powered by Java and AWS.
Responsibilities
Architectural Leadership & Strategy
Design, architect, and guide the implementation of end-to-end cloud-native microservices solutions tailored for enterprise banking systems (e.g., core banking, payments, loan processing, or fraud detection etc.).
Establish architectural principles, blue-prints, and coding standards for distributed systems, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, low latency, and audit readiness.
Lead technology selection, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and architectural review for the solution designs in the team.
Technical Execution & Hands-On Guidance
Architect modular microservices using
Java
and the
Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security)
.
Design and implement robust API management strategies (RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL) and event-driven architectures (using Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, or RabbitMQ) for real-time transaction processing.
Optimize database architectures using a polyglot approach (relational like PostgreSQL/Aurora alongside NoSQL like DynamoDB/MongoDB) with strict data consistency and ACID transaction management across microservices (Saga pattern, CQRS).
Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS)
Architect enterprise-grade, secure infrastructure on
AWS
utilizing technologies such OAuth2, Nimbus JOSE+JWT, WebAuthn, Authlete and Lattice SigV4 auth starter .
Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, ensuring automated, repeatable environments across multi-region deployments.
Enforce cloud security best practices aligned with banking regulatory standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, Open Banking APIs).
Collaboration & Domain Expertise
Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, domain experts, and security leads to align technical strategies with business objectives.
Mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and developers, conducting architecture reviews and fostering a culture of technical excellence.
Your Skills and Experience
Requirements / Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 10+ years of software development experience and 4+ years acting as a Technical/Solutions Architect.
Core Java Expertise:
Expert-level mastery of Java, core concurrency models, memory management, garbage collection tuning, and JVM internals.
Spring Ecosystem Mastery:
Deep hands-on knowledge of Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Batch, and Spring Integration.
Microservices Architecture:
Proven track record in designing large-scale distributed systems, incorporating microservices patterns (Circuit Breaker, API Gateway, Service Mesh, Event Sourcing, Distributed Tracing, Saga Pattern).
AWS Cloud Expertise:
Hands-on experience designing and deploying mission-critical systems on AWS. Active certification such as
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
is strongly preferred.
Banking & Financial Domain:
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building systems within core banking, retail/corporate banking, payment gateways (ISO 20022, SWIFT, ACH), ledger systems, or trading platforms.
Data Management:
Proficiency with RDBMS (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases, alongside caching mechanisms (Redis, Hazelcast) and messaging brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Security & Compliance:
Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, TLS/mTLS, data encryption at rest/in transit, and banking regulatory compliance standards.
AI:

Design and implement logging, audit trails, distributed tracing, monitoring, and alerting capabilities for production services.
Optimize backend performance, latency, throughput, scalability, and service reliability for high-volume production environments.
Design and manage appropriate data models, database schemas, caching strategies, message brokers, persistence layers, and transaction management.
Participate in production incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), post-incident reviews, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Apply security best practices including authentication, authorization, access control, audit logging, and data protection throughout service development.
Support the integration of AI/ML inference results into backend services while collaborating with AI teams on production deployment.
Work closely with Product, Frontend, Data, AI/DS, and Platform Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

At least 4 years of experience developing backend or platform software for production environments.
Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, or equivalent.
Hands-on experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, backend integration services, and asynchronous processing systems.
Experience working with message brokers or streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent technologies.
Strong knowledge of relational databases and experience with at least one NoSQL database or distributed caching technology.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, API integration, concurrency, and production system design.
Experience using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, logging, monitoring, and automated deployment practices.
Strong troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimization, and production incident resolution skills.

You know how to find the gaps. Now take ownership of closing them.
Our client is a fast-growing international technology company building and operating large-scale digital platforms across multiple markets. As the business expands, so does the complexity of protecting its systems, infrastructure, users and transactions.
They are looking for a hands-on Cybersecurity Manager to build and lead the security function from the ground up. You will have direct access to management, ownership of the security roadmap, and the authority to decide where the business needs to strengthen its defenses.
This is not an audit or policy-only position. You need to know how to test, find weaknesses, manage incidents and make sure security issues actually get fixed.

You own security end to end: testing, risk assessment, external security partners, incident response and team development. You will work closely with engineering and management, covering everything from application and infrastructure security to cloud environments and platform integrity.

Establish and lead the security function, building the team as the business grows.
Lead security assessments across web applications, APIs, infrastructure and cloud environments.
Maintain a clear inventory of company assets and a risk register to identify and track potential exposure.
Manage external security specialists and assessment partners, ensuring identified issues are properly addressed and closed.
Identify weaknesses in platform workflows, user accounts and transaction processes, including potential misuse and unauthorized activities.
Conduct simulated social engineering exercises and improve security awareness across the organisation.
Establish vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response processes.
Work closely with engineering teams to review new features, strengthen application security and integrate security practices into development.
Take charge of security incidents, coordinating containment, investigation and communication with management.
Present security risks and progress to leadership in clear, business-focused terms.

8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with strong hands-on experience in security testing or security engineering. Pure audit, compliance or policy backgrounds will not be suitable.
Strong knowledge of web application and API security, infrastructure testing, network security and cloud environments (AWS).
Ability to identify complex application weaknesses and business workflow vulnerabilities, beyond relying on automated testing tools.
Experience leading security incidents, including containment, investigation and communication with senior management.
Previous experience directly managing and developing a technical team.
Experience working with external security consultants and managing specialist assessment engagements.
Ability to work closely with engineering teams and translate technical findings into practical solutions.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail and ability to work independently.
Good English communication skills.

description:

 Life Insurance & Cancer Insurance
The Job
1. MỤC ĐÍCH CÔNG VIỆC
Thiết kế, xây dựng, vận hành và liên tục cải tiến nền tảng Kubernetes/container cùng các dịch vụ kỹ thuật dùng chung (CI/CD, GitOps, IaC/Automation) phục vụ hệ thống core bảo hiểm, ứng dụng nội bộ và các nền tảng của MB Life.
Giữ vai trò dẫn dắt kỹ thuật (acting technical lead) của mảng Platform: định hướng chuẩn kỹ thuật, phân công – review công việc và kèm cặp kỹ sư Platform cấp Junior/Mid.
Nâng cao độ tin cậy, bảo mật và khả năng kiểm soát thay đổi của nền tảng; giảm tác vụ thủ công lặp lại (toil), bảo đảm khả năng truy vết và tuân thủ quy định của MB Life.
2.  NHIỆM VỤ VÀ TRÁCH NHIỆM
Trách nhiệm chuyên môn:
A. Kubernetes & Cloud Platform (trọng tâm)
Thiết kế, triển khai, quản trị vòng đời và vận hành các cụm Kubernetes production/non-production: cấu hình, nâng cấp, mở rộng node, bảo trì và phương án rollback.
Phân tích, xử lý sự cố Kubernetes
Chuẩn hóa Helm chart, manifests, registry, resource request/limit, autoscaling và các thành phần platform dùng chung; theo dõi khả năng mở rộng, hiệu năng và capacity.
B. CI/CD, GitOps & Release Safety
Xây dựng, vận hành và cải tiến năng lực CI/CD dùng chung (GitLab CI/Jenkins hoặc tương đương), runners/agents và bộ pipeline template có thể tái sử dụng.
Triển khai GitOps (Argo CD/Flux hoặc tương đương), quản lý cấu hình khai báo theo Git, kiểm soát drift, review, approval, traceability và rollback.
Phối hợp cùng Development/DevOps và ANTT tích hợp kiểm thử, kiểm tra dependency, SAST/SCA, image scan, quản lý artifacts/secrets trong quy trình phát hành; hỗ trợ chiến lược rollout/canary/blue-green khi phù hợp.
Chuẩn hóa quy trình triển khai lên nền tảng; trách nhiệm về mã nguồn, nghiệp vụ và chất lượng ứng dụng thuộc đội phát triển/ứng dụng theo phân công.
C. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Thiết kế, phát triển và duy trì module/playbook/script bằng Terraform, Ansible, Python, Bash hoặc công cụ tương đương để cấp phát, cấu hình và vận hành platform một cách có thể lặp lại.
Quản lý mã IaC/Automation bằng Git; áp dụng code review, lint/test, quản lý state và secrets an toàn, kiểm soát thay đổi và lưu dấu vết thực thi.
Nhận diện toil, ưu tiên tự động hóa các yêu cầu lặp lại; xây dựng công cụ hoặc workflow có tài liệu, có kiểm tra lỗi và có khả năng tái sử dụng cho nhiều nhóm.
D. Reliability, Observability & Incident Management
Xây dựng, tích hợp giám sát metrics, logs và traces khi phù hợp cho Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps và các dịch vụ platform; phát triển dashboard, cảnh báo có thể hành động và giảm alert noise.
Đề xuất SLI/SLO phù hợp từng dịch vụ nền tảng sau khi thống nhất đối tượng sử dụng, nguồn đo và trách nhiệm vận hành; theo dõi xu hướng capacity, availability và hiệu năng.
Tham gia on-call theo lịch; chủ trì xử lý incident trong phạm vi platform, thực hiện RCA/blameless postmortem, cập nhật runbook và theo dõi hành động phòng ngừa.
Phối hợp đội Infrastructure/Backup và Application để kiểm chứng yêu cầu HA, backup/restore, DR, RTO/RPO liên quan tới workloads và dịch vụ nền tảng.
E. Security, Compliance & Cross-team Delivery
Phối hợp ANTT áp dụng hardening, least privilege, quản lý secrets, image security, runtime guardrails, audit logging và cung cấp log/sự kiện cho SIEM theo chính sách.
Thực hiện thay đổi có đánh giá rủi ro, kiểm thử, phương án rollback và bằng chứng; tuân thủ quy trình phê duyệt hiện hành, đồng thời đề xuất chuẩn hóa/automation cho standard changes đủ điều kiện.
Phối hợp với Infrastructure/Network/Storage/Backup, DevOps/Development, Application, ANTT và Vendor; làm rõ ownership, dependencies và escalation khi triển khai hoặc xử lý sự cố.
Tư vấn yêu cầu phi chức năng và production readiness cho dịch vụ sử dụng platform; viết tài liệu kiến trúc, SOP/runbook và tham gia PoC khi được giao.
F. Technical Leadership | Dẫn dắt kỹ thuật
Xây dựng và duy trì chuẩn kỹ thuật của mảng Platform (cấu hình cluster, Helm chart, pipeline template, quy ước IaC, runbook); review thay đổi/merge request của kỹ sư khác trước khi áp dụng lên Production.
Lập kế hoạch kỹ thuật, chia nhỏ hạng mục và phân công công việc cho kỹ sư Platform Junior/Mid; theo dõi tiến độ, chất lượng và báo cáo Trưởng phòng.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Report to CTO
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Be part of an AI-first transformation
A culture that shows up outside of work too
Room to grow as we grow
The Job
WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM!
We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to be the senior technical authority for AI across the organization. This is not a people-management role – it’s a consulting and architecture role with organization-wide reach: you design AI solutions, set the standards other engineers build to, drive evaluation discipline, and shape how AI enters our products from the design phase onward. You report directly to the CTO and multiply the impact of every squad working with AI.
What You’ll Do
Advise and design AI solutions across the full spectrum – from single LLM calls to complex multi-agent infrastructure – recommending implementation approaches that account for fallbacks, cost/latency budgets, and rate-limit constraints (throttling, TPM/RPM).
Architect agentic systems with the right structure for the problem: MCP server design, deterministic workflows, single agents with tool access, orchestrator–worker or A2A multi-agent topologies.
Own the evaluation practice that drives technical decisions: eval sets, scoring rubrics, and regression measurement for non-deterministic outputs – and use that evidence to settle when to prompt, when to RAG, when to fine-tune, and when to build an agent, so architecture choices are backed by measurement rather than intuition.
Partner with Product from the design phase: consult on where AI genuinely adds value in a feature, what’s feasible at what cost, and what the failure modes will look like – so AI capability shapes the product spec instead of being retrofitted after.
Forecast the direction of AI in the next 2-3 years, and start to take actions today so Perform.AI remains technologically relevant in that future.
Raise the technical level of engineers across squads: review their designs and code before implementation, define shared standards they follow (prompt conventions, eval-driven development), design and deliver internal AI training programs, and make architecture decisions the whole team builds on.
Your Skills and Experience
WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG!
Core Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and operating LLM-based systems in production.
Hands-on experience designing and running LLM-based systems in production – beyond API calls: handling fallbacks, cost/latency trade-offs, rate limits (TPM/RPM), and structured output reliability at scale.
Experience building multi-step agentic systems and choosing the right topology for the problem – using frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, Claude Agents SDK), with working knowledge of MCP, context/state management, and agent failure modes.
Demonstrated evaluation discipline for non-deterministic systems: building eval sets, defining scoring rubrics (including LLM-as-judge approaches), measuring regression – using tools like LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalents – and using eval evidence to drive architecture decisions (prompt vs. RAG vs. fine-tune vs. agent).
Strong backend fundamentals with the depth to drive the tech stack, not just work within it: expert-level Python, distributed systems, high-volume data pipelines, and the judgment to select and standardize frameworks, libraries, and infrastructure for AI workloads across the team.
Nice to Have
Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or other high-volume data domains.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference talks.
Experience fine-tuning models (managed fine-tuning APIs or open-weight approaches like LoRA/PEFT) and judging when fine-tuning beats prompting or RAG on cost and quality.
Experience across the LLM deployment spectrum: working with managed cloud LLM services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent) – quotas, regional availability, model version management – familiarity with deploying open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Qwen from Hugging Face) on your own infrastructure with an understanding of the cost/control trade-offs between the two.
Why You'll Love Working Here
WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE IN RETURN!
We at
Perform.AI
are dedicated to being a platform for growth for all our team members, regardless of function and location.
The opportunity to work in a fast-growing, super exciting, and innovative business building the AI Commerce Operating System for global e-commerce brands. You will be the needle of success in the growth of a global product that will become a key platform behind successful e-commerce brands worldwide.
Fully sponsored Claude Code usage – As part of our commitment to staying at the bleeding edge of AI-driven engineering, we provide sponsored access to Claude Code, enabling you to build faster, smarter, and more efficiently with state-of-the-art AI support.
Submerge in the bleeding-edge of Agentic Development – We don’t simply supplement an existing process with AI tools, we rework every aspect of the software development life cycle, from requirement gathering, implementation, to testing. We believe the productivity multiplication of AI doesn’t just come from individual applications but also from an entire system that embraces it into every fabric.
An environment where everybody never stops growing and focuses on succeeding – we continuously work with you on your strengths and weaknesses across many important dimensions and look at ways for you to address them and further your development.
Join a passionate, global team at Perform.AI where you can continuously develop your skills and actively drive our mission and international success.
OUR BENEFITS!
Perform.AI
is committed to providing a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that supports the wellbeing, growth, and performance of our employees.
Competitive compensation package
13th month salary and ESOP
Health insurance and annual health check-up
Hybrid working, flexible hours, and unlimited leave
Learning support fund for professional development
Access to AI tools and innovation initiatives
Company-provided laptop & monitor
Complimentary lunch and daily snacks
Employee care programs and engagement activities

description:

The Job
1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Position: Senior Fullstack Engineer (PHP, NextJS)
Department: Tech Development
Report to: CTO
Headcount: 2
Level: Senior
2. JOB PURPOSE
PropNex is one of Singapore's largest real estate agencies. We are building its new public property portal, where home buyers, sellers and tenants search for homes to buy or rent with rich filters or on an interactive map. They can see listing and project details, past transactions and price trends, browse new launches and auctions, find and compare agents, get an instant home valuation and track their enquiries. As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will own features end to end, from the PHP API and MySQL database to the Next.js frontend, and help shape how the platform grows.
3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Design, build and maintain the REST APIs in PHP 8 (Slim) that power every part of the portal.
Model data in MySQL and write efficient, hand-tuned SQL for search with many filters, sorting and pagination.
Build map-based search that stays fast as users pan and zoom across the island.
Integrate with PropNex's internal systems and third-party services, and build scheduled jobs that keep listings, projects and agent data up to date.
Build secure account features (sign-up, sign-in, profiles, saved listings, search history), protect public endpoints from abuse and keep user data safe.
Build pages and features in Next.js (App Router), React and TypeScript, turning designs into responsive, accessible UI with Tailwind CSS and a shared component library.
Own SEO and page speed: server rendering, metadata, canonical URLs, sitemaps and Core Web Vitals.
Find and fix performance problems across the stack: slow queries, heavy responses, memory use and caching.
Take features from requirement to release: API contract, database, UI, CI/CD deployment to staging and production, and production monitoring.
Lead technical design for new features, write automated tests, and mentor other engineers through code reviews and pairing.
Work with product, design and the business team in Singapore, and keep technical docs and API specs up to date.
Your Skills and Experience
4. REQUIREMENTS
4.1. Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4.2. Experience
5–8 years building and shipping web applications on both the backend and the frontend, including at least 2 years of production work with Next.js. Experience in proptech or real estate is a plus.
4.3. Technical Skills
a) Software Development
Backend:
PHP 8 and OOP; a micro-framework (Slim, Lumen, Symfony components or similar); REST API design; OAuth2/JWT
Frontend:
React, TypeScript, Next.js (App Router, SSR/SSG), HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
Database:
MySQL schema design, indexes, query optimisation and transactions; hand-written SQL rather than an ORM; Redis caching
DevOps:
Docker, Linux, CI/CD
Tools:
Git, browser dev tools, the command line
b) Backend Engineering
You build APIs that stay fast and reliable as data and traffic grow.
Write efficient SQL for complex search, filtering and pagination
Integrate third-party APIs, handling timeouts, retries and errors
Build scheduled jobs that keep data in sync
Profile and fix slow queries, heavy responses and memory problems
Secure user accounts and public endpoints
c) Frontend Engineering
You turn designs into fast, accessible pages that rank well in search.
Build responsive, accessible UI from designs
Handle server data and complex forms (TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod)
Design proper loading, empty and error states
Implement technical SEO: server rendering, metadata, sitemaps
Improve page speed and Core Web Vitals
Work with component libraries such as shadcn/ui
d) Nice to Have
These will help you hit the ground running.
Map-based or geospatial search; the Google Maps JavaScript API
Firebase
AWS, Nginx, GitHub Actions
Automated testing (PHPUnit, Jest, Playwright)
Using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code) in daily work
Proptech experience or knowledge of Singapore property (HDB, condo, landed, new launches)
4.4. Soft Skills
Takes ownership of a problem and follows it through to production
Writes clear code and clear messages
Asks questions early and suggests better ways of doing things
Mentors others and gives constructive code reviews
Works well independently with a team in another country
Good written English for specs, pull requests and day-to-day chat
Why You'll Love Working Here

100% salary during probationary period
Annual salary review and performance-based bonus
Paid social insurance
in accordance with Vietnam regulations

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Competitive salary, healthy and sporty environment
Hybrid/remote professional working environment
Opportunity traveling to US for training
The Job
About the Role
We are looking for a data scientist who combines strong statistical and machine learning foundations with curiosity, independent judgment, and practical business sense.
You will work with messy, real-world data to solve problems in forecasting, optimization, customer intelligence, and operations across our e-commerce and agriculture technology businesses. Working with business and engineering teams, you will take problems from the initial question through investigation, experimentation, and delivery.
You thrive in a small, hands-on team where priorities evolve and problems are not always fully defined.
You take initiative, use AI tools and agents effectively, and own work through to a useful result.
What You Will Do
Modeling Forecasting and Optimization
Independently develop modeling and optimization approaches suited to the business problem, available data, objectives, and practical constraints.
Compare alternative methods against meaningful baselines, using evaluations that reflect how the results will be used.
Investigate model failures and unexpected results, then propose and test improvements.
Work with engineering teammates to bring useful models into production and translate results into decisions.
Data Science and Analytics
Explore complex datasets, identify patterns and anomalies, and formulate hypotheses worth testing.
Validate sources, metric definitions, and assumptions; investigate inconsistencies that could affect the answer.
Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests, using appropriate statistical methods.
Test competing explanations, distinguish correlation from causation, and produce reproducible analyses with clear limitations.
AI and Applied Generative AI
Use AI tools and agents to increase productivity, automate routine work, and accelerate research, analysis, coding, evaluation, and reporting through reusable workflows.
Use AI to explore approaches and challenge assumptions, retaining responsibility for the reasoning and correctness of the result.
Evaluate new tools, models, agents, and reusable skills on representative tasks, balancing quality, reliability, speed, and cost.
Build and evaluate AI-powered tools for information retrieval, classification, extraction, and decision support.
Product and Business Collaboration
Turn broad business requests into analytical questions, objectives, and success measures,
questioning assumptions and identifying missing context.
Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences, connecting the evidence, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommended action.
Prioritize by expected business value, balancing rigor with speed and available resources.
Incorporate stakeholder knowledge and material feedback, resolving open questions or agreeing how they will be handled.
Data Architecture Engineering and Model Operations
Your work will sometimes extend into data engineering, with an emphasis on architecture, reusable systems, and automated operations.
Design reusable datasets, features, feature-store structures, and pipelines with clear definitions and traceable sources.
Take selected components from design through implementation, working with engineering teammates where appropriate.
Build in quality checks, automated evaluation, and monitoring to detect data failures, model drift, and performance degradation and inform retraining or revision.
Make practical architecture decisions that balance reliability, flexibility, cost, and maintenance; document systems so teammates can support them.
Example Projects
Depending on business priorities, you may work on:
Forecasting and planning: improve demand forecasts and help buyers understand changes, uncertainty, and inventory implications.
Optimization: recommend replenishment quantities, inventory allocations, or resource plans within business constraints.
Customer intelligence: develop segmentation, recommendation, or retention models for e-commerce and SaaS businesses.
Agriculture technology: build yield, harvest, or operational planning tools.
AI-powered decision support: combine business data, information retrieval, and agent workflows to help users investigate questions and act.
Your Skills and Experience
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated ability to independently lead substantive data science work, from an ambiguous business question through investigation, evaluation, and delivery. We assess seniority through analytical judgment, ownership, and results rather than a fixed number of years.
Strong foundations in statistics, probability, experimental design, and machine learning, with practical experience in forecasting or optimization.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including experience with common data analysis and machine learning libraries.
Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data platforms.
Demonstrated use of AI tools and agents in substantive analytical or development work, including validating their outputs and explaining the reasoning.
Natural curiosity and self-directed learning. You actively explore new methods, tools, and AI capabilities, test their practical value, and apply what proves useful. You investigate unfamiliar problems and unexpected results without waiting to be directed.
Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Why Join Us?
AI Playground: Work in an environment where your AI knowledge isn’t just welcomed—it’s celebrated. Test and deploy AI solutions that make a real impact.
Growth Opportunities: Mentorship from senior IT pros, access to online training (e.g., Udemy), and a clear path to roles like Systems Admin or AI Specialist.
Young & Dynamic Team: Collaborate with peers who share your passion for tech and innovation.
Perks: Competitive salary, health benefits and specific company perks, e.g., “free coffee,” “free buffet lunch”, “yoga” , “football” ..etc...

title: Product Engineer (Fresher & Junior)
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Own critical product surfaces end‑to‑end
Build real revenue engines with AI and data
Hybrid, async work that respects working style
The Job
About Flexspace AI
Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
What we ship
: mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
Who buys it
: coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
How we work
: small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
What engineering means here.
The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
On prioritization.
Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
On decisions.
Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
On growth.
You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
Ship features end-to-end.
Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents.
Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
Make booking effortless.
Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
Wire up integrations.
Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
Pull data, form an opinion, decide.
Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
Write so the team stays in sync.
Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
Drive and motivation.
We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
Attention to detail and high standards.
You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
Clear written English.
You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
High agency.
You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
You question everything.
Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
Curiosity and fast learning.
You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
Product sense.
You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.
Your Skills and Experience
Must-have
Vietnamese, based in Ho Chi Minh City
. Hired on a Vietnamese employment contract. No visa sponsorship or relocation funding.
Solid CS fundamentals.
You understand how data is structured, how APIs work, and how to troubleshoot methodically—and you can name what you're doing and why.
Comfortable with the basics that make a good teammate.
Git, reading existing code, writing tests, and jumping into unfamiliar parts of a codebase.
Some Ruby, TypeScript, or Python.
You'll spend most of your time in Ruby and TypeScript. We don't expect all three—we expect you to learn fast.
A project we can look at.
At least one thing you built that works—side project, open source, internship, hackathon, or coursework—with a link and a clear story of how and why you built it.
AI-native.
You use Claude and Cursor daily and know where they shine and where they break down.

title: Senior IT Operations Engineer
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Solve AI-era quality problems for global customers
Total rewards that stand out in market
Open and flexible environment with real ownership
The Job
Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently.
Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.
About the role
Katalon's IT & Digital Transformation team runs the internal technology for our people across Vietnam, the US and remote locations. We are a small team that works agent-first: we run IT through APIs, scripts and AI agents, not through click-ops and ticket queues.
We are looking for an engineer to
own IT Operations in our HCMC office
— the service desk, identity and devices, onboarding and offboarding, and the office network and server room. You will be the go-to owner for this domain, run projects on your own, and use automation and AI to keep a large scope manageable.
We hire for growth.
You likely started on the service desk and have already begun to own sysadmin work: a firewall rule, the office WiFi, a VPN, a server, the backups. This role gives you the full scope and the title to match. You do not need to know all of it on day one; you need to want it and learn fast.
What you will own
From day one
Service desk:
the IT request queue, floor support, meeting-room and event AV.
Onboarding and offboarding:
accounts, devices, access, licences and data handover — complete and evidenced.
Identity:
Google Workspace administration.
Devices:
a Mac-first laptop fleet with some Windows, managed through MDM; endpoint security and the hardware asset register.
Network and server room, first line:
collect the data, find the cause, make safe changes with a written plan and a rollback. Enterprise firewall, WiFi and switching; virtualisation, storage, power and backups.
On-call:
office emergencies; paid overtime when an incident or event needs it.
Within your first six months
Network and server room, full ownership:
firewall policy, WiFi, VPN and backups — end to end, under change control.
Vendors:
day-to-day owner for IT vendors and service providers — quotes, tickets, invoices, renewals.
Compliance:
first-line security-compliance evidence (for example SOC 2): access reviews and device controls.
Licences:
SaaS seat hygiene and renewals.
Cloud housekeeping:
OAuth clients, API access, billing and access for our cloud tenants.
Physical security:
office access control and cameras.
Documentation and automation:
runbooks for the systems you own; automate recurring service-desk and lifecycle work.
Your Skills and Experience
What we need from you (must-have)
3+ years in IT
, including service-desk work, with
growing ownership
since then (things you built, migrated or ran, not only tickets).
Hands-on sysadmin exposure
in at least one of: firewall, WiFi, VPN, servers, backups. You can tell the story of a problem you fixed yourself.
The drive to grow
into a sysadmin / IT-ops owner role.
You enjoy service work.
Users come first. This role keeps the service desk; it grows your scope, it does not take you away from users.
Workspace admin
(Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and a will to switch) and identity basics (SSO/SAML, OAuth, least privilege).
MDM
experience (Jamf, Intune or similar) and device-fleet support.
Real AI use, with examples (MUST).
You use AI tools in your daily IT work to troubleshoot, script, document and automate. Not for show, and not only when someone makes you. Your application MUST include 1–2 short examples: the problem, how you used AI, and the result.
Scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell.
Careful change habits:
one change at a time, a rollback ready, a written record.
Root-cause mindset:
you prove a cause with data before you call it.
High agency:
you find and close problems without being chased.
Good written and spoken English; Vietnamese for local vendors.
100% on-site in our HCMC office.
Work starts at 9am (sometimes 8am for events). Some evenings past 8pm for maintenance. On-call for emergencies, sometimes in US hours or at weekends. Paid OT.
Nice to have
Deeper network skills: firewall policies, SD-WAN, enterprise WiFi, VLANs, RF troubleshooting.
Apple fleet management; Google Workspace admin.
A home lab, a GitHub, a blog or anything else that shows you build things.
ITSM platform admin (Jira Service Management or similar): request types, workflows, SLAs, automation.
Security-compliance evidence work (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Virtualisation and backup tools; physical access-control systems.
Cloud identity and IAM (any major cloud).
Vendor and procurement experience.
Workflow automation tools; AWS basics.
Networking, security, MDM or Google Workspace certifications.
How to apply
Send your CV with 1–2 short examples of how you used AI in your IT work: the problem, what you did with AI, and the result. A link, a screenshot or a few lines of text is enough. Applications without examples will not move forward.
What success looks like
30 days:
you have access to every system you own, you know the vendors, and you keep the network and server-room documentation current.
90 days:
you run the service-desk queue to agreed response times; you own onboarding and offboarding end to end, with evidence; you solve network issues to root cause with data, with a runbook for each.
6 months:
you own network and server-room changes end to end, vendors and first-line compliance evidence; recurring service-desk and lifecycle work runs largely through automation.
Why You'll Love Working Here
At Katalon,
we bring together self-starting, open-minded, and talented people while actively promoting a transparent and growth-enabling working environment. But don’t just take our word for it. Take a better look below!
Total Remuneration:
Satisfying your financial goals through competitive compensation and periodic performance bonuses.
Well-being & Work-life Balance:
Staying healthy through comprehensive health plans and generous paid leaves.
Statutory Compliance:
Labor compliance with local regulations that ensure employee security.
Work Facilities & Accommodation:
Top-notch equipment, supportive allowances, and A-class facilities.
Diversity, Equity, Engagement, & Inclusion:
Becoming part of a global team that celebrates differences, equal opportunity, and meaningful employee recognition.
Growth & Rewards:
Thriving professionally through employee enablement, a culture of trust, and rewarding performance.
Katalon is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer
. We care about our people and celebrate our differences. We want to work with talented, collaborative, and innovative people. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Product Engineer (Insurtech SaaS, Golang, AI)
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

The Job
About the job
Product Engineer
AI-first engineering, uncompromising fundamentals. Accountable for the outcome, not the output.
Full-time · On-site · Flexible working hours · Distributed, multi-timezone team · AI-first engineering · 3+ years experience
The role is remote from your start date and becomes hybrid when our new office opens, expected around 20 December
Job Summary
We are hiring a
Product Engineer
- an engineer accountable for
outcomes, not output
.
We do not measure engineers by tickets closed or lines shipped. We measure them by whether the thing they built actually solved the user's problem. That means you will be expected to question requirements before building them, own a feature from ambiguity through to production behaviour, and stay attached to it after release - watching the metrics, the logs, and the support tickets.
You will work with
Product Managers, designers, and business stakeholders based in different countries and timezones
. Overlap hours are limited by design, so clear communication and the ability to move a decision forward asynchronously - without waiting for a meeting - matter as much as your engineering skill.
This is a
deeply technical role with an AI-first mindset
. AI coding agents are the default way we build here - you will spend more of your day designing architecture, steering agents, and reviewing generated code than typing implementations by hand. We expect fluency with spec-driven development, reusable agent skills, and context engineering, not occasional autocomplete use.
Which is exactly why fundamentals and best practices matter more, not less
, so you will be held to a high bar on SOLID, Clean Architecture, design patterns, distributed system design, relational data modelling, and automation testing: these are working knowledge, not résumé keywords, and you should expect to defend your choices reasonably in code review and in the interview.
You remain the author of record for everything that lands in main.
"The agent wrote it" is never an acceptable explanation for a defect.
Key Responsibilities
Own the outcome.
Take a business problem from vague to shipped to
measured
. Define what success looks like with your Product Manager, instrument for it, and act on what the data says - including rolling back or rewriting your own work when the numbers disagree with the plan.
Find the problem, not just the solution.
Interrogate requirements before implementing them. Surface the cheaper path, the edge case nobody scoped, and the feature that shouldn't be built. Say so early and in writing.
Collaborate across borders and timezones.
Partner directly with Product Managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders distributed across multiple countries. Write decisions down, keep specs and PR descriptions self-explanatory, unblock people in other timezones, and run the occasional early or late call when the others need it.
Architect and build services and APIs.
Design RESTful (and where appropriate, event-driven or gRPC) services applying SOLID, Clean/Hexagonal Architecture, and design patterns deliberately - with a clear justification for the boundaries you draw. Design normalised, indexed, migration-safe relational schemas that hold up under real query load. Architecture is the part an agent cannot infer for you: you set the boundaries and the contracts, then let agents fill them in.
Design for distribution.
Make grounded calls on monolith vs. microservices. Build services that satisfy 12-factor principles - externalised config, stateless processes, disposability, dev/prod parity - and containerise them for Docker/Kubernetes deployment.
Automate the safety net.
Own automated testing for what you build: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where it earns its keep. Tests ship in the same PR as the code, not in a follow-up ticket. A bug fix without a reproducing test is not a fix. In an AI-first workflow the test suite
is
the specification - it is what makes agent-generated change safe to merge at speed.
Work AI-first, and hold the line on quality.
Drive delivery with coding agents, know your acceptance criteria first, let agents execute, then review hard. Build and maintain reusable agent skills, project instructions, and guardrails so the whole team gains leverage - not just your own throughput. Reject output that is merely plausible: over-abstracted layers, duplicated logic, silently swallowed errors, tests that assert nothing. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
Run what you ship.
Instrument services with structured logging, metrics, and tracing. Debug production incidents, write the postmortem, and close the loop with a fix that prevents recurrence.
Raise the team's bar.
Review peers' PRs substantively, document trade-offs and decisions, and mentor on fundamentals and on responsible AI-assisted workflows.
Your Skills and Experience
Job Requirements
3+ years
building and operating production backend services - and you can walk through a system you designed, why you designed it that way, and what you'd change now.
Deep, demonstrable command of software design fundamentals:
OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and design patterns. You will be asked to critique a design and explain what breaks at scale. This is the non-negotiable core of the role - in an AI-first team, fundamentals are the review capability that keeps agent velocity from becoming agent debt.
Strong RESTful API design:
resource modelling, versioning, idempotency, pagination, error contracts, authentication/authorisation.
Strong relational database design
(PostgreSQL/MySQL): normalisation and when to break it, indexing strategy, transactions and isolation levels, query analysis, safe schema migrations.
Microservices and 12-factor apps:
service boundaries, inter-service communication, failure isolation, configuration and secrets management - plus honest judgment on when a monolith is the correct answer.
Automation testing discipline:
you write tests first or alongside, understand the test pyramid, and use test doubles without mocking away the thing under test. You treat coverage as a floor for confidence, never as a number to satisfy - and you can tell a genuine regression test from an agent-generated one that asserts nothing.
Containerisation:
confident with Docker; working knowledge of Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets, health probes, resource limits).
An AI-first way of working, already in your hands:
real production experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent - including spec/context engineering, agent skills or custom commands, and a disciplined self-review process before any PR. You should be able to describe a time an agent produced plausible-but-wrong code, how you caught it, and which fundamental (a design principle, a data-model rule, a failing test) let you catch it.
Product mindset with real ownership instincts:
comfortable with ambiguity, able to talk to non-engineers about trade-offs in their language, and biased toward shipping something small to learn rather than debating something large.
Effective asynchronous, cross-cultural collaboration:
professional written English, the discipline to document context for people who are asleep when you're working, and comfort operating with stakeholders in several countries and timezones.
Working frontend ability
- React, Next.js, or Vue - enough to build and ship a full user-facing slice yourself.
Nice to Have
Golang
- our preferred backend language for new services.
gRPC
and
HTTP/2
, including streaming and
Server-Sent Events (SSE)
for real-time and AI-streaming interfaces.
ReactJS / NextJS
at depth - SSR/RSC, routing, data fetching, performance.
CI/CD pipeline
ownership (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) including automated quality and security gates.
Infrastructure as Code
- Terraform, Pulumi, or Helm.
Service observability and SRE practice
- OpenTelemetry, APM (Datadog / New Relic / Grafana stack), SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident response.
Message queues, background job processing, and event-driven architectures.
SaaS products, media streaming (HLS/M3U8), or prior experience in a distributed international team.
Why You'll Love Working Here

A genuinely international team - you'll work with product and business colleagues across multiple countries.

Promote a culture of project management excellence across the Bank.

Drive the adoption of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices throughout the organization.

Portfolio Management capability.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Middle AI Engineer (LLM, RAG, ML, Python, PyTorch)
description:

Tham gia các dự án lớn với khách hàng US, UK
Môi trường làm việc trẻ trung, chuyên nghiệp
The Job
Thiết kế và xây dựng AI agents và ứng dụng LLM: gọi công cụ (tool/function calling), quy trình nhiều bước, đầu ra có cấu trúc (structured output), guardrails; đảm bảo độ tin cậy với retry, xử lý giới hạn tốc độ (rate limit) và kiểm tra an toàn.
Xây dựng hệ thống RAG và tìm kiếm tri thức trên tài liệu của khách hàng: chunking, embedding, hybrid search, reranking và câu trả lời có căn cứ.
Xây dựng pipeline document AI: OCR, trích xuất bố cục và bảng, tài liệu scan chất lượng thấp, mô hình thị giác-ngôn ngữ, kèm chấm điểm độ tin cậy và kiểm tra kết quả.
Triển khai và vận hành dịch vụ AI trên cloud (Azure, AWS) và trên VPS hoặc máy chủ tự quản: Docker, bảo mật, quản lý secrets và kiểm soát chi phí.
Chạy và tối ưu mô hình LLM, embedding, reranker: dùng API có sẵn hoặc mô hình mã nguồn mở trên GPU (vLLM, Ollama hoặc tương đương), áp dụng quantization và batching khi cần.
Đảm nhận MLOps và vận hành: CI/CD cho dịch vụ AI, quản lý phiên bản mô hình và dữ liệu, logging, tracing, giám sát hiệu năng và tài nguyên, tối ưu độ trễ và chi phí.
Xây dựng API và dịch vụ backend (REST, tác vụ bất đồng bộ, hàng đợi, xác thực) kết nối các thành phần AI với hệ thống của khách hàng.
Đo lường và cải thiện chất lượng: xây dựng bộ dữ liệu đánh giá (có thể gồm dữ liệu tổng hợp), dùng các chỉ số như Precision@K, Recall@K, và MRR, phân tích lỗi và tối ưu liên tục.
Thu thập yêu cầu của khách hàng, ước lượng công việc, viết tài liệu giải pháp.
Hỗ trợ đồng đội và phối hợp với frontend, BA, tester và quản lý dự án.
Your Skills and Experience
Từ 2 năm kinh nghiệm AI/ML hoặc kỹ thuật phần mềm, đã triển khai ít nhất một hệ thống LLM, agent hoặc OCR đến người dùng thật.
Python vững, biết PyTorch hoặc thư viện ML tương đương, và thực hành kỹ thuật tốt (Git, kiểm thử, code review).
Từng xây dựng AI agents với API LLM (tool calling, framework điều phối hoặc tự viết) và một framework API như FastAPI.
Từng làm OCR và xử lý tài liệu (engine mã nguồn mở, dịch vụ OCR trên cloud hoặc mô hình thị giác-ngôn ngữ).
Có kinh nghiệm với vector database hoặc search engine (pgvector, FAISS hoặc tương đương) và hiểu hybrid search.
Kỹ năng triển khai: Linux, Docker, ít nhất một nền tảng cloud (Azure, AWS), cài đặt VPS, reverse proxy (Nginx hoặc tương đương), kiến thức cơ bản về mạng, bảo mật, quản lý secrets và phân quyền.
Hiểu cơ sở dữ liệu SQL.
Biết kiểm thử và đo lường chất lượng hệ thống AI bằng các chỉ số phù hợp.
Biết giao tiếp tiếng Anh là một lợi thế.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Thu nhập cạnh tranh, chế độ tăng lương 1-2 lần/năm
Thưởng theo hiệu quả làm việc, thưởng Lễ Tết, Công đoàn vào 08/03, 20/10, Tết Thiếu nhi, Tết Trung thu,…

Crossian is a high-growth technology-driven e-commerce business. Behind our success is our people. As a start-up formed in 2020, we have created a fast-paced and dynamic environment, enabling our people to reach a cumulative average growth rate of over 1000% in the last 6 years.
We are building an agile, data-driven Fashion Product Development team that turns global trends into commercially successful products. Every step, from trend research and concept creation to sampling and final launch, is optimized for speed, quality, and customer delight.
As a Project Manager / Delivery Manager, you will lead the end-to-end execution and performance of the Fashion Product team. The Job
About Us
Crossian is a high-growth technology-driven e-commerce business. As a start-up formed in 2020, we have created a fast-paced and dynamic environment, enabling our people to reach a cumulative average growth rate of over 1000% in the last 5 years.
About the role
We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to embed security into software delivery, assess applications and cloud workloads, and drive vulnerabilities through to verified resolution. You will partner with engineering and DevOps teams to implement practical controls, provide security guidance, and balance risk with business and delivery needs.
Key responsibilities
Secure SDLC & DevSecOps
Define security requirements, security gates, and design reviews across the design, development, testing, and deployment stages of the SDLC.
Integrate and automate SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, and container/IaC scanning in CI/CD pipelines; tune findings to reduce false positives and improve developer workflows.
Security assessment & penetration testing
Assess and penetration-test web and mobile applications, APIs, and backend services using OWASP guidance, with attention to authentication, authorization, and business logic.
Perform manual and automated security code reviews of high-risk functionality; help developers identify root causes and implement effective remediation.
Vulnerability lifecycle management
Manage application vulnerabilities from discovery, validation, and risk-based prioritization through remediation, retesting, and closure against agreed SLAs; escalate overdue findings and track approved exceptions.
Assess risks in third-party libraries, open-source dependencies, and software components using Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).
Cloud workload security
Assess and implement security controls for application workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Partner with DevOps to review containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, IAM/service identities, secrets, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) against security baselines.
Incident response & collaboration
Support application security incident investigations and use lessons learned to strengthen preventive controls and development practices.
Coordinate external penetration tests, including scope definition, findings follow-up, and remediation retesting.
Provide practical secure coding guidance, training, and support to engineering teams.
Your Skills and Experience
Requirements
Intermediate:
Typically 3+ years of relevant experience, able to deliver defined assessments and security improvements with guidance on complex decisions.
Senior:
Typically 5+ years, with demonstrated ownership of application security practices, complex assessments, and cross-team remediation.
Hands-on application/API penetration testing and security code review experience, with strong knowledge of OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, and business-logic vulnerabilities.
Experience integrating and tuning security testing tools in CI/CD pipelines and applying Secure SDLC practices.
Experience validating, prioritizing, and tracking vulnerabilities through verified closure, including dependency risk management using SCA/SBOM.
Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, container/Kubernetes security, IAM, secrets management, and IaC review.
Ability to read application code and write scripts to automate security tasks.
Clear communication and reporting skills; able to explain risk, recommend practical fixes, and collaborate with developers and stakeholders.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with mobile application testing, threat modeling, or application security incident investigations.
Relevant application security, penetration testing, or cloud security certifications are welcome but not required.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Real ownership over an important part of the company, from day one.
The chance to help redesign systems that matter.
A workplace that values results and independent thinking.
13th-month salary + performance bonus.
15 paid leave days + health insurance.
Budget to keep learning and growing.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

The Job
Daiichi Life Vietnam is building a value-focused
Data Analytics & AI function
to
develop and operationalize
predictive models across
customer growth
, renewal premium collection, persistency and claims. We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist who can independently lead complex modeling work, guide junior specialists and partner with business teams to convert models into controlled interventions and measurable financial outcomes.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
1. ADVANCED MODEL DEVELOPMENT & TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP
• Lead end-to-end analytical work for assigned use cases, including problem framing, data assessment, label design, feature engineering, model development and model selection.
• Develop robust statistical and machine-learning models, including GLM, gradient boosting, survival, severity, anomaly-detection and treatment-response / uplift approaches as applicable.
• Design evaluation frameworks covering discrimination, calibration, stability, explainability, fairness and segment-level performance.
• Review code and methodology, mentor junior data scientists and promote reproducible development, testing and documentation standards.
• Translate complex model behavior into clear business drivers, limitations, reason codes and decision recommendations.
2. EXPERIMENTATION, IMPLEMENTATION & MODEL LIFECYCLE
• Partner with Analytics Product Managers to define interventions, controlled pilots, success thresholds and incremental-value measurement.
• Prepare production scoring specifications and work with Data Engineering, BI, IT and business teams to integrate model outputs into operational workflows.
• Prepare development documentation, respond to independent validation and ensure approval conditions are addressed before deployment.
• Establish and monitor model-performance, data-drift and business-value indicators; recommend recalibration, retraining, restriction or retirement.
• Engage Actuarial, Claims, Distribution, Customer Service and Risk teams to ensure models are technically sound, commercially relevant and responsibly used.
Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor or Master degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or a related quantitative field.
• Minimum 5-8 years of experience in data science, machine learning, actuarial analytics or quantitative modeling, with demonstrated end-to-end project ownership.
• Strong expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning, including GLM, tree-based models, model calibration and explainability.
• Practical experience with AI or LLM-enabled solutions, such as prompt workflows, semantic search, RAG, text analytics or conversational interfaces.
• Understanding of LLM evaluation, including how to assess relevance, factuality, consistency, safety and business usefulness.
• Practical experience in at least one advanced area such as survival analysis, causal inference, uplift modeling, anomaly detection, frequency / severity modeling or recommender systems.
• Advanced SQL and strong R or Python programming skills, including reproducible workflows, version control and code review.
• Experience operationalizing models, designing controlled experiments and monitoring models after deployment.
• Life insurance, banking, customer analytics, claims or fraud analytics experience is strongly preferred.
• Strong stakeholder communication and mentoring skills, with fluency in English.

We are looking for a Network Engineer to operate, secure, and improve enterprise and datacenter network infrastructures.
The engineer will act as an L3 escalation point, participate in the scheduled On-Call rotation, and may temporarily support shift operations when required due to staffing needs.
The engineer will work on network design, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, vulnerability management, DDoS protection, customer migration projects, and L3 technical escalation.

Track and resolve security advisories/CVEs from vendors (Fortinet, Arista), assess infrastructure impact, and execute firmware upgrades (e.g., FortiOS HA) and vulnerability patching.

Deploy and manage DDoS protection solutions and propose advanced mitigations.
Manage hardware lifecycles, replace faulty components, handle Arista switch RMAs, and adhere to EOS Life Cycle Policies.
Execute network migrations, including IP planning, new topology design, and MPLS channel configurations.

Phối hợp với các đơn vị Quản trị dữ liệu, An ninh thông tin, Rủi ro và Tuân thủ để triển khai hiệu quả các chính sách, quy trình, tiêu chuẩn và công cụ bảo mật dữ liệu trong phạm vi được phân công, góp phần đảm bảo hoạt động quản trị dữ liệu toàn hàng được vận hành liên tục, an toàn và hiệu quả.
2. Nhiệm vụ/trách nhiệm chính:
i. Thiết kế và triển khai Data Security Framework thống nhất trên toàn tổ chức.
ii. Quản lý các hoạt động bảo mật dữ liệu theo vòng đời dữ liệu (data lifecycle):
• Phân loại và gắn nhãn dữ liệu (Data Classification & Tagging)
• Mã hóa và quản lý khóa (Encryption & Key Management)
• Ẩn danh, che dấu dữ liệu (Masking, Tokenization)
• Quản lý truy cập và phân quyền (Access Control, IAM, ABAC/RBAC)
• Giám sát và phát hiện rò rỉ dữ liệu (DLP, Monitoring, Incident Response)
iii. Xây dựng và cập nhật chính sách, quy trình, tiêu chuẩn bảo mật dữ liệu, phối hợp chặt chẽ với các đơn vị IT Security, Data Governance, QTRR và Tuân thủ.
iv. Tham gia triển khai, đánh giá và kiểm soát tuân thủ các quy định pháp luật về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân và bảo mật thông tin.
v. Đào tạo, nâng cao nhận thức về bảo mật dữ liệu cho các đơn vị kinh doanh và kỹ thuật.
vi. Xây dựng báo cáo định kỳ về tình hình an ninh dữ liệu, cảnh báo sớm rủi ro và kế hoạch cải thiện cho Ban Lãnh đạo.
Your Skills and Experience
I. Trình độ & kinh nghiệm
• Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, An toàn thông tin, Khoa học dữ liệu, hoặc tương đương.
• Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực: Information Security, Data Governance, IT Risk, hoặc Cloud Security.
• Hiểu biết về các tiêu chuẩn và khung kiểm soát bảo mật dữ liệu: ISO 27001/27701, NIST, GDPR, PCI-DSS, Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP.
• Có kinh nghiệm triển khai hoặc quản lý các công cụ bảo mật dữ liệu: DLP, Data Masking, Encryption, IAM, SIEM, Key Vault, Cloud Security Tools.
II. Kỹ năng
• Khả năng thiết kế và triển khai cơ chế bảo mật dữ liệu ở cấp tổ chức.
• Tư duy data-centric security, cân bằng giữa bảo mật và hiệu quả kinh doanh.
• Kỹ năng điều phối liên phòng ban, giao tiếp tốt, và ra quyết định nhanh trong tình huống sự cố.
• Ưu tiên có chứng chỉ quốc tế: CISSP, CISM, CDPSE, ISO 27001 LA/LI, CDMP Practitioner, CISA.

title: VAI - Chuyên viên Kiểm thử phần mềm
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Dẫn đầu thị trường
Cơ hội thử thách và phát triển bản thân
Môi trường làm việc năng động
The Job
Chiến lược & Quy trình kiểm thử
Xây dựng Test Strategy và Master Test Plan cho từng dự án/sản phẩm: xác định phạm vi, loại hình và mức độ kiểm thử, tiêu chí bắt đầu/kết thúc (Entry/Exit Criteria) và tiêu chí phát hành (Release Criteria).
Thiết lập, chuẩn hóa và liên tục cải tiến quy trình QA/QC theo mô hình Agile/Scrum; đưa kiểm thử vào sớm từ giai đoạn phân tích yêu cầu (Shift-left) và tích hợp kiểm thử vào pipeline CI/CD.
Áp dụng kiểm thử dựa trên rủi ro (Risk-based Testing): nhận diện, đánh giá và ưu tiên các khu vực có rủi ro cao về nghiệp vụ, kỹ thuật và dữ liệu.
Xây dựng bộ chỉ số đo lường chất lượng (Test Coverage, Defect Density, Defect Leakage, tỷ lệ Pass/Fail, thời gian xử lý lỗi…) và dùng số liệu để ra quyết định.
Quản lý & Phát triển đội ngũ Test
Trực tiếp quản lý team Tester (Manual & Automation): ước lượng khối lượng công việc (Test Estimation), phân công nhiệm vụ, theo dõi tiến độ và xử lý vướng mắc.
Review chất lượng test case, kết quả kiểm thử và báo cáo lỗi của thành viên; đảm bảo đầu ra đồng đều và đúng chuẩn.
Đào tạo, kèm cặp (Coaching/Mentoring), đánh giá hiệu suất và xây dựng lộ trình phát triển năng lực cho từng thành viên.
Xây dựng kho tri thức dùng chung của team: template, checklist, bộ test case mẫu, tài liệu hướng dẫn.
Phối hợp trong team dự án
Tham gia review yêu cầu (User Story, Acceptance Criteria, tài liệu đặc tả) cùng BA/PO ngay từ đầu để phát hiện sớm điểm mơ hồ, thiếu sót.
Phối hợp chặt chẽ với Dev, DevOps, Data/AI Engineer để thống nhất phạm vi kiểm thử, môi trường, dữ liệu và kế hoạch phát hành.
Đại diện QA trong các buổi Sprint Planning, Daily, Review, Retrospective; báo cáo tình trạng chất lượng cho PM/Ban lãnh đạo và đưa ra khuyến nghị Go/No-go trước mỗi lần phát hành.
Tổ chức thực thi kiểm thử
Chỉ đạo thiết kế test scenario/test case cho kiểm thử chức năng và phi chức năng: API, tích hợp hệ thống, dữ liệu, hiệu năng, bảo mật, tương thích đa nền tảng (Web/Mobile).
Chuẩn bị và quản lý môi trường kiểm thử (Test Environment) và dữ liệu kiểm thử (Test Data), đảm bảo tuân thủ quy định bảo mật dữ liệu.
Quản lý vòng đời lỗi trên Jira: phân loại Severity/Priority, điều phối Bug Triage, phân tích nguyên nhân gốc (Root Cause Analysis) và theo dõi đến khi đóng lỗi.
Định hướng và thúc đẩy kiểm thử tự động (API, UI, Regression), từng bước nâng tỷ lệ tự động hóa và rút ngắn thời gian kiểm thử hồi quy.
Ứng dụng AI vào hoạt động kiểm thử (AI for Testing)
Sử dụng các công cụ AI tạo sinh/LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot…) để sinh test scenario, test case từ User Story và tài liệu yêu cầu; tạo dữ liệu kiểm thử giả lập (Synthetic Test Data); hỗ trợ viết và bảo trì script automation.
Ứng dụng AI để phân tích log và báo cáo lỗi: gom nhóm lỗi trùng lặp, gợi ý nguyên nhân gốc, dự đoán khu vực rủi ro cao để ưu tiên kiểm thử.
Nghiên cứu, thử nghiệm và đưa vào sử dụng các công cụ kiểm thử có tích hợp AI (Self-healing Test, Visual Testing, AI Test Generation…); đo lường hiệu quả (thời gian tiết kiệm, độ bao phủ, số lỗi phát hiện) và nhân rộng trong team.
Xây dựng hướng dẫn sử dụng AI an toàn và có trách nhiệm trong team: không đưa dữ liệu nhạy cảm vào công cụ bên ngoài, bắt buộc review kết quả do AI sinh ra trước khi sử dụng.
Kiểm thử sản phẩm AI (Testing AI Products)
Xây dựng phương pháp kiểm thử đặc thù cho các sản phẩm AI của Viettel AI (Sàn Dữ liệu, Trung gian dữ liệu, DMP, Trợ lý ảo…), kết hợp kiểm thử chức năng truyền thống với đánh giá chất lượng mô hình.
Kiểm thử các ứng dụng dùng LLM: độ chính xác và nhất quán của câu trả lời, hiện tượng “ảo giác”, Prompt Injection, nội dung không phù hợp; kiểm thử hồi quy khi thay đổi mô hình hoặc prompt.
Đánh giá hiệu năng, độ ổn định và tính công bằng (Bias/Fairness) của hệ thống AI trong điều kiện thực tế: tải đồng thời, thời gian phản hồi, dữ liệu đầu vào nhiễu hoặc bất thường.
Nghiệm thu & Hỗ trợ triển khai
Tổ chức nghiệm thu nội bộ (Internal UAT) và hỗ trợ khách hàng trong quá trình UAT; chuẩn bị tài liệu hướng dẫn sử dụng và tài liệu bàn giao.
Đánh giá mức độ sẵn sàng phát hành (Release Readiness), thực hiện Smoke Test sau Go-live và hỗ trợ xử lý sự cố trên môi trường Production.
Tổng kết bài học kinh nghiệm (Lessons Learned) sau mỗi dự án/release để cải tiến quy trình kiểm thử.
Your Skills and Experience
Yêu cầu chung
Tốt nghiệp Đại học Chính quy loại Khá trở lên, chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, hoặc các chuyên ngành liên quan.
Tiếng Anh tối thiểu TOEIC 650/990 (Chưa yêu cầu có bằng khi tuyển dụng đầu vào).
Yêu cầu cụ thể
Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm từ 3-4 năm trở lên ở vị trí chuyên viên hoặc từ 2 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Leader Tester trở lên.
Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm các dự án về
Product, Fintech, E-commerce
Nắm vững các loại hình kiểm thử: Unit, Integration, System, Regression, Performance và UAT.
Sử dụng thành thạo SQL để truy vấn và kiểm tra toàn vẹn dữ liệu (Data Integrity).
Sử dụng các công cụ quản lý lỗi (Jira ..) và các công cụ kiểm thử (Postman, Jmeter…).
Có tư duy về Security Testing (kiểm thử bảo mật) là một lợi thế.
Biết về Automation (Selenium, Appium) là một lợi thế.
Có chứng chỉ ISTQB advanced là lợi thế.
Tư duy logic tốt, cẩn trọng và có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao với sản phẩm.
Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề và quản lý thời gian hiệu quả dưới áp lực dự án.
Khả năng giao tiếp, truyền đạt và thuyết phục tốt.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Đãi ngộ
# Dẫn đầu thị trường

title: Senior iOS Engineer (Fluent in English)
description:

The Job
The Role
Be a part of something big! GeoComply is embarking on a transformative journey to revolutionize our core geolocation services, the cornerstone of our product. We're looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to play a crucial role in this effort. You'll be instrumental in the modernization of our core technology stack, directly impacting the development of next-generation geolocation and anti-fraud products. This includes evolving legacy systems to a modern, cutting-edge platform and strengthening our defenses against ever-evolving spoofing threats. If you're a passionate engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and wants to make a real difference, we encourage you to apply!
Key Responsibilities
iOS Performance Optimization:
Contribute to our iOS SDK performance optimization initiative, a multi-year project to enhance the reliability, features, and efficiency of our geolocation services.
Contribute to automating operational tasks, such as releases and production support, to increase efficiency and free up resources for innovation.
Research new features, analyze requirements & competitors, estimate implementation; design software; code reviews; document solutions
Client Success:
Collaborate closely with our client-facing team to help resolve issues for our Clients, ensuring a smooth experience for end users & developers.
Anti-fraud Innovations:
Innovate the iOS SDK following industry best practices for fast, high reliability, security and performance
Drive the development, scaling, and optimization of geolocation and anti-fraud products that align with GeoComply’s mission and customer needs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management and business stakeholders, to define product requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Champion a user-centric approach to product development, ensuring our solutions are intuitive, efficient, and deliver exceptional value.
Collaborate with our global team of experts to build technologies that set the industry standard for anti-fraud and compliance solutions.
Stay abreast of emerging spoofing techniques and proactively adapt our systems to maintain a robust security posture.
Design and implement features that empower business users to define and execute real time Anti-fraud rules
Your Skills and Experience
Who You Are
Computer Science background with 5+ years of experience in programming languages, with a preference for iOS development proficiency (Both Objective-C and Swift).
Proven experience collaborating with Product Managers, translating product requirements into technical requirements
Proven expertise in designing and implementing multi-threading architectures
Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.
Experience with Xcode Instruments
Experience with device jailbreak and hide jailbreak techniques
Experience with CI/CD pipelines specifically for mobile development.
Familiar with reverse-engineering techniques..
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Enjoy working in a multi-region environment
Willing to learn in a fast-paced environment
Intermediate written and spoken technical English with ability to articulate & debate during team calls.
Bonus Points
Experience building apps with cross platform technologies: Cordova, ReactNative, Unity…etc…
Familiarity with geolocation spoofing techniques and anti-fraud measures.
Track record of Mobile Security Testing.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Our Benefits:
Learning opportunities & personal development allowance
20 annual leave days, 5 sick leave days
Extensive health insurance
Competitive salary package, 100% salary during the probation period
Attractive bonuses (13th month, business performance, equity plans)
Annual salary performance review
Hybrid working mode & Modern office at a prime location in District 1
Free parking
Annual company trip & year-end party
Quarterly team-building activities
In-office snacks and drinks
International working environment
About GeoComply
We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud.
Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year.
At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down.
Now What?
Send us your resume and a cover letter. We Can’t-Wait To Meet You.
