Hello Clever is building the next generation of payments and loyalty infrastructure by turning every transaction into growth for merchants.

We’re an AI-powered fintech operating across 26+ markets, helping businesses move money in real time and convert payments into measurable outcomes like higher repeat rates, bigger baskets, and smarter customer engagement. Our platform combines local account-to-account rails, embedded cashback and loyalty products, and powerful data intelligence through Clever AI, so merchants can launch offers, optimise ROI, and scale faster, all through a single integration.

We recently crossed $70M in live ARR and are on track to pass $100M by the end of 2026-just 2.3 years after reaching our first $1M. It’s an exciting milestone that reflects the scale of what we’re building and the opportunity ahead.

We’re also proud to be recognised on the global stage, including being named Australia’s fastest-growing fintech, recognised in Forbes Asia’s Top 100, ranked among the AFR Fastest-Growing Companies, and selected for Inc. Magazine’s Best in Business.

About The Role

You'll build the integrations that connect our platform to suppliers and payment rails, and help evolve the platform our partners build on. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll design, build and test backend services while working directly with suppliers' technical teams to take integrations live. We're growing fast, so we need someone who moves fast, takes initiative, and is trusted to make technical decisions and see them through.

What You'll Do

Lead supplier integrations end to end: scope, estimates and timelines, coordination with product, QA and ops, through sandbox/UAT, certification and go-live.Act as the technical point of contact for suppliers: clarify specs, resolve open technical questions, and align on flows, limits and settlement.Own ongoing maintenance of live integrations: API changes and deprecations, certificate and credential renewals, supplier health monitoring, and up-to-date integration documentation and runbooks.Design scalable integration and platform architecture: connector patterns, shared components and partner-facing APIs.Handle payment lifecycles: webhooks, retries, idempotency, partial failures, reconciliation and settlement.Build secure, compliant integrations with sound data protection and audit practices.Ensure production readiness through automated unit and integration tests, monitoring, alerting, and safe rollout and rollback plans.Write design docs, review others' designs and code, and lead incident root-cause analysis with suppliers.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of backend engineering, with strong production experience in Ruby and Ruby on Rails.Pragmatic about technology choices, including using other languages when needed to improve system reliability or performance.Proven experience running third-party integrations in production, ideally with payment gateways, banks or PSPs.Experience leading the design of a platform, integration layer or multi-provider system.Strong written and spoken English (B2+), with the ability to independently manage technical discussions with external partners.Ability to turn unclear specifications into actionable plans and deliver with minimal supervision.Strong fundamentals in async processing, idempotency, PostgreSQL/MySQL and production troubleshooting.

Nice to Have

Experience at a payment gateway, processor or payments infrastructure company.Real-time or account-to-account payment rails, multi-currency.Redis, Sidekiq, Kafka, cloud and containers.AI-assisted coding tools with strong review discipline.

What Success Looks Like In 6–12 Months

Agreed supplier integrations delivered end to end, through production launch and stabilisation.A reusable connector pattern that makes onboarding suppliers faster.Improved integration reliability and troubleshooting through better failure handling, monitoring and runbooks.

What We Value

Speed with quality: you ship fast without cutting corners on reliability.Proactive ownership: you spot problems early and fix them without being asked.Clear, direct communication with suppliers, partners and internal teams.Independence: you're trusted to make decisions, and you own the outcome.

Why join Hello Clever?

High-Growth Fintech - Be part of a company leading the future of real-time payments and loyalty solutions.Global impact - We’re live in 26+ markets and growing fast.Category-defining product - Real-time payments, instant cashback, AI-powered merchant tools.Mission-driven - We’re here to make money smarter, fairer and faster for everyone.Dynamic Culture - Join a passionate, results-driven team that values innovation and collaboration.

Benefits & Perks

Leave that supports real life – Enjoy Birthday Leave and Menstrual Leave in addition to your standard annual leave.Invest in your wellbeing and growth – Receive an annual Wellness and Development Allowance to use toward what helps you feel and perform at your best.Technology support – Access a Technology Allowance to help you create a productive working setup.Flexible hybrid working – Enjoy the balance of collaborating in person and working remotely.Celebrate together – Connect with the team through quarterly social events and our annual company trip.

How To Apply

We like to keep things simple, but we also want to make sure this is the right fit for both of us. Here’s what to expect:

Phone CallTechnical Interview Round Meet the Team 

Sound like you? Let’s talk. Drop us a note at careers@helloclever.co

Direct applicants only, no agencies.

Role Description

The Data Engineer is responsible for architecting, building, and optimizing centralized data infrastructure (Data Warehouse / Data Lake) to empower business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven executive decision-making. This role owns end-to-end data integration pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC, Batch & Real-time) across enterprise operational platforms (SAP ERP, DMS, WMS, TMS, OCS/CRM, Logs, and 3rd-party services), guaranteeing data consistency, high availability, cost efficiency, and query performance.

Data Pipeline Architecture & Engineering: Design, construct, and optimize automated ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting heterogeneous data sources (core enterprise systems, OCS, DMS, CRM, SAP S/4HANA, WMS, TMS, Web/App Logs, 3rd-party APIs) into the centralized Data Warehouse.Engineer enterprise-grade data integration solutions, Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines, and high-throughput Batch and Real-time / Near Real-time processing flows.Data Modeling & Architecture: Design and maintain robust data models on Data Warehouse platforms (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema) optimized for high-performance querying and analytical reporting.Structure domain-specific Data Marts and analytical layers aligned with operational and strategic management needs.DataOps & Data Quality Governance: Implement CI/CD best practices for data codebase management; build automated data testing and Data Quality checks to proactively detect and alert data anomalies.Monitor pipeline reliability, execution SLAs, latency, and error rates to guarantee continuous system uptime.Performance Tuning & Cloud Cost Optimization: Profile, troubleshoot, and optimize complex SQL queries; implement efficient partitioning, clustering, and data compression strategies to curtail cloud storage/compute expenditures.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management: Partner closely with Data Analysts, Business Analysts, and Product Teams to translate business requirements into clean, scalable data datasets and marts. Manage milestones for Data Warehouse enhancements, pipeline re-architecting, and BI reporting ecosystem initiatives.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), or related fields.

Experience: Minimum 2–4 years of progressive experience as a Data Engineer, DWH Developer, or ETL Engineer.

Technical Qualifications

Strong programming proficiency in Python or Java / Scala.Expert-level SQL proficiency (advanced data manipulation, analytical functions, indexing, and execution plan optimization).Direct hands-on experience or professional certification in modern Cloud Data Warehouses: Google BigQuery, Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Databricks.Practical experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) or equivalent real-time event streaming paradigms.Proven competence in workflow orchestration and transformation tools: Apache Airflow and dbt (Data Build Tool).Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, JSON/XML data serialization, file-based data ingestion, and enterprise integration patterns.Proficient in Linux/Unix environments, Shell scripting, and task automation.Comprehensive understanding of Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse paradigms, and modern ETL/ELT architectures

title: Firmware Engineer
description:

Invent the future with us

AI Data Infrastructure

Job Details

Aitomatic builds Digital Engineers for physical industry: AI agents that turn engineering expertise into governed, executable intelligence. Our platform, DanaOS, powers them in real operations such as semiconductor fabs, buildings, plants and energy systems, including on-premise and air-gapped environments.

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to help build the core of DanaOS. You will work with our AI experts, product managers and Forward-Deployed Engineers to make agents reliable, governed and fast to deploy for different enterprise customers.

We suggest you explore aitomatic.com and form your own view of what we are building. We would like to hear it in the interview.

About The Role

Design and build the agent framework: workflows, tool use, orchestration and reasoning. Build the runtime, governance and evaluation capabilities that make agents safe and dependable in production. Build integrations and reusable components that connect agents to customer systems and data. Own features end to end: understand the user problem, ship an early version fast, then iterate with FDEs and customers until it is polished and genuinely usable. Use our own agents in your daily work, and fix what gets in your way. Hold a high bar for quality and mentor others through code reviews. 


What Makes You a Good Fit

Must Have

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Strong software engineering skills, with proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience building and shipping AI agents to real users (workflows, tool use, orchestration, evaluation), not just chatbots or one-off prototypes. Experience integrating with real-world systems and data (APIs, pipelines, enterprise systems). A track record of shipping software that is reliable, polished and genuinely usable. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to speed up development. Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication, including with customer-facing teams. 


Great to Have

Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs or other symbolic and neurosymbolic approaches to reasoning. Experience with industrial systems or data (for example manufacturing, buildings or energy). Experience building secure, on-premise or air-gapped software. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with cloud services such as Azure or AWS. Experience in a forward-deployed or customer-facing engineering role. 


Who You Are

A product-minded builder: you care whether people can actually use what you ship, not just whether it passes the ticket. You ship early, listen to feedback and keep iterating until it is great. You work with AI by default and use what you build. 


Before You Apply

We move fast and we expect a lot. This role probably isn't right for you if:

You find ambiguity stressful rather than something to resolve. You prefer to stay in your lane rather than flag problems outside your immediate scope. You want a well-defined role in a large, established org. 


But if you're the kind of engineer who sees a broken integration and can't help but fix it, and who treats "we've never built that before" as an invitation rather than a blocker, this is the role you've been looking for.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Attractive compensation and benefits commensurate with experience and impact. Daily lunch allowance of $10 per team member. Private health insurance for you and your family. Overseas travel opportunities for training and work. Real ownership: your work goes straight to customers in fabs, plants and energy sites, and you see the impact. Flexible working hours.

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer (Vue 3 + Golang)
description:
Who We Are

Intrepid Asia is a leading e-commerce and Digital Solutions Provider in Southeast Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state of the art in-house technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven and growth-focused services, which are enabled by the strongest team in the industry, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.

We are growing rapidly and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful e-commerce business end-to-end.

The team you will be part of

Our Tech Team is the engine behind our digital capabilities — designing and building the platforms, tools, and systems that power our services across the eCommerce ecosystem. From automation to optimization to data integration, the team turns complex challenges into seamless solutions, enabling scale, speed, and smarter decision-making. With innovation at its core, Tech drives the digital backbone of our business and empowers every function to perform at its best.

The team operates across multiple product domains — MarTech, Data-as-a-Service, and Social Commerce — each with its own suite of internal tools and external-facing applications. All products are built on a common shared infrastructure and benefit from a collaborative engineering culture where knowledge-sharing, code standards, and continuous learning are central to how we work.

The part you will play

You will build our Social Commerce Intelligence Platform — an affiliate and creator management product for brands running affiliate programs on TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada and other SEA platforms — end to end, from the Vue 3 screens to the Go services behind them.

Brand teams use it to discover creators across marketplaces, build and manage their own creator network, import and reconcile creator lists, enrich profiles with contact and performance data, and track GMV, commission and content ROI per creator and per campaign. It is a multi-tenant SaaS: brand × country, 6 markets, targeted at 5,000 concurrent users.

This is a from-scratch product on a fresh monorepo, not maintenance of a legacy codebase. You will own features vertically — OpenAPI contract, Go domain service, async worker, Vue screens, tests — rather than being handed tickets for one layer. And you will do it with coding agents as your primary implementation tool: our workflow is spec-driven and agent-driven, with humans reviewing evidence rather than typing every line.

What You Will Take Charge Of

Full-stack product delivery — Main scope

Work with the Product team to turn business requirements into clear specs — challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and agree on scope before you buildWork with the Design team to lock the design before implementation: review flows and screens, flag what the design system already covers, raise edge cases and states early, and sign off on what gets builtBuild Vue 3 SPA screens (Composition API, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, TanStack Query) on top of our internal design system — Discover, My Network, Imports, Creator Detail, SettingsBuild the Go services behind them: Gin HTTP handlers generated from OpenAPI, domain services with constructor injection, sqlc-based repositories, RabbitMQ consumers and scheduled jobsWork contract-first: the OpenAPI spec and event JSON Schemas are the source of truth; Go server stubs and the TypeScript client are both generated from them, and CI fails on stale codegenDesign multi-tenant data access — every query scoped by tenant, Elasticsearch as the read model for creator search and faceting, MySQL as source of truth, synced through an outbox and RabbitMQOwn the non-functional side of what you ship: p95 latency budgets, pagination bounds, async exports and imports, idempotent consumers, structured logs and metrics

Engineering with coding agents — Main scope

Implement day to day with Claude Code, and design screens with Claude DesignKeep the agent setup living with the system — rules, skills and guardrails stay in sync as the codebase changesOwn what the agent produces: you review it, you are accountable for it

Quality, review and craft — Main scope

Write tests that hold: unit tests on domain logic, integration tests against real MySQL / Redis / RabbitMQ / Elasticsearch containers, contract tests against the spec, Playwright for critical flowsReview teammates' and agents' code, contribute to coding standards, and raise the bar for whoever joins after you

AI features in the product

Ship user-facing AI features on top of LLM APIs — creator search in natural language, profile and content summarisation, campaign and creator recommendations, agent-callable actions on the app itselfHandle the practical side of LLM integration: prompt versioning, structured output, streaming, retries, evaluation and cost tracking

Data and crawling integration

Work with our crawler and data teams to turn raw marketplace and social data into the canonical creator profiles and daily metrics the product readsWhere the platform has no Open API, help design and consume crawling pipelines: event contracts, normalisation, deduplication and matching, freshness and quality monitoring

Requirements

3+ years building and shipping production web products, with real ownership of both a frontend and a backend codebase (not "I touched the API once")Vue 3 — strong: Composition API and , TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router, a server-state library (TanStack Query or similar). You know why component state, server cache and URL state are three different thingsGolang — strong: idiomatic Go, goroutines and channels, context propagation, interfaces and dependency injection, error handling, table-driven tests. Gin or an equivalent HTTP framework in productionDatabases: MySQL schema design, indexing and query optimisation; comfortable writing SQL by hand (we use sqlc, not an ORM). Redis for caching and rate limiting. Elasticsearch or OpenSearch in production — mapping design, filtering and faceting, cursor pagination, re-indexing; you know when a query belongs in the search index and not in MySQLAsync systems: RabbitMQ or Kafka in production — exchanges and routing, consumer retries, dead-letter queues, idempotencyAPI design: REST with OpenAPI as a contract, versioning and backward compatibility, code generation on both endsTesting: you write tests before or alongside the code, and can explain what belongs in a unit test versus an integration test versus an E2E testCoding agents — fluent, daily, in production work. This is a hard requirement, not a bonus. You should be able to walk us through:

Nice to haveSoft skills

Which agent you use and how you structure a task for it — spec, constraints, acceptance criteria, test firstHow you keep it inside the rails — repo rules files, custom commands or skills, guard hooks, scoped file permissionsHow you review its output, and a concrete case where you caught something it got wrongWhere you deliberately do not use it, and whyDocker and a working understanding of CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or similar); able to debug your own service in KubernetesWorking English — you will read and write specs, ADRs and PR reviews in English with regional colleaguesDomain — strong plus: affiliate or creator marketing, TikTok Shop affiliate / TikTok Shop Partner ecosystem, influencer CRM, livestream commerce, marketplace seller tooling, or e-commerce analytics. Knowing what GMV, commission rate, sample seeding, open collaboration and creator tiers actually mean saves us months of translationAI / LLM integration — plus: shipped features on top of OpenAI / Gemini / Claude APIs; RAG, embeddings and vector search; structured output and function calling; prompt versioning and evaluation; cost and latency management. We expect AI features in this product and want someone who can propose them, not just implement themCrawling / data extraction — plus: large-scale scraping and API harvesting, headless browsers, anti-bot and rate-limit handling, proxy rotation, schema drift, deduplication and entity matching. Much of our creator data comes from crawling before an official API existsVector search: embeddings, kNN or pgvector, hybrid ranking for natural-language creator searchDesign systems: consuming a component library as a versioned package, design tokens, accessibility basicsKubernetes, Helm, observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured loggingPython for data, scripting or ML toolingOwnership: you take a feature from unclear requirement to running in production, and you notice when it breaks before the client doesStructured thinker: you break ambiguous asks into concrete decisions, write the trade-offs down, and are happy to be argued out of themHealthy scepticism: fast with agents, but never trusting output you have not read. You can tell the difference between code that compiles and code that is correctCollaborative: comfortable working with Product, BI, data and other engineering teams; you ask the business why before you buildPragmatic about scope: you would rather ship a correct slice this sprint than a perfect architecture next quarter

Benefits

In return, you will be getting

We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' — covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory Management, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can matchYou get the chance to work on exciting AI-powered SaaS projects and sophisticated features that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructureOur Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable team of rockstar experts where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. At the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative — you get the best of both worldsTech is a strategic pillar for Intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and you will partner closely with business stakeholders who provide real-world feedback that takes our tech stack to the next level

We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale-up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. Engineers review every step.• Take a data product from spec to deployed jobs and schemas with the platform's agents andCLI, dev before prod• Review, test and correct what the agents generate before it merges, and report gaps in the agent skills• Operate platform runs: watch deployments and agent outputs, triage failures, and keep CI green• Maintance cost within the allocated budget, optimize pipeline and query performance, servicesreliability

Priority given to candidates with• SAP ECC or S/4HANA ingestion experience• Data migration experience: moving tables or pipelines from one platform to another with reconciliation of the result
Nice to have• Databricks specifics: Unity Catalog, Jobs, Azure ADLS Gen2• Open Data Product Specification (ODPS) or Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS)• Infrastructure as code for Databricks: Pulumi, Terraform or Asset Bundles, deployed throughCI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions• Streaming pipelines and online feature serving (a big advantage): building real-time pipelines with Structured Streaming, Auto Loader, Kafka or Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, and serving fresh features to ML models at low latency• Personal-data handling: masking, tagging and access rules

title: Division Principal Game Programmer (Unreal Engine, AI)
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON
What you will focus on
This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team's positioning from "a team that delivers what it is asked to build" to "a technical partners that others actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game's success." That shift requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems, and drive focused R&D including applied AI in game development, while simultaneously ensuring flawless deliveries across multiple live and co-development projects.
 
What it means on a daily basis
Monitor the technical health of multiple projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track. Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams. Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines. Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to programmers, conducting periodic competency assessments and building clear development paths. Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines. Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality. Strategic resource planning and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director. 
 
What success will look like
Within your first year, you will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in alignment with the studio's long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone.
 
Who you would be working with
Report to the Studio Technical Director. Operate accross a programming department of around 35 to 40 people, spanning multiple seniority levels and allocated to live service and co-development projects. Collaborate closely with Department Heads and Team Leads across Game Design, Art, and Production, as well as Studio Directors and the Studio Manager. Work directly with Technical Managers and Technical Directors from co-development partner studios. 
 
Your recruitment journey
Screen Call with a RecruiterFirst Interview with the Studio Technical Director and Division Principal/ManagerSecond Interview with Studio Manager and HR Director Final interview with a Technical Director from a sister studio 
Where this role can take you
If the opportunity arises and the qualifications are in place, this position is a direct pathway to the Studio Technical Director role. That outcome is not guaranteed, but it is a realistic evolution for the right person.
 
 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
Proven hands-on expertise in game development across multiple genres and platforms, including mobile, PC, and console.High proficiency in Unreal Engine 5 and programming languages such as C++ and C#. Demonstrated ability to design and lead large-scale technical systems, covering areas such as 3D rendering, AI gameplay systems, online and network scalability, and cloud infrastructure. A track record of leading R&D initiatives from exploration through to production integration. Demonstrated leadership of multi-disciplinary programming teams, including identifying skill gaps, building development plans, and raising the collective output quality of a department rather than just individual projects. The ability to communicate technical direction clearly to senior leadership, partner studio counterparts, and non-technical collaborators, and to influence decisions at a strategic level while maintaining alignment across stakeholders. Practical experience deploying AI and LLM-based tools in a production context. 
 
WHO YOU ARE
Think in systems and long-term consequences, not just immediate fixes. Proactive technical authority who anticipates what teams and partners will need before they ask. Invested in developing others: raising the technical floor of a department matters as much as personal output. Hold grounds in complex stakeholder environments, with clear, inclusive communication. Hands-on by choice on the most strategic and complex challenges, not only in meetings. Balances technical rigor with product thinking: treats quality, security, and compliance as conditions for sustainable creativity. Steady and focused when priorities shift or organizational context changes. 
 
 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
 
A hybrid working model with 2 days working from home every week. A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally. Various training packages, including internal training, training sponsorship, and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O'Reilly,...). Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourself. An attractive monthly salary alongside Tet and other performance bonuses. Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave,... 100% coverage of mandatory insurance plus private healthcare insurance. A monthly allowance to support lunch meals and working-from-home electricity and Internet bills. Relocation supprt for international candidates joining from overseas. 
 
Life at Gameloft
A collaborative workplace environment, with over 15+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born. An open-space office, a canteen, a billiard table, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table. A gaming room equipped with mutiple devices (PS, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, arcade machine,...). A capable and encouraging team of professionals focused on creating compelling video games. A global company where you can meet great people around the world. A fun place to work in the heart of the city. 
 
HOW TO PROCEED
Ready to level up your career? Apply now and help us create the next great game!
Please note:
To ensure a fair and compliant recruitment process under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), please submit your application through the official job posting, preferably via Gameloft website, Gameloft or Gameloft Vietnam LinkedIn pages, or SmartRecruiters. Applications sent via email or LinkedIn messages will not be considered.
Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates whose profiles most closely match the role needs will be contacted by our recruiters. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and interest.
 
What's more?
Want to know more? Visit our websites:
Saigon Studio websiteLinkedIn pageFacebook page

Check out some projects at Saigon Studio:

Min 2 years of experience in system development, integration engineering, or QA automation. At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.

Daily catered lunch, a variety of snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

title: Senior Data Engineer

description:
Our Company

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Science team within a complex engineering environment.

Working closely with Data Scientists and engineering stakeholders, you will be responsible for translating analytical requirements into scalable, production-ready code using Databricks and modern data technologies. You will support the development of analytics solutions by extracting, transforming, and preparing data, building reusable datasets, and implementing analytical workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on coding, problem solving, and working with large datasets, while contributing to real-world engineering and operational improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Preparation

Build and maintain data pipelines within Databricks. Extract, transform, and validate data from multiple sources. Develop reusable datasets and analytical tables for Data Science projects. Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across analytical workflows. 

Analytics Development

Translate requirements from Data Scientists into efficient and maintainable code. Develop data processing solutions using PySpark, SQL, and Pandas. Support feature engineering activities for machine learning and advanced analytics projects. Investigate data anomalies and support root-cause analysis activities. Optimise data queries and processing logic for performance and scalability. 

Collaboration

Work closely with Data Scientists to support model development and deployment. Collaborate with engineering stakeholders to understand operational data sources and business requirements. Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions. Document datasets, code, and analytical processes. 

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve existing data pipelines and analytical processes. Promote coding standards and best practices. Stay up to date with developments in Databricks, Spark, and modern data platforms. 

Essential Requirements

Experience developing analytical solutions using Databricks. Strong proficiency in PySpark. Strong SQL skills, including writing and optimising complex queries. Experience using Python and Pandas for data analysis and transformation. Familiar with Airflow, KafkaExperience with with Docker, Kubernetes is a plusExperience with other stream processing like Flink is a plusExperience working with large-scale datasets. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Experience working in collaborative Agile teams. 

Desirable Requirements

Experience within engineering, rail, transportation, manufacturing, industrial, or asset-intensive industries. Exposure to machine learning workflows and feature engineering. Experience with Delta Lake and Spark optimisation. Familiarity with Azure Data Platform technologies. Knowledge of Power BI or Grafana. Experience using Git/version control. 

About Us

We're a global, team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can bring a better tomorrow closer to today, this is the place for you.

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

How we look after you

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. Senior AI Exprt - Voice Bot Systems

 Work Location:  Hanoi: TechnoPark Tower, Vinhomes Ocean Park, Hanoi Hochiminh: Vincom Dong Khoi, HCM

Job Overview

We are looking for an AI Expert to join our team as the technical anchor for next-generation real-time voice bot systems. While our Software Engineers focus on integration and infrastructure, this role owns the intelligence layer — designing, training, evaluating, and optimizing the AI models that make voice interactions actually work: from acoustic understanding to natural speech synthesis, speaker identification, and language comprehension in noisy, real-world conditions.

The ideal candidate has built voice AI systems in production — not just integrated APIs, but understood what's happening inside them and made deliberate choices about model architecture, training data, evaluation methodology, and latency trade-offs. You will work directly with Software Engineers to move models from research into production and with product stakeholders to define what "good" means for a voice bot.

Key Responsibilities:

Voice AI Research & Development

Design and develop end-to-end voice pipelines: ASR → NLU → dialogue management → TTS, with full understanding of the trade-offs at each stageResearch, evaluate, and fine-tune models for Vietnamese-language voice tasks: ASR accuracy on domain-specific vocabulary (vehicle names, locations, plate numbers), TTS naturalness, speaker diarization in multi-party callsBuild and maintain evaluation frameworks for voice AI quality: Word Error Rate (WER), Real-Time Factor (RTF), MOS scoring, speaker turn accuracy, end-to-end latency benchmarks

Model Fine-tuning & Training

Fine-tune ASR models (Whisper, Gipformer, wav2vec 2.0) on domain-specific and accent-specific Vietnamese dataFine-tune TTS models (F5-TTS, VoxCPM2, VITS) to produce natural, brand-consistent voice output for CSKH scenariosBuild and curate training datasets: audio collection pipelines, annotation tooling, data quality validationApply speaker diarization and voice activity detection (VAD) to segment and attribute multi-speaker call audio

LLM & NLU Integration

Design prompt strategies and context management for LLM-driven dialogue in voice-specific constraints (no markdown, short sentences, natural prosody cues)Develop intent classification, entity extraction, and slot-filling components tuned for spoken Vietnamese, including noisy transcripts from imperfect ASREvaluate and mitigate hallucination in voice LLM pipelines, including ASR-grounded prompting and transcript correction techniques

Production & Optimization

Optimize inference latency for real-time constraints: quantization, batching, streaming inference, model distillationDesign and run A/B experiments on model variants in production; define statistical evaluation criteria for voice quality metricsCollaborate with Software Engineers on model serving architecture (GPU inference servers, ONNX runtime, TorchServe, Triton)Build monitoring pipelines for model performance drift, ASR degradation, and TTS quality regression in production

Qualifications: 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Linguistics, or a directly related field. PhD is a plus for research-heavy responsibilities

Hands-on Voice AI Experience (required)

3-5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying voice AI systems — not just integrating cloud APIs, but working with the models themselvesDemonstrated experience with at least two of: ASR fine-tuning, TTS model training, speaker diarization, VAD, voice conversion, or acoustic modelingPrior production experience with real-time voice pipelines where latency, reliability, and audio quality were hard constraints

Deep learning & NLP foundations

Solid understanding of sequence modeling (Transformer, CTC, RNN), attention mechanisms, and how they apply to speech and language tasksFamiliarity with acoustic features (MFCCs, mel spectrograms, filterbanks) and audio signal processing fundamentalsExperience with speech-specific deep learning frameworks: ESPnet, SpeechBrain, NeMo, Hugging Face transformers + datasets for audio

Engineering skills

Strong Python; comfortable with PyTorch or TensorFlow for model development and fine-tuningAbility to write production-quality code, not just research scripts: modular, testable, observableExperience with ML experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), model versioning, and reproducibility practicesFamiliarity with Docker and GPU infrastructure for model serving

Evaluation mindset

Knows that a model is only as good as its evaluation — can design rigorous offline and online evaluation protocols for voice AIExperience with human evaluation studies (MOS, MUSHRA, preference tests) and automated proxies

________________________________________

Nice to Have

Experience with multilingual or low-resource language ASR/TTS, especially VietnameseFamiliarity with speaker diarization systems (pyannote, NeMo MSDD) applied to call center audioKnowledge of telephony audio constraints: G.711 µ-law/a-law codecs, 8kHz narrowband limitations, packet loss concealmentExperience with streaming ASR (chunk-based inference, endpointing) for real-time applicationsContributions to open-source speech/NLP projects or published research in voice AI

What This Role Is Not

This is not an API integration role. We need someone who understands what happens inside the model, not just how to call itThis is not a pure research role. Models need to ship into production voice systems with real latency and reliability requirementsThis is not a data annotation role. You will design the data strategy and evaluation criteria — others will execute annotation at scale

What We Offer

Ownership of the AI layer in a production voice system serving real customersDirect collaboration with Software Engineers, DevOps, and product teams — short feedback loops between research and productionAccess to real call audio data for training and evaluation (with appropriate privacy controls)Competitive compensation with equity

deep understanding of JNI, memory management, pointers, ELF and dynamic linking.• Deep knowledge of Android internals (ART/Dalvik, Zygote, bionic libc, system calls, Binder IPC, SELinux) and the app component lifecycle; comfortable reading and working with Java/Kotlin.• Expert static and dynamic analysis of Android apps using IDA Pro, Ghidra, JADX, Frida and ADB.• Solid command of OWASP MASTG/MASVS, and skill in analyzing Logcat, crash dumps and stack traces.• A methodical, self-driven problem-solver who keeps up with new attack and defense techniques, explains technical issues clearly to partners, and reads English technical papers and whitepapers with ease.Nice to have• Hands-on experience designing anti-debugging, anti-hooking, anti-tampering, obfuscation or integrity verification.• iOS internals and security (Mach-O, dyld, Sandbox, Code Signing, AMFI, memory protections) and iOS reverse engineering with LLDB or Frida.• Objective-C (runtime, method swizzling) or Swift.• Published security research, in-depth writeups or CVEs.What we offer• Work directly with Verichains leadership and some of Vietnam's top security experts.• Help take a "Make in Vietnam – Go Global" product to international markets, with partners in Singapore, Thailand, the UAE and beyond.• Competitive salary, 13th-month salary and 14th, 15th+ month bonuses.• 14–16 days of annual leave; social insurance on full salary, health insurance and lunch allowance.• Annual company trip and team building in an open, flexible, globally minded workplace.

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer
description:
Titan Dealer Management Solutions Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer

Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer

About Us

As a global player in the SaaS automotive landscape, Titan Dealer Management Solutions (Titan DMS) boasts over 170 staff globally and SaaS representation across more than 26 markets. Titan is now recognised as one of the leading suppliers of technologically driven industry solutions to automotive dealers and manufacturers around the world.

Since 2009, Titan's flagship product, the Titan Dealer Management System (Titan DMS), has been adopted by Franchised Automotive Dealerships covering over 45 different Automotive Brands throughout Australia, Asia, Pacific Region, Middle East, UK, Africa and Europe, and continues to extend its global reach and reputation as a leading international software provider.

About The Role

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer (Junior level, 1–2 years of experience) to join our Business Intelligence team in Ho Chi Minh City.

Reporting directly to the BI Platform Architect, you will play an essential role in supporting the quality, delivery, and continuous improvement of Titan's Business Intelligence and reporting solutions for our international dealership customers.

In this role, you will start by exploring and thoroughly testing our existing BI solutions and data workflows to ensure accuracy and uncover areas for improvement. You will also actively use modern AI tools to develop and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards requested by customers, while communicating directly in English with international customers to answer reporting questions and gather requirements within your assigned scope.

We believe in structured mentorship and progressive responsibility. You will receive hands-on training and step-by-step guidance from day one, an opportunity to work directly with international clients, and applying cutting edge AI Business Intelligence to our project streams.

Above all technical skills, we value a strong work ethic, integrity, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

What You'll Do

Solution Exploration, Quality Assurance & Data Validation

 Proactively explore and build a solid understanding of Titan's existing BI solutions, reporting systems, and underlying business data flows. Conduct thorough functional testing, data validation, and quality checks across BI solutions and reports after each development stage. Critically examine reports, calculations, and workflows with a keen eye for detail to spot software defects, data discrepancies, edge cases, or anything that appears illogical or inconsistent from a business or user perspective. Document findings clearly and work closely with the BI lead to verify fixes and continuously improve solution reliability and usability.

AI-Assisted Power BI & Reporting Development

 Design, build, and maintain customer-facing Power BI reports and dashboards based on agreed business requirements. Actively leverage modern AI tools to accelerate day-to-day reporting development, including writing and optimising SQL queries, crafting DAX measures, modelling data, and building clean visual layouts. Carefully review, test, and reconcile all AI-generated queries, formulas, and report outputs against source data to ensure accuracy before delivery. Maintain and enhance existing Power BI reports as customer needs evolve.

Customer Communication & Requirements Gathering

 Communicate directly and professionally in English (both written and verbal) with international customers and internal stakeholders within the scope of assigned tasks. Investigate and respond to customer queries regarding their reports, metrics, and underlying data. Participate in customer discussions to gather, clarify, and document reporting requirements, translating business requests into clear technical tasks and report designs.

Continuous Learning & Team Collaboration

 Work closely alongside the BI lead, participating actively in mentorship sessions, reviews, and knowledge sharing to progressively take on greater technical responsibility. Document reporting logic, validation checklists, and operational workflows to keep team documentation clear and up to date.

Required Experience

 1–2 years of professional experience after graduation in software development, information systems, data analysis, BI/reporting, or technical QA/BA. Solid foundational knowledge of relational databases and SQL (ability to read, write, and understand SQL queries to inspect and verify data). Practical capability and enthusiasm for using modern AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to assist with technical problem-solving, query writing, data analysis, and report development. Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate directly with international customers to answer questions and gather requirements within assigned work scope. Strong logical thinking, analytical skills, and a meticulous approach to testing and verifying work.

Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a closely related discipline.

Preferred (Nice To Have — Training Provided)

 Prior hands-on experience working with Data, Data Warehousing, ETL processes, or Microsoft Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, dashboard design) is highly welcomed. Basic familiarity with ERP, DMS, accounting, or business management systems is an advantage.

Note on Training: Candidates who have not yet worked extensively with Data Warehouses or Power BI are still strongly encouraged to apply if they have a solid software or information systems background and a strong drive to learn. Structured on-the-job training and 1-on-1 mentorship will be provided.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT's data platform ingests from more than forty business systems such as CRM, finance, HR, marketing, support, product telemetry, lands the raw output in a Delta lakehouse, refines it through bronze and silver, and publishes marts that downstream consuming applications read. Apache Airflow on AKS orchestrates it, dbt Core models it, and the warehouse is moving from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse to Azure Database for PostgreSQL while all of that stays running.

You own that path end to end, not a link of it: a source nobody has ingested before, carried all the way to a table a business user can open in a dashboard, and everything in between that decides whether the number is right and arrives on time. The extraction that survives pagination, throttling and a schema that changed without telling anyone; the schedule that fires when the data lands rather than when the clock says; the silver table that refuses bad rows instead of passing them downstream; the mart whose columns are documented and whose keys are tested; the semantic-layer definition that makes it usable; and the freshness and the cost of the whole arrangement.

Senior Data Engineering owns the modelling standards and the parity proof that a dbt mart matches the legacy procedure it replaces. You own the path those models sit on; the pipeline that feeds them and the serving layer that consumes them and you build marts to that standard rather than to your own. The seam is real and it is worked together: you bring the source contract, the schedule and the serving behaviour; they bring the layer rules and the value comparison.

You will work in an AI-assisted engineering workflow, where agentic tooling carries the mechanical parts and your judgement stays on the design: what a source's contract is, where a pipeline should fail loudly, and what a dashboard can afford to query.

What you will be doing

Onboard sources end to end: authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental watermarks, landing, bronze, silver with quality gates, warehouse sync as one DAG family per data source, not a bespoke script per table.Own orchestration: DAGs triggered on data arrival, idempotent re-runs, backfills that do not double-count, pod sizing that fits the work, and alerts that page a human only when a human is needed.Build the last mile: the marts and the semantic-layer definitions on top of them, so a metric in Zenlytic or a chart in Superset resolves to a column that means what its name says.Keep the lakehouse healthy: compaction, Z-ordering chosen from real query patterns, vacuum only inside retention, and schema evolution that does not break a consumer.Make performance a measured number: before and after on the pipeline you tuned, capacity spend on the warehouse, caching or pre-aggregation where a dashboard is paying for the same scan every morning.Set and defend freshness and completeness expectations per source; when one breaks, diagnose to root cause and write it down.Run the platform underneath: AKS workloads, Helm or Kustomize, Terraform, image builds and CI/CD, Key Vault and managed identity, least-privilege access to every store you touch.Review pull requests on pipelines and models, and keep runbooks and standards current enough that the next engineer does not need to ask you.Work with the Analytics Engineers and Product Analysts who own the business definitions your marts serve, so a definition change and a pipeline change land in the right order.


What we need from you

5+ years in data engineering, with production ownership of pipelines other people depended on.Expert Python and SQL: you can read a query plan and say why it is slow.A dataframe engine at volume: Polars, duckDB, Spark and the judgement to know when not to pull the data into memory at all.Airflow in production (or Dagster/Prefect and the willingness to move); you have debugged a scheduler, not only written DAGs.Containers and Kubernetes: an image, a pod spec, a resource limit, and what happens when the limit is wrong.Lakehouse table formats: Delta or Iceberg with partitioning, compaction and schema evolution treated as operational concerns, not theory.Dimensional modelling judgement and hands-on dbt: you can state a grain, choose a key, and place logic in the right layer.One cloud in depth: Azure, AWS or GCP including storage, identity, secrets, and the networking that makes a private endpoint actually work.Infrastructure as code: Terraform, and Helm or Kustomize. You have shipped a change through a pipeline rather than by hand.Observability habits: metrics, logs, alerts, and an on-call triage you can describe step by step.API integration craft, pagination, throttling, retry with backoff, incremental state and the difference between a source that is down and a source that changed shape.Working fluency with a BI or semantic layer, enough to know why a model that is correct in SQL can still be unusable in a dashboard.Clear writing. The incident report and the runbook are part of the job, not paperwork around it.


It would be great if you also have

Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server including Citus / Elastic Cluster in your background.dbt at scale: Elementary, exposures, column-level lineage, CI-enforced builds.Cost engineering: capacity units, warehouse sizing, and a saving you can attribute to a change you made.A platform migration you helped carry warehouse engine, orchestrator, or both.Superset, Zenlytic, Power BI, or another tool where you owned the semantic model rather than only the chart.CDC or streaming: Fabric mirroring, Debezium, event-driven ingestion.Standards or tooling you authored that other engineers actually follow.

ABOUT YOUR ROLE:

The Senior Developer, Material Portfolio, Trims is responsible for creating and maintaining scalable trim platforms that support VF brands and product categories. Reporting to the Manager, Material Portfolio, Trims, this role translates brand and product needs into consolidated, reusable, and technically validated trim solutions. The role analyzes trim usage, identifies opportunities to reduce duplication and complexity, and develops core platforms that improve adoption, speed, consistency, cost efficiency, sustainability, and supply resilience across brands.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:

Trim Platform Creation & Development

Create and develop scalable trim platforms across key categories such as zippers, buttons, snaps, labels, tapes, elastics, cords, hardware, and packaging-related trims. Translate common brand and product requirements into core trim constructions, specifications, color or finish options, and application guidelines that can be adopted across multiple products and brands. Develop platform solutions that balance brand relevance with repeatability, technical performance, cost efficiency, sustainability, speed, and supply resilience. Maintain a clear pipeline of new platforms and platform enhancements based on portfolio gaps, product needs, market trends, supplier capability, and innovation opportunities. 

Portfolio Analysis, Consolidation & Lifecycle Management

Analyze trim usage, specifications, suppliers, cost, performance, and adoption data to identify duplicate, fragmented, low-usage, or overlapping materials. Recommend and execute consolidation opportunities by aligning similar trim requests to existing core materials or by creating common platforms that serve broader business needs. Support lifecycle management of core and seasonal trims, including adoption, performance review, rationalization, replacement, and phase-out. 

Platform Validation & Readiness

Validate platform constructions, finishes, compatibility, durability, appearance, and end-use performance across intended product applications. Coordinate sampling, testing, risk assessment, trial adoption, and corrective actions with Product Development, Quality, Sustainability, suppliers, and brand material teams. Ensure approved platforms have complete specifications, testing records, application guidance, supplier information, and digital assets for reliable adoption and commercialization. 

Cross-Brand Adoption & Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with brand material teams, Design, Product Development, Material Sourcing, Quality, and Sustainability to identify shared needs and embed platform solutions into seasonal development. Present platform options, consolidation recommendations, technical trade-offs, and business benefits clearly to support timely material decisions. Work with suppliers and internal partners to resolve technical barriers and improve the usability, relevance, and adoption of core trim platforms. 

Digital Portfolio, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

Maintain accurate trim metadata, specifications, images, supplier details, lifecycle status, and platform relationships in PLM and material library systems. Track platform adoption, trim proliferation, material utilization, consolidation progress, and portfolio gaps to support data-driven decisions. Continuously improve platform-development and portfolio-review processes to reduce redundant requests, increase core-material adoption, and simplify the overall trims portfolio. 

WHAT WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR IN YOU:

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of trim categories, constructions, finishes, manufacturing processes, performance characteristics, and product applications. Demonstrated capability in creating scalable material platforms, comparing specifications, identifying commonality, and converting multiple requirements into consolidated solutions. Working knowledge of material testing, quality, sustainability, compliance, costing, supplier capability, and lifecycle management. 

Leadership & Collaboration

Proven ability to lead and develop small teams. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to build trusted relationships across teams and suppliers. 

Analytical & Strategic Thinking

Strong analytical capability to interpret material usage, specifications, adoption, supplier, cost, and performance data and turn findings into portfolio actions. Ability to manage multiple platform-development and consolidation projects, align stakeholders, and deliver against seasonal and longer-range priorities. Experience with PLM, ERP, or material library systems is a plus.

title: AI Native Software Engineer - Secure File Gateway
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

About The Product

Secure File Gateway is a gateway that sits between a WAF and the web app backend. It ensures every uploaded file is scanned and sanitized by MetaDefender Core (via ICAP) before reaching the application; no WAF config changes needed. This solves the gap left by WAFs that don't support ICAP, or can't handle CDR-sanitized data.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and test SFG in C++ or Rust (Windows/Linux) as the transparent proxy between WAF and backend.Implement the core flow: intercept uploads → forward to MetaDefender Core over ICAP → return sanitized files, with low latency and high reliability.Build multi-threaded, high-concurrency networking components.Build and use agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Code, autonomous coding agents) daily for coding, testing, and debugging.Work within a Scrum team; collaborate with Product Management; do peer code reviews.


What We Need

Strong OOP background (Java/C#), willing to learn/work in C++ or Rust.Solid multi-threading and network programming skills.Comfort with protocol/network-level concepts (TCP/IP, HTTP, proxying).Genuine interest in using AI tools in your dev workflow.Experience building or using multi-agentsGood coding/debugging skills, strong communication, self-motivated.


Nice to Have

ICAP protocol, reverse proxy / gateway experience.REST API design.Agile/Scrum, Git/Bitbucket/Jira/Confluence/TeamCity.DBMS (SQLite, PostgreSQL, etc.).Windows/Linux dev experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python -  Customer Data Platform) - DC31
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
YOUR NEW ROLE 

This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software

JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate.

Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next.

A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement.

You build the services that make the platform trustworthy: how data gets in, who may run what, and how products get their answers, for exactly one merchant and never for another. You own these services end to end, from infrastructure and pipeline to code, tests and production behavior. Security is not a feature here; it is the product. We hire at Mid-Level or Senior and set the level with you, based on your experience.

The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window.

YOUR EXCITING TASKS

Design, build and run backend services and container jobs in Python on Azure, including their Terraform and CI/CD. Make tenant isolation provable: short-lived credentials, least-privilege identities, row-level security and the automated tests that keep them honest. Integrate identity (OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID) so every person, service and run acts under its own identity. Instrument what you build so that when something breaks, we learn which merchant, which step and why. Write short specs and decision records before building; ship through small, reviewed pull requests.Design and run agent workflows: decompose work for Claude Code and Codex, orchestrate parallel agents, let them triage issues and draft fixes, and review what comes back with a critical eye. 

YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY

6+ years (Senior) building production software, with strong Python. Hands-on experience running services on Azure or a comparable cloud, and with Terraform and CI/CD. A solid grasp of authentication and authorisation (OAuth2 / OIDC, tokens, RBAC) and secure-by default design. Good SQL and PostgreSQL; you know what roles, permissions and row-level security are for.Tests are part of done for you, and you would rather raise a loud alarm than ship a quiet mistake.Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex, beyond autocomplete: you have built agent workflows, orchestrated agents on real tasks and know where they fail. Clear written and spoken English.

Nice To Have

Multi-tenant SaaS platforms and tenant isolation in storage, compute or database layers.Dagster, DuckDB, dbt or data pipelines in general. Azure Container Apps, Azure Front Door / WAF, Zitadel or Keycloak. Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills and hooks, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted SRE. E-commerce or ERP background.

Benefits Await You At Code Leap

Competitive salary and beneﬁtsYear-end bonus (13th-month salary)Generous annual leave of up to 18 daysAdditional premium health insuranceEnjoy an endless selection of delicious refreshments, including gourmet coffee, beverages, snacks, and fresh fruits, all complimentaryDynamic, fun, and agile environment, perfect for sharing and creativityOpen-minded, kind & humble colleagues

CONTACT

Come to talk to us at jobs@codeleap.de

About Us

With our expert teams spread across two continents, CODE LEAP provides innovative software solutions for venture-backed companies and leading enterprise businesses in Germany. Our teams in Berlin (Germany) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) work hand in hand to develop state-of-the-art solutions of the highest quality.

Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth.

We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer

description:

AI has moved past being a coding aid, it's reshaping how software actually gets built, from spec to delivery, and we're moving with it rather than waiting for the dust to settle: agentic workflows, new tooling, new ideas about what a software factory even looks like. Your Impact:
As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build and run production AI/ML systems, from classic ML models to LLM and agent-based applications, that improve the user experience and business results. You will lead technical work on large AI systems, set a high bar for AI-native engineering practice, mentor engineers and work with stakeholders to define and deliver AI initiatives.

title: AI Engineer
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

My OPSWAT Portal is OPSWAT's one stop hub for customers and partners. We provide a central place to manage licenses, access support, download products, track training, and navigate OPSWAT cloud services securely. It brings essential tools together in one place so customers and partners can get started quickly and stay productive.

This role is for an engineer who would rather own the model than rely on someone else: you build and integrate AI/LLM features into our platform based on product and business requirements. 

You will be responsible for continuously improving the AI’s accuracy, latency, cost efficiency, security, and reliability. 

What You Will Be Doing: 

Develop and integrate RAG, AI agents, recommendation/search systems, and AI-powered automation workflows. Build and maintain data ingestion, embedding, retrieval, and evaluation pipelines. Collaborate with the Engineering Team (Developers & QA) to design, build, test, and deliver AI features. Collaborate with the DevOps Team to deploy, monitor, and optimize our self-hosted LLMs. Build and maintain evaluation gates for every LLM change and make it something the team trusts more than its own intuition. 


What We Need from You: 

At least 3+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering. Strong Python, including building data pipelines for training datasets. Good understanding of Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, Tool Calling, AI Agents, and LLM Evaluation. Experience with Rest APIs, SQL/No-SQL databases, Docker, Git, and CI/CD. Ability to debug, evaluate, and validate AI systems in real-world production environments. Experience with LLM serving, APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, …), inference (e.g. vLLM, Ollama), including quantization and the memory / latency / quality trade-off on constrained hardware. Familiarity with tool-calling / agent-based LLM applications. Ability to design and run model evaluations for non-deterministic systems: you can name a metric you designed and the number you moved. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English: the language of the team, the docs, and the prompts. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable owning a track in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 


It Would Be Nice If You Had: 

Experience fine-tuning open-weight LLMs Experience with agent frameworks Awareness of LLM security risks: prompt injection, data leakage, misuse. Compact models deployed on-premises, offline, or resource-constrained environments. Evaluation tooling for LLM systems: LLM-as-judge, regression suites, human review loops. Cybersecurity concepts, or experience building components of a security product

description:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

What We Need

We are looking for a Simulation Engineer to join our Simulation Team within our Software Engineering organization. Your job will be to design, develop, optimize, and scale simulation systems that support the design, validation, testing, and deployment of large-scale robotic warehouse automation solutions. You will work closely with robotics, controls, perception, cloud, and product teams to build simulation capabilities that accelerate engineering innovation and improve system performance.

What We Do

The Simulation Team is part of the Software Engineering organization, which is responsible for building the software platforms and technologies that power Symbotic's warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops simulation systems, digital twin platforms, cloud applications, and visualization tools that help engineers, operators, and stakeholders better understand, validate, and optimize robotic automation workflows.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain simulation systems, tools, and virtual environments that support the development, testing, qualification, and deployment of robotic warehouse automation systems. Develop faster-than-real-time, scalable, and optimized simulation environments to support engineering analysis, design validation, system testing, and operational planning. Build and improve simulation capabilities across multiple levels of fidelity, including component-level, robot-level, fleet-level, and system-level simulation. Evaluate existing simulation tools, identify performance, scalability, accuracy, and usability gaps, and drive improvements that enable faster and more cost-effective engineering workflows. Support simulation coverage for individual robots, perception, controls, routing, fleet coordination, warehouse operations, and system-wide automation scenarios. Collaborate with robotics, controls, perception, cloud, QA, and product teams to align simulation capabilities with product development, testing, deployment, and operational needs. Provide senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with clear technical insights, trade-off analysis, risks, and recommendations to support long-term simulation and robotics roadmaps. Mentor other engineers, share technical knowledge, promote engineering best practices, and help the team deliver innovative and scalable simulation solutions. Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, simulation design notes, configuration guides, and operational usage instructions. Stay up to date with modern simulation technologies, robotics frameworks, digital twin platforms, physics engines, rendering engines, cloud-based simulation, and AI-assisted development tools. Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer. 

What You’ll Need

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline. 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably with experience in simulation systems, robotics systems, optimization systems, or virtual environments. Core Requirements{{:}} Primary Stack{{:}} Professional Gz-Sim & ROS2 expertise Languages{{:}} Mastery of C++ and Python. (Bonus point for C# and JS) Strong software engineering foundation, with the ability to design, implement, test, optimize, and maintain complex simulation software. Hands-on experience developing simulations, digital twins, virtual environments, or system modeling tools for real-world engineering applications. Plus{{:}} Experienced with faster-than-real-time and multi-fidelity modeling in simulation. Plus{{:}} Experience with cloud-based simulation, distributed simulation workloads, or scalable simulation infrastructure. Plus{{:}} Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools. Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills. Working proficiency in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders. 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. BUSINESS UNIT

The Search & Book unit at HRS plays a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions through HRS Connect, the company's flagship product within the expansive global corporate travel management market. HRS Connect specifically targets the rapidly growing and significantly underserved segments of corporate lodging, meetings, groups, and long stays. The unit develops, enhances, and maintains complex technology solutions that seamlessly integrate hotel distribution systems, Property Management Systems (PMS), Online Travel Agencies (OTA), and Hotel Chain systems into the HRS Connect platform. Leveraging robust connectivity, innovative technology, and data-driven insights, the unit ensures seamless connectivity, optimized travel spend, enhanced traveler experiences, and high-performance booking solutions for global enterprise customers.

POSITION

A Senior Fullstack Engineer (AI-Native) builds production-grade applications and intelligent workflows with an AI-first mindset across the full software development lifecycle. This role is for an engineer who does not treat AI as an add-on, but as a core way of working across design, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and delivery.The ideal candidate consistently approaches work by asking whether a task can be completed entirely with AI or materially improved through AI-assisted execution, while still applying strong engineering judgment and quality controls.

Review and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, and production readiness.Technical Leadership: Drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and champion AI-native engineering practices across the team.

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH...
