Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development workflows for scaffolding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery while critically reviewing outputs and maintaining engineering standards.AI-first mindset. Approaches every task by asking whether it can be completed entirely with AI or improved significantly through AI, then applies the right level of human review, validation, and control.Excellent communication skills and fluency in English to collaborate effectively in an international environment.

PERSPECTIVE

Access to a global network of a globally united and mutually responsible “Tribe of Intrapreneurs” that is passionately dedicated to renew the travel industry and while doing so reinvent the ways how businesses stay, work and pay.

Our entrepreneurial driven environment of full ownership and execution focus offers you the playground to contribute to a greater mission, while growing personally and professionally throughout this unique journey. You will continuously learn from a radical culture of retrospectives and continuous improvement and actively contribute to making business life better, smarter and more sustainable.

description: About Gene SolutionsGene Solutions is a pioneering genetic testing company, with teams around the world, dedicated to making next-generation genetic testing accessible. set and meet service levels for availability and turnaround time.Build in clinical-grade quality — every result reproducible and traceable to the exact pipeline, model, reference data and software version that produced it; plan infrastructure, storage and security with IT; resolve competing priorities through clear proposals and data; and explain technical risks and trade-offs to management.Integrate with international partners — work with partner teams around the world to integrate our solutions with their platforms: agree interfaces and data exchange, deploy into partner environments, and troubleshoot jointly across organizations.What We're Looking ForSubstantial experience building and running production software systems — typically eight or more years — including several years as the technical lead of a team while staying hands-on.A proven track record as an architect of systems that handle heavy and growing load in production.Excellent people skills — delivering through teams you do not manage: negotiating priorities, resolving disagreements and building trust.Clear communication in fluent English, in writing and in person, with executives, scientists, engineers and international partners alike.Strategic thinking and sound judgement — seeing where the system must go and getting there in safe steps, in a setting where results inform patient care.A degree in computer science, software engineering, bioinformatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.Core Technical SkillsHands-on experience with workflow orchestration and with Slurm and/or cloud infrastructure is required. title: Analytics Engineer
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT's data platform turns business-system data into governed, documented, tested tables that business teams can read without asking what a column means. It is built on dbt Core, layered source → staging → intermediate → mart, and the warehouse is moving from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. You will learn the craft on the real thing: models that ship, with value parity proven before anything is cut over.

This is the entry point to analytics engineering on this team, and it is a working role rather than an observation one. You will build models for the domains assigned to you and they will go into production. What differs from a more senior role is the supervision, not the bar: every change is reviewed before it lands, you have a named mentor, and you are paired with a Product Analyst on the business side: the two halves answer for the same number.

By day 60 you are expected to be delivering a model with less correction than your first one, not to still be waiting for instructions.

What You Will Be Doing

Build staging, intermediate and mart dbt models for the domains assigned to you, following the team's layer standards: what belongs in each layer, where collation is normalised, one path in per source.Write tests that fail when the data breaks, not checks that pass whatever the data does.Run parity comparisons between a dbt model and the legacy procedure it replaces: execute the comparison, record the numbers, and learn what "proven" means before a consumer is repointed.Investigate the quality failures your tests surface, and trace them back to the source instead of patching the symptom in the model.Keep documentation and lineage current as models change, so the next reader does not have to ask what a column means.Work across both engines while the warehouse migrates, and notice when the same model behaves differently on each.Work in an AI-assisted engineering workflow. You set the task, review the output, and own what lands.Pair with a Product Analyst to learn what the business needs from a number, and why a definition is worth arguing about.Ask for review early, and act on it.


What we need from you

0–2 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a comparable role or a portfolio that shows the same work.Working SQL: joins, filters, aggregations, CTEs. Window functions are the next thing you learn, and you are already reading about them.Some Python for data work. A script you wrote, a notebook you finished, a pipeline you broke and then fixed.Git and pull-request basics, or the willingness to learn them in the first week.The habit of checking your own numbers before sharing them: reconciliation, sanity checks, and saying so when something does not add up.Curiosity about how the business actually works. You want to know why the data looks the way it does.Willingness to ask for help early. On this team that is the norm, not a weakness.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have

Exposure to dbt, or another transformation framework, from coursework or a project.A BI tool you have built in: Superset, Power BI, Looker, or similar.A data project you can talk about for ten minutes: what it was for, what you got wrong, and what you changed.Comfort in a terminal: Docker, a CLI, a cloud console.Azure basics: storage, identity, or a service you have actually used


What success looks like in your first 60 days

Your first models are merged, reviewed, and pass the layer-standards check. You learned the rules by applying them.A test you wrote catches something real, or would fail if the model broke.You have run a parity comparison end to end and can explain what "proven" means without reading the definition back.You can explain your domain's data in business terms, and why the definition matters.Your reviewer's comments are getting fewer and smaller: the next model needs less correction than the first.

title: RTL System Integration Engineer
description:
About FaradayFaraday Technology Corporation is a leading fabless ASIC and IP provider with over 30 years of global semiconductor experience. Headquartered in Taiwan, Faraday delivers thousands of successful SoC and ASIC designs annually and supports customers worldwide across automotive, AI, networking, consumer electronics, and IoT.

title: DevOps Engineer (Middle - Senior)
description:
About the roleBuild like a founder. Ship like Spartan.Our clients are startups in a race: an MVP in 30 days, real traffic the day after launch. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to keep them fast, up, and cheap to run.We don’t act like vendors. We embed. Our teams sit inside startups backed by YC, Pear VC, BlingCap, a16z, and Techstars, working beside founders and engineers from Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, and Uber. Together we ship those MVPs and scale the systems behind them to millions of users and billions of requests.This isn’t a back-office ops seat three layers from the client. You’ll be in the founder’s Slack. Your infrastructure runs their launch. When their product survives its first traffic spike, that’s your work holding it up.70% of our portfolio is LLM-powered. That means real GPU workloads, real traffic spikes, and real cloud bills. You’ll design the infrastructure behind it. Cursor, Claude, and Codex are default tools here, and you’ll use them to automate the boring parts.
Who Thrives at SpartanNot every environment fits everyone, so here’s an honest picture of the teammate we’re looking for.You’ll thrive here if:You do whatever it takes to win. Terraform today, debugging someone’s Node service tomorrow.You own an incident until it’s resolved, whether it started in your area or not.You treat cost like a feature. You can tell a founder why their bill dropped 40%.You automate the boring parts without being asked.Some weeks will stretch you. That’s the job. But you’ll never carry it alone. A critical incident or a high-stakes migration? You won’t be the only one on it. We push each other hard because we care how far each of us can go. We win together. We lose together. Nobody gets left behind.One last thing. We’re not filling seats. We’re looking for teammates for the battles ahead. If you read all this and something in you said yes, trust that feeling and apply. We respect people who back themselves. Every Spartan here started with that same yes.
What You’ll DoDesign and run multi-cluster, multi-cloud Kubernetes environments across AWS EKS, GCP GKE, and Azure AKS: highly available, disaster-resilient, auto-scaling.Build GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD or FluxCD.Tune performance, reliability, and cost. Every dollar saved is margin for the startup we serve.Run AI infrastructure: GPU workloads, model serving, vector databases, and the inference bills that come with them.Automate ops with AI: runbooks, incident summaries, IaC generation with Cursor and Claude.Secure workloads: RBAC, Network Policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, vulnerability scanning.Work with dev teams on containerization and app modernization.Mentor engineers on Kubernetes and infrastructure practices.Turn what you build into reusable accelerators: CI/CD templates, starter kits, monitoring setups that cut project startup time across clients.
Whom We’re Looking ForFluent English. You’ll talk directly with US startup founders.At least 3-6 years in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure, with Kubernetes in production.Strong Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible.Deep knowledge of Docker/OCI runtimes, Linux, networking, and troubleshooting.Hands-on with monitoring stacks: DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger.Solid grasp of Kubernetes internals.You use AI tools like a pro: you review what they write, catch their mistakes, and know when not to use them.A builder’s mindset. You don’t just run infra, you solve problems like an owner.
Nice to HaveYou’ve run LLM serving in production: vLLM, GPU scheduling, or managed inference endpoints.Backend engineering experience.CKA, CKAD, or CKS certifications.Service mesh: Istio, Linkerd, Consul.Open-source contributions to Kubernetes or CNCF projects.Cloud cost optimization wins you can put numbers on.
Tech We UseEvery project brings a different stack, so in a year here you’ll touch more of this list than most engineers do in five. Two rules hold everywhere: everything as code, no click-ops. And what we adopt is decided by our engineers through an internal Tech Radar, not handed down from a slide deck.Platform: Kubernetes (EKS · GKE · AKS) · DockerIaC & GitOps: Terraform · Helm · Ansible · ArgoCD · FluxCDCI/CD: GitHub Actions · JenkinsObservability: OpenTelemetry · Prometheus · Grafana · DataDog · ELK · JaegerAI infra: vLLM · GPU workloads · pgvector · QdrantCloud & edge: AWS · GCP · Azure · CloudflareAI tooling: Cursor · Claude · Codex
Career GrowthWork directly with founders from YC, Stanford, MIT, Yale, Google, Amazon, Uber, and more.Exposure to AI infrastructure: LLM serving, vector databases, GPU workloads.Transparent career path and mentorship from engineers who’ve taken 3 companies to IPO.Every project feels like its own mini-startup.
Why Spartan50+ MVPs launched, 3 IPOs, $100M+ raised by the startups we build with.95% engineer retention. People stay because the work is worth staying for.You build zero to one. Empty cloud account to production infrastructure in weeks. Most engineers get that chance once in a career. Here it’s the job.Your work is visible. The infrastructure you build this month carries a founder’s launch next month.No layers, no bureaucracy. You talk to the decision-maker directly, and decisions land in hours, not weeks.Every project is a new cloud, a new stack, a new problem. One year here teaches what three years elsewhere would.You’ll never just take tickets. You’ll own problems, ship fast, and grow with the founders we partner with.
Benefits & Perks💰 Competitive salary, 100% salary during probation🏝 Unlimited PTO + public holidays🩺 Premium healthcare insurance + annual health check⚽ Sports clubs for every taste: football, badminton, billiards, pickleball🎮 PS5 and Nintendo at the office🏠 Hybrid working style, flexible hours✈️ Company trip + monthly birthday parties💻 MacBook provided📜 Social insurance per Labor Law

Alternate Job Titles

Applications Engineer, EDA ToolsCustomer Support Engineer, Physical DesignTechnical Applications Engineer, ASIC ImplementationField Applications Engineer, Design ImplementationSolutions Engineer, Physical Design Flow

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. You Are

You are an early-career engineer who is curious about how digital chips are implemented and eager to build hands-on expertise in ASIC physical design. You have a foundation in digital design and are interested in learning what happens from floorplanning through tapeout. You are comfortable reading basic Verilog, working in a Linux environment, and using or learning Tcl, Python, or Shell scripting to improve engineering productivity.

You communicate clearly in English, across time zones and teams. You are the kind of person who can explain technical issues to an engineer in cross-functionally and cross-regionally. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers using tools that shape how chips get built, and the problems you solve will matter.

What You'll Be Doing

Provide hands-on technical support for customers using Synopsys Design Implementation and Verification tools, including troubleshooting issues in physical design flows like floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and timing closureTake ownership of customer technical cases from initial investigation through resolution, debugging tool behavior, analyzing design data, and working with customers to deploy solutionsCollaborate with R&D engineering teams across regions to escalate complex issues, communicate customer requirements, and validate fixes or new features before deploymentBuild and maintain strong relationships with customers by proactively following up on open issues, understanding their design challenges, and ensuring they get the most out of Synopsys toolsWork with Synopsys Fusion Compiler, ICC2, and related signoff tools to help customers optimize their implementation methodologies and improve design outcomesCreate and refine technical documentation, application notes, and best practices based on real customer engagements and lessons learned in the field

Directly unblock customer design teams so they can meet tapeout schedules and deliver working silicon on timeReduce the time it takes for customers to adopt new Synopsys tools and features by providing clear guidance and proven methodologiesSurface real-world customer pain points to R&D teams, influencing product roadmaps and making tools better for the entire user baseBuild trust and long-term partnerships with customers in the region, expanding Synopsys's technical footprint and customer satisfaction scoresHelp customers achieve better PPA (power, performance, area) outcomes by optimizing their use of physical design and verification flowsContribute to a global knowledge base that helps Application Engineers worldwide solve problems faster and more effectivelyStrengthen Synopsys's reputation as a company that does not just sell tools but stands behind them with world-class technical support

What You'll Need

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical fieldUnderstanding of ASIC physical design and implementation methodologies, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and static timing analysisWorking knowledge of Verilog and digital design fundamentalsComfort with Linux or Unix environments and scripting in Tcl, Python, Perl, or ShellStrong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teamsExposure to Synopsys Fusion Compiler, ICC2, or related signoff tools is a strong plusApplication Engineering experience supporting implementation flows or customer-facing technical roles is a plus

Who You Are

You can take a vague customer complaint like "the tool is slow" and turn it into a specific diagnosis with a clear next stepYou are comfortable saying "I do not know yet, but I will find out" and then actually following through until you have an answerYou do not wait for someone to tell you to follow up with a customer, you just do it because you want to know if the fix actually workedYou are genuinely interested in trying new tools, new features, and AI-assisted workflows, not because you have to but because you want to see what is possibleYou can work across time zones and teams without losing track of who needs what and when, and you keep stakeholders informed without being asked

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Applications Engineering team in Ho Chi Minh, focused on providing technical support for EDA Design Implementation and Verification solutions. The team works directly with customers across the region to address technical issues, optimize design methodologies, and drive successful adoption of Synopsys tools. You will collaborate closely with Application Engineers worldwide and R&D teams to solve complex customer challenges, escalate critical issues, and ensure continuous improvement of Synopsys solutions. This is a team that values customer success, technical depth, and proactive problem-solving.

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Associate DevOps Engineer
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. As an Associate DevOps Engineer, you’ll help keep this platform fast, secure and always available, working alongside senior engineers on the infrastructure that handles large volumes of untrusted files every day. Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you!

title: Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Về chúng tôi

Majorbird là Đối tác Bạc của Odoo (từ năm 2020), được sáng lập bởi một đội ngũ Trung – Pháp và đặt trụ sở chính tại Nam Sơn, Thâm Quyến. Chúng tôi là một đội ngũ quốc tế gồm 17 người, có văn phòng tại Hồng Kông, Trung Quốc, Việt Nam và Mexico. Chúng tôi đã triển khai hơn 100 dự án ERP và chuyên về những dự án đa công ty, đa tiền tệ và xuyên biên giới phức tạp mà phần lớn đối tác né tránh — trải dài khắp Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, Trung Đông và Mỹ Latinh.

Chúng tôi thiên về kỹ thuật, tư duy sản phẩm và luôn đi đầu: tham gia sâu vào các công nghệ tiên tiến và thực sự hiểu cách doanh nghiệp vận hành. Chúng tôi hay nói rằng ERP là trường kinh doanh tốt nhất của thời hiện đại — ở đây bạn thấy các công ty thật vận hành ra sao (tài chính, chuỗi cung ứng, sản xuất, bán hàng) và học cách làm cho chúng tốt hơn.

Vị trí — Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam

Bạn xây dựng và tùy biến Odoo trên các dự án khách hàng thực tế với mức độ tự chủ ngày càng cao — phát triển module, tích hợp và báo cáo, đồng thời làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối.

Công việc của bạn

Phát triển và tùy biến các module, tích hợp và báo cáo trên Odoo.Làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối — từ phân tích cùng tư vấn viên đến bàn giao.Viết code sạch, có kiểm thử và tuân thủ quy chuẩn kỹ thuật của chúng tôi.Sửa lỗi, cải thiện các tính năng hiện có và góp phần giữ chất lượng cao.

Yêu cầu bắt buộc

1–3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm với Python và kinh nghiệm thực tế với Odoo.Có khả năng hoàn thành tính năng với mức giám sát hạn chế.Tò mò về logic nghiệp vụ phía sau dòng code.Tiếng Anh viết là bắt buộc.Vị trí này không yêu cầu tiếng Anh giao tiếp.

Điểm cộng

PostgreSQL, JavaScript / OWL, Git, Linux hoặc Docker.Bằng Khoa học máy tính / Kỹ thuật hoặc các dự án cá nhân nổi bật.Đã từng tham gia các dự án Odoo đa công ty / đa tiền tệ.

Mức lương

Mức lương: 15.000.000–25.000.000 VND/tháng, tùy theo kinh nghiệm.

Điều tuyệt vời ở vị trí này

Nhìn dự án từ đầu đến cuối và làm chủ tác động thật — không phải một mảnh nhỏ trong cỗ máy khổng lồ.Làm việc trên các hệ thống đa công ty / đa tiền tệ thực sự phức tạp, không phải những cấu hình rập khuôn.Phát triển nhanh nhờ được dẫn dắt bởi người giàu kinh nghiệm, với lộ trình rõ ràng.Gia nhập một đội ngũ quốc tế thiên về kỹ thuật, công bằng và gắn bó dài hạn.

Quyền lợi

Thưởng dự án — trích theo quý dựa trên dòng tiền thu về của các dự án bạn tham gia triển khai.Tài trợ chứng chỉ Odoo — hoàn trả toàn bộ lệ phí thi — cùng đào tạo thường xuyên.Phép năm: 5 ngày sau năm làm việc đầu tiên, +1 ngày mỗi năm, tối đa 15 ngày.Thêm 1 ngày nghỉ có lương dịp Giáng sinh (nét văn hóa của đội ngũ Trung – Pháp).Bảo hiểm xã hội theo luật (BHXH / BHYT / BHTN) và các phúc lợi địa phương.Hoạt động team-building hằng quý, hộp quà ngày lễ và quà sinh nhật.Trang thiết bị làm việc do công ty cung cấp.Làm việc tại văn phòng ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh, với 1 ngày làm việc từ xa mỗi tuần.

Cách chúng tôi làm việc

Chúng tôi tôn trọng con người của mình, vì vậy họ tôn trọng công ty. Chúng tôi công bằng và xây dựng cho dài hạn.Chúng tôi không phải một "body shop" — mà là một đối tác tư duy sản phẩm, xem Odoo như một hệ thống sống, minh bạch tuyệt đối và không có toan tính ẩn giấu.Bạn gia nhập một đội ngũ nhỏ, giàu kinh nghiệm, quốc tế — nơi công việc của bạn được nhìn thấy và sự phát triển của bạn là thật.

Cách ứng tuyển

Nhấn Apply Now (Ứng tuyển ngay) trên trang này và giới thiệu đôi nét về bản thân. Chúng tôi xem xét mọi hồ sơ và sẽ phản hồi bạn.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT is committed to harnessing the power of AI to drive meaningful advancements across all areas of our business. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer to lead the deployment and optimization of Large Language Models for efficient, high performance inference on GPU hardware.

In this role, you will own the infrastructure layer that turns our AI models into fast, cost effective, production grade services. You will work closely with the AI/ML Team, the Enterprise & Data Team, and Infrastructure to design local LLM serving environments, maximize GPU utilization, and apply model compression techniques such as quantization from FP32 down to FP8/FP4. This is a chance to work at the deep intersection of models, serving software, and hardware within a global cybersecurity company, delivering the performance that powers OPSWAT's AI products at scale.

What You Will Do

Local LLM Deployment & Hardware Setup: Design and build local LLM serving environments on GPU hardware, selecting GPU configurations based on VRAM, memory bandwidth, and workload. Install and maintain the full inference stack (NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, cuDNN, inference engines) across single and multi GPU deployments, including tensor and pipeline parallelism.Inference Optimization & Model Compression: Optimize LLM models for efficient GPU serving, balancing latency, throughput, memory, and cost. Apply quantization from FP32 to FP16/BF16, FP8, and FP4 using PTQ methods (GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant) and QAT. Design mixed precision strategies and run calibration to minimize quality loss. Apply complementary techniques including pruning, distillation, and sparsity.Serving Engine & Performance Engineering: Deploy and tune high throughput serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI), optimizing KV cache (PagedAttention), continuous batching, and speculative decoding. Leverage optimized kernels (FlashAttention) and FP8 tensor cores. Build benchmarking for TTFT, inter token latency, throughput, GPU utilization, and cost per million tokens.Production Serving Infrastructure: Deploy quantized models with autoscaling, load balancing, and observability. Establish quality regression gates and run A/B tests of quantized vs full precision models on real traffic.Research & Propose Innovative Solutions: exploring and implementing novel inference optimization and model compression techniques.


What We Need From You

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on ML infrastructure, LLM inference, or model optimization.Hands on experience deploying and serving LLMs on GPU hardware in production.Strong understanding of quantization and model compression (FP8/FP4/INT8/INT4, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, QAT).Experience with high throughput inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, llama.cpp).Solid understanding of GPU architecture, CUDA, and the memory bandwidth bound nature of LLM inference.Familiarity with KV cache, continuous batching, PagedAttention, and speculative decoding.Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, etc.).Good communication, collaboration, and problem solving skills.Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast paced environment.Proficiency in Python; familiarity with C++/CUDA is a strong plus.


It Would Be Nice if You Have

Experience writing or tuning custom CUDA / Triton kernels.Experience with multi GPU and distributed inference.Certifications in AWS or Azure architecture.Experience with CI/CD and cloud production deployment (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including GPU backed instances.

title: Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam
description:
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Apply Now!

Về chúng tôi

Majorbird là Đối tác Bạc của Odoo (từ năm 2020), được sáng lập bởi một đội ngũ Trung – Pháp và đặt trụ sở chính tại Nam Sơn, Thâm Quyến. Chúng tôi là một đội ngũ quốc tế gồm 17 người, có văn phòng tại Hồng Kông, Trung Quốc, Việt Nam và Mexico. Chúng tôi đã triển khai hơn 100 dự án ERP và chuyên về những dự án đa công ty, đa tiền tệ và xuyên biên giới phức tạp mà phần lớn đối tác né tránh — trải dài khắp Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, Trung Đông và Mỹ Latinh.

Chúng tôi thiên về kỹ thuật, tư duy sản phẩm và luôn đi đầu: tham gia sâu vào các công nghệ tiên tiến và thực sự hiểu cách doanh nghiệp vận hành. Chúng tôi hay nói rằng ERP là trường kinh doanh tốt nhất của thời hiện đại — ở đây bạn thấy các công ty thật vận hành ra sao (tài chính, chuỗi cung ứng, sản xuất, bán hàng) và học cách làm cho chúng tốt hơn.

Vị trí — Lập trình viên ERP (Odoo) — Việt Nam

Bạn xây dựng và tùy biến Odoo trên các dự án khách hàng thực tế với mức độ tự chủ ngày càng cao — phát triển module, tích hợp và báo cáo, đồng thời làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối.

Công việc của bạn

Phát triển và tùy biến các module, tích hợp và báo cáo trên Odoo.Làm chủ tính năng từ đầu đến cuối — từ phân tích cùng tư vấn viên đến bàn giao.Viết code sạch, có kiểm thử và tuân thủ quy chuẩn kỹ thuật của chúng tôi.Sửa lỗi, cải thiện các tính năng hiện có và góp phần giữ chất lượng cao.

Yêu cầu bắt buộc

1–3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm với Python và kinh nghiệm thực tế với Odoo.Có khả năng hoàn thành tính năng với mức giám sát hạn chế.Tò mò về logic nghiệp vụ phía sau dòng code.Tiếng Anh viết là bắt buộc.Vị trí này không yêu cầu tiếng Anh giao tiếp.

Điểm cộng

PostgreSQL, JavaScript / OWL, Git, Linux hoặc Docker.Bằng Khoa học máy tính / Kỹ thuật hoặc các dự án cá nhân nổi bật.Đã từng tham gia các dự án Odoo đa công ty / đa tiền tệ.

Mức lương

Mức lương: 15.000.000–25.000.000 VND/tháng, tùy theo kinh nghiệm.

Điều tuyệt vời ở vị trí này

Nhìn dự án từ đầu đến cuối và làm chủ tác động thật — không phải một mảnh nhỏ trong cỗ máy khổng lồ.Làm việc trên các hệ thống đa công ty / đa tiền tệ thực sự phức tạp, không phải những cấu hình rập khuôn.Phát triển nhanh nhờ được dẫn dắt bởi người giàu kinh nghiệm, với lộ trình rõ ràng.Gia nhập một đội ngũ quốc tế thiên về kỹ thuật, công bằng và gắn bó dài hạn.

Quyền lợi

Thưởng dự án — trích theo quý dựa trên dòng tiền thu về của các dự án bạn tham gia triển khai.Tài trợ chứng chỉ Odoo — hoàn trả toàn bộ lệ phí thi — cùng đào tạo thường xuyên.Phép năm: 5 ngày sau năm làm việc đầu tiên, +1 ngày mỗi năm, tối đa 15 ngày.Thêm 1 ngày nghỉ có lương dịp Giáng sinh (nét văn hóa của đội ngũ Trung – Pháp).Bảo hiểm xã hội theo luật (BHXH / BHYT / BHTN) và các phúc lợi địa phương.Hoạt động team-building hằng quý, hộp quà ngày lễ và quà sinh nhật.Trang thiết bị làm việc do công ty cung cấp.Làm việc tại văn phòng ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh, với 1 ngày làm việc từ xa mỗi tuần.

Cách chúng tôi làm việc

Chúng tôi tôn trọng con người của mình, vì vậy họ tôn trọng công ty. Chúng tôi công bằng và xây dựng cho dài hạn.Chúng tôi không phải một "body shop" — mà là một đối tác tư duy sản phẩm, xem Odoo như một hệ thống sống, minh bạch tuyệt đối và không có toan tính ẩn giấu.Bạn gia nhập một đội ngũ nhỏ, giàu kinh nghiệm, quốc tế — nơi công việc của bạn được nhìn thấy và sự phát triển của bạn là thật.

Cách ứng tuyển

Nhấn Apply Now (Ứng tuyển ngay) trên trang này và giới thiệu đôi nét về bản thân. Chúng tôi xem xét mọi hồ sơ và sẽ phản hồi bạn.

Apply Now!

location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Location — Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Company — Vinova

About Vinova

Vinova is a Singapore-headquartered software development company that builds web, mobile, and enterprise applications. Our engineers work with clients and cross-functional teams to design, deliver, and operate software that solves real business problems. 

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineering Lead to lead the design and delivery of AI-powered products and agentic workflows. You'll work with clients and product teams to define use cases, decide where agents add value, and guide engineers from prototype through production. 

You'll own the technical decisions behind model selection, tool integration, evaluation, and deployment on AWS or Microsoft Azure. You'll also help the team adopt agentic development practices using tools such as Codex and Claude Code, while evaluating models such as Claude and Grok for product use cases. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of AI features and agentic workflows, including multi-step tasks, tool calling, and human approval where needed. Translate business problems into technical designs and measurable success criteria. Choose between conventional automation, a single model call, and an agentic workflow based on the task. Evaluate models and providers against task accuracy, latency, cost, and data handling requirements. Integrate them with existing APIs, applications, and data sources. Build evaluation datasets and regression checks for model outputs and agent behavior. Define how the system handles tool failures, unreliable outputs, and requests that need human review. Deploy and operate AI services on AWS or Azure. Set up CI/CD, monitoring, access controls, and rollback procedures for changes to models, prompts, and application code. Stay hands-on with architecture, implementation, and code reviews. Mentor engineers and establish team practices for using coding agents, reviewing generated changes, and verifying behavior before release. Communicate technical trade-offs, delivery risks, and progress to clients and stakeholders in clear English. 


What You'll Bring

Strong software engineering experience and a track record of leading the technical delivery of production systems. Hands-on experience taking at least one LLM-powered application or agentic workflow into production, with ownership of design, implementation, and evaluation. Strong coding skills in Python, TypeScript, C#, or another backend language, with experience designing APIs and integrating external services. Practical experience with model APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, and evaluation. Ability to explain how you measured quality and addressed failures in production. Hands-on experience deploying and operating services on AWS or Azure, including CI/CD, observability, identity and access management, and secrets management. Experience using Codex, Claude Code, or a comparable coding agent in real engineering work. Ability to explain how you scope tasks, review generated changes, and verify the results. Ability to mentor engineers, lead design discussions, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders in English. 


Nice to Have

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or multiple model providers, including Anthropic or xAI. Experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, integrating tools through Model Context Protocol (MCP), or orchestrating multi-agent workflows. Experience building evaluation and monitoring systems that track task completion, tool failures, latency, and cost at scale. 


What We Offer

Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. Flexible working hours subject to project requirements. Opportunities to work directly with international clients and collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams across regions. Opportunities for short- and long-term onsite assignments in Singapore. Team-building activities and an annual company trip. 


How To Apply

Send us your CV to recruitment@vinova.sg

title: AI-Native Software Engineer - MD Core

The Position

MetaDefender Core is OPSWAT's file security platform, trusted where the stakes are highest: nuclear plants, defense networks, the banks that move the world's money. It's a high-performance engine, shipped everywhere from cloud and containers to on-premises and air-gapped deployments.

Most companies are still debating whether their engineers may use AI. Here, it is the operating model.

What You Will Be Doing

Contribute to features end to end: clarify requirements, participate in design discussions, implement, test, debug, and help ship features, with ownership growing as you develop. Use AI as part of your daily engineering workflow: work with tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while reviewing and validating AI-generated output before it ships. Develop strong debugging skills by investigating issues that cannot easily be delegated to AI, from reproducing bugs and analyzing logs to diagnosing concurrency, OS, and environment-specific problems. Work across Windows and Linux environments, and gain exposure to cloud, containerized, on-premises, and air-gapped deployments. Prototype and evaluate AI-powered product capabilities, such as LLM-assisted analysis, automated triage, or AI-assisted support for new integrations. Collaborate with Product Management and QA to understand requirements, make technical trade-offs, and deliver reliable product features. 


What We Need From You

Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience 1+ years of professional experience with a track record of feature ownership. Good understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and common design patterns Experience with multi-threaded programming and system design Excellent coding and debugging skills, including comfort navigating a large existing codebase and diagnosing issues across OS boundaries (processes, services, permissions) An AI-native development mindset: hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools in real development work, with the judgment to review, verify, and test AI-generated code before it ships. Working knowledge of LLM fundamentals: prompt and context design, tool/function calling, evaluating outputs, and data-privacy considerations when using AI on proprietary code Hands-on experience in design reviews Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts. Good English is a plus point. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment Development experience on Windows, Linux platforms

location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Our R&D Center in Vietnam is a strategic AI Hub. We are building a unified, high-performance software foundation that powers Intelligent Edge Devices—from smart cameras to dedicated AI box processors—bringing server-class intelligence to the edge.

Job Description

Role Vision

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as a core Individual Contributor within our AI Engineering organization. In this high-impact role, you will take ownership of researching, designing, and developing cutting-edge Computer Vision algorithms to solve real-world public safety challenges.

Recognizing that modern AI encompasses vast and diverse domains, we offer high flexibility in this role. We do not expect candidates to be full-stack masters of every domain. Instead, we highly value deep specialization. We welcome candidates who possess profound, hands-on expertise in EITHER resource-constrained Edge inference optimization OR large-scale Cloud AI model development and algorithmic data mining.

Core Responsibilities

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will contribute heavily to core algorithm development while leveraging your specific strengths:

Core AI/ML Development

Design, train, and fine-tune high-performance deep learning models for complex vehicle attribute detection and optical character recognition (OCR) utilizing modern architectures (CNNs, Vision Transformers).Apply a Data-Centric AI approach, potentially leveraging Generative AI (Diffusion Models, GANs) for Synthetic Data Generation to overcome long-tail anomalies and obscured data in natural environments.Write clean, highly efficient, well-documented, and maintainable production-level code (Python/C++).

Specialized Domain Focus (Depending On Your Primary Expertise)

title: Senior Data Engineer
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
The Job in short

The Data Enablement team is here to enable every team in the organisation with their data needs. Our job starts the moment that data enters our platform and ends when it reaches whoever needs it. We are a small, senior team of data and AI engineers, working across customer data, product knowledge, and the data the organisation runs on.

We bring data in, reconcile it into one version people can rely on, and make it available to the right audience. Increasingly that audience is agents as well as people, so everything we build has to work for both. Two things must hold at every step: that only the right people can see it, and that we can prove it is correct. You build the platform that makes both possible.

As a Senior Data Engineer you own the foundation: the lakehouse, the pipelines that fill it, and the layers that serve it. We treat data as a product, so each one has a named owner, a documented contract with the teams who consume it, and stated expectations on freshness and quality. That includes Data as a Service, where internal and external teams run analytics on data held in our AI-powered Banking OS.

This is not only a tabular data job. A large part of it is a versioned documentation corpus, kept current, deduplicated and traceable across many product versions, and much of it arrives semi-structured rather than clean. The consumers are not only dashboards either. You build and maintain the MCP tools that let AI agents query documentation, API specs and release history directly. That is a meaningful part of the role, not a side project.

We hold pipelines to the same standard as application code: tested, reviewed, deployed through CI/CD, observable in production, and promoted properly across environments. If that is already how you think about data engineering, you will recognise this team quickly.

Meet the job

Develop and maintain pipelines extracting data from many sources: RDBMS, Change Data Capture and streaming endpoints.Process data ranging from observability metrics to bank accounts and transactions, in a highly secure and compliant manner.Transform raw data into business-ready analytical models on a Data Lakehouse.Guard data consistency, quality and end to end governance across the full lifecycle.Unstructured data at scale. Ingest and maintain a large versioned documentation corpus: incremental sync, change tracking, deduplication and freshness. Much of it is public or semi-structured source material rather than clean tabular data.Agent-facing data tools. Build and maintain MCP tools that let AI agents query documentation, API specs and release history. A meaningful part of this role.Pipelines as software. GitHub Actions CI/CD, automated tests, observability and proper environment promotion across Fabric and Databricks. We automate through GitHub, and we expect the same engineering discipline from data pipelines as from application code.


How About You

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.5+ years of experience in data engineering, preferably Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks or Spark. Strong experience on another major cloud is fine if you are ready to convert.Expertise in Data Lakehouse concepts and Delta Lake.Working knowledge of data regulation and compliance, and the judgement to know when to involve Legal.Strong technical leadership. You can drive a piece of work end to end, take the calls with other value streams and stakeholders yourself, and keep it moving without a project manager.Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.Proactive, autonomous and self-sufficient. You work independently on your own projects and take the calls with other value streams and stakeholders yourself.Python and SQL depth, including pipeline and query performance work.


Strong pluses

Experience with data contracts and making a platform other teams can self-serve from.A BI layer in production, such as Power BI.Machine learning fundamentals, enough to work with AI engineers as a peer.Retrieval and vector search. Building or maintaining the vector and hybrid search layer that AI products query.Preparing data for model training or fine-tuning, including anonymisation of sensitive data.Instrumenting retrieval so its quality can be measured by someone else.


Our tech stack

Languages: Python, SQL.Platform: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Blob, Cosmos DB, Azure Key Vault.Processing and orchestration: PySpark, Fabric pipelines and notebooks.Ops: GitHub Actions, Fabric deployment pipelines, Power BI.AI surface: MCP, vector and hybrid search.

description:

Driven by the power of Technology and AI, their mission is to economically empower everyone across the region, operating with core values of heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Get to know the teamThe AI Platform team builds and operates the core platform that runs the organization's massive Apache Airflow fleet. Hundreds of Airflow instances serve various engineering and data teams across the company, running on Amazon EKS with metadata databases powered by Amazon Aurora. The team owns this infrastructure footprint end to end - covering clusters, databases, networking, identity and access models, observability, and cost controls - with the goal of maintaining a fleet that is fast, reliable, and cost-effective for every team scheduling workloads on it.

title: Lead Engineer (Production Bioinformatics & ML Platform)
description: The RoleWe are looking for a Lead Engineer to lead, technically, the team that builds and runs our commercial software platform: the production system that runs our R&D team's bioinformatic pipelines (mostly Nextflow) and machine-learning models at high volume, every day, for the clinical genetic tests our customers rely on. Your team makes these pipelines reliable, scalable, traceable and fast in production, and keeps them that way as the load grows.The platform sits between R&D and IT. You will not manage either team, yet much of your work depends on both, so the role needs strong architectural judgement and the people skills to move work forward through influence rather than authority.This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the platform's technical direction and make its key technical decisions — designing it to absorb growing volumes, new tests and new models without being rebuilt — while doing a real share of the technical work yourself.What You Will DoSet the technical direction — define where the platform should be in two to three years and the roadmap to get there; make the architecture, technology and build-versus-buy decisions.Stay hands-on — write production code, prototype and benchmark design options, review infrastructure and pipeline code, and lead the investigation of the hardest production incidents.Design for heavy and growing load — workflow orchestration and scheduling, compute capacity, storage and movement of large sequencing files, and predictable turnaround times.Bring pipelines and models into production — packaging, containerisation, versioning, validation, release and rollback, so that new and updated tests ship quickly and safely.Keep the system running smoothly — monitoring, alerting, incident response and capacity planning; set and meet service levels for availability and turnaround time.Build in clinical-grade quality — every result reproducible and traceable to the exact pipeline, model, reference data and software version that produced it; patient data protected; audit and regulatory requirements supported.Lead the team technically — make and explain the key decisions, break the roadmap into deliverable work, guide engineers through design and code review, and set engineering standards, including that AI-generated code is reviewed and owned like any other.Work across R&D and IT — agree with R&D what a production-ready pipeline looks like; plan infrastructure, storage and security with IT; resolve competing priorities through clear proposals and data; and explain technical risks and trade-offs to management.Integrate with international partners — work with partner teams around the world to integrate our solutions with their platforms: agree interfaces and data exchange, deploy into partner environments, and troubleshoot jointly across organizations.What We're Looking ForSubstantial experience building and running production software systems — typically eight or more years — including several years as the technical lead of a team while staying hands-on.A proven track record as an architect of systems that handle heavy and growing load in production.Excellent people skills — delivering through teams you do not manage: negotiating priorities, resolving disagreements and building trust.Clear communication in fluent English, in writing and in person, with executives, scientists, engineers and international partners alike.Strategic thinking and sound judgement — seeing where the system must go and getting there in safe steps, in a setting where results inform patient care.A degree in computer science, software engineering, bioinformatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.Core Technical SkillsHands-on experience with workflow orchestration and with Slurm and/or cloud infrastructure is required. Across the other areas we expect solid ability in most and real depth in several:Workflow orchestration — how orchestration works (task graphs, scheduling, resource requests, data staging, retries, caching) and hands-on use of at least one framework: Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL/Cromwell, Airflow, Argo or Temporal. Our pipelines are written in Nextflow; if it is new to you, be ready to learn it.Compute infrastructure — Slurm (or another HPC scheduler) and/or AWS, GCP or Azure, including running large batch workloads.Programming — Go, which parts of our platform are written in, and, Python, plus Bash and SQL. Strong engineers from another back-end language are welcome if ready to pick up Go quickly.Software architecture — distributed systems, APIs, queue- and event-driven processing, fault tolerance and horizontal scaling.Containers and Linux — Docker, Kubernetes, Linux administration, networking, storage (including object storage such as S3 or MinIO) and performance profiling.DevOps and reliability — Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and logging.Data and ML in production — relational databases and message brokers (e.g. PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka); packaging, versioning and batch inference of models.Security — access control, secrets management, encryption and secure handling of patient data.Nice to HaveHands-on Nextflow — running pipelines in production, ideally writing and optimising them (DSL2, nf-core).Bioinformatics or NGS data — FASTQ/BAM/VCF and tools such as BWA, samtools or GATK.Both HPC and cloud, hybrid on-premise and cloud architectures, moving very large files over constrained networks, and infrastructure cost control.What We OfferReal ownership of the technical direction of a production system at the heart of the business.Meaningful work: the systems you build deliver results that improve patients' healthcare.Close collaboration with a strong, publication-active R&D team in an international company.A competitive compensation package, including private health insurance.Flexible working hours and a partial work-from-home option (upon approval).

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech leadClosely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture visionDesign and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as productsApply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processesAutomate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systemsMaintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructureDevelop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and servicesProvide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peersBe given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasksShare your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and ‘doing work together’Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

Who Thrives at SpartanNot every environment fits everyone, so here's an honest picture of the teammates we're looking to build with.You'll thrive here if:You do what it takes to move things forward. A schema redesign today, a backfill script and a founder demo tomorrow.You take on the hardest part of a project and see it through to production.You chase a wrong number until you find where it broke. Silent bad data bothers you more than a loud outage.You'd rather own a problem than simply complete a ticket.You adapt quickly, take responsibility, and care about the impact of what you build.Some weeks will stretch you. Data Engineering remains your core, but you'll also contribute to backend services, infrastructure, and AI integration.Help shape Spartan's engineering culture, building with ownership, speed, and the mindset of a product engineer rather than a traditional contractor.

You build reliable platforms that make data accessible, trustworthy, and useful.
Nice to HaveExperience in one or more of the following areas will be a plus:Stream processing: Hands-on production experience with Flink, Spark, or Kafka Streams.Warehouse and lakehouse technologies: Experience with dbt, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or real-time OLAP stores such as ClickHouse or Druid.Durable execution: Experience with Temporal or similar technologies for managing long-running workflows.IoT and telemetry: Experience handling high-volume ingestion, late and out-of-order events, and large device fleets.ML and LLM infrastructure: Experience with feature stores, vector databases, and training or evaluation data pipelines.Data platform development: Experience building an internal data platform from scratch.Domain knowledge: Experience in rideshare, logistics, mobility, transportation, or other data-intensive industries.

title: Staff Data Engineer (Customer Data Platform) - DC33
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
YOUR NEW ROLE 

This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software

JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate.

Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next.

A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement.

You own the data path: from the moment a merchant's delivery arrives, through validation and nightly builds, to versioned business views that products can trust. Nothing lost, nothing counted twice, no half finished state ever visible, for thousands of merchants at once. We are hiring two Data Engineers with complementary profiles, from Mid-Level to Staff, and set the level with you, based on your experience.

The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window.

YOUR EXCITING TASKS

Design and build tenant-isolated transformation layers with dbt and DuckDB, from raw deliveries to clean, versioned business views. Define data contracts for ERP source tables (orders, articles, stock, invoices) and extend them to new sources step by step. Build idempotent, replayable pipelines: deliveries may arrive twice, results never do. Orchestrate nightly runs per merchant with Dagster, with retries, blast-radius limits and alerts that say what happened. Automate data quality and end-to-end checks into every pull request. Model the metrics products ask for, revenue, margin, stock, reorder signals, together with the product teams.Work agent-first: specify, then let Claude Code and Codex implement, orchestrate agents across pipelines and models, triage pipeline issues with them, and own the review. Keep cost per merchant transparent and low. 

YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY

8+ years building production data pipelines. Excellent SQL and strong Python; you can read a query plan and you test what you ship. Hands-on experience with dbt (or comparable) and analytical engines such as DuckDB, Spark, Snowflake or BigQuery. Experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. A solid grasp of analytical data modelling: incremental loads, idempotency, late and duplicate deliveries. Experience with relational sources (Microsoft SQL Server or similar) and PostgreSQL. Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: you design agent workflows, orchestrate agents on real work and know when not to trust them. Clear written and spoken English and a habit of writing things down.

Nice To Have

Multi-tenant data platforms, tenant isolation and row-level security. Data contracts and schema evolution. Terraform, Azure or GitHub Actions. Semantic or metrics layers (MetricFlow, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube). Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted data operations. E-commerce or ERP data. 

Benefits Await You At Code Leap

Competitive salary and beneﬁtsYear-end bonus (13th-month salary)Generous annual leave of up to 18 daysAdditional premium health insuranceEnjoy an endless selection of delicious refreshments, including gourmet coffee, beverages, snacks, and fresh fruits, all complimentaryDynamic, fun, and agile environment, perfect for sharing and creativityOpen-minded, kind & humble colleagues

CONTACT

Come to talk to us at jobs@codeleap.de

About Us

With our expert teams spread across two continents, CODE LEAP provides innovative software solutions for venture-backed companies and leading enterprise businesses in Germany. Our teams in Berlin (Germany) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) work hand in hand to develop state-of-the-art solutions of the highest quality.

Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth.

We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

title: Senior Data Engineer (Customer Data Platform) - DC32

description:
YOUR NEW ROLE 

This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software

JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate.

Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next.

A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement.

You own the data path: from the moment a merchant's delivery arrives, through validation and nightly builds, to versioned business views that products can trust. Nothing lost, nothing counted twice, no half finished state ever visible, for thousands of merchants at once. We are hiring two Data Engineers with complementary profiles, from Mid-Level to Staff, and set the level with you, based on your experience.

The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window.

YOUR EXCITING TASKS

Design and build tenant-isolated transformation layers with dbt and DuckDB, from raw deliveries to clean, versioned business views. Define data contracts for ERP source tables (orders, articles, stock, invoices) and extend them to new sources step by step. Build idempotent, replayable pipelines: deliveries may arrive twice, results never do.Orchestrate nightly runs per merchant with Dagster, with retries, blast-radius limits and alerts that say what happened. Automate data quality and end-to-end checks into every pull request. Model the metrics products ask for, revenue, margin, stock, reorder signals, together with the product teams.Work agent-first: specify, then let Claude Code and Codex implement, orchestrate agents across pipelines and models, triage pipeline issues with them, and own the review. Keep cost per merchant transparent and low.

YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY

6+ years (Senior) building production data pipelines. Excellent SQL and strong Python; you can read a query plan and you test what you ship.Hands-on experience with dbt (or comparable) and analytical engines such as DuckDB, Spark, Snowflake or BigQuery. Experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. A solid grasp of analytical data modelling: incremental loads, idempotency, late and duplicate deliveries. Experience with relational sources (Microsoft SQL Server or similar) and PostgreSQL.Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: you design agent workflows, orchestrate agents on real work and know when not to trust them. Clear written and spoken English and a habit of writing things down.

Nice To Have

 Multi-tenant data platforms, tenant isolation and row-level security. Data contracts and schema evolution. Terraform, Azure or GitHub Actions. Semantic or metrics layers (MetricFlow, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube). Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted data operations. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
About GeoComply

We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud.

Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year.

At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down.

Why do we create this position?

Infrastructure and hosting are vital to GeoComply’s success, ensuring uninterrupted, top-tier service for the US gaming industry. Beyond that, we engineer forward-thinking infrastructure to deliver high availability, key to our uptime, making it easy to scale, accelerating innovation, and keeping pace with industry growth and evolving customer demands.

We are an engineering organization navigating a critical migration and innovation phase. Our goal is to reduce cloud platform dependency, optimize costs, and ensure high availability and scalability by migrating service workloads from AWS to GCP. At the same time, we’re modernizing our systems, shifting from a monolithic architecture to microservices, and building a resilient, multi-region platform.

To sustain this pace, we are growing our DevOps capability in Vietnam. This role adds senior hands-on execution capacity to the team. We are looking for someone who can own significant workstreams end to end, mentor the engineers around them, and partner directly with development squads as we scale.

Job Description

As a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Vietnam and part of a global DevOps team, you'll design, build, and operate the infrastructure and DevOps tooling that powers GeoComply's systems.

You'll own meaningful pieces of our AWS to GCP migration and multi-region platform on GCP, contributing to a unified, scalable core infrastructure that enables product development teams to deliver value quickly and keep pace with our customers' growing and fast-changing demands. This means shifting DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable" through self-service tooling, without loosening security, standards, or guardrails. You'll help ensure the platform runs reliably 24/7 and holds up under peak events like the Super Bowl, consult product teams on cloud-native best practices, work independently on complex problems, and use AI assistance as a standard part of how you build and operate.

Key Responsibilities


Cloud Infrastructure & FinOps: Support and maintain our AWS and GCP infrastructure for high availability, identify capability gaps within your scope and propose practical improvements, and treat cost as a first-class design constraint through FinOps practices. Multi-Cloud Delivery & Migration: Own and deliver workstreams across AWS and GCP, including our AWS to GCP migration using GCP-managed services (e.g. GKE, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), while continuing to operate the AWS workloads that remain business-critical, with cost, performance, and interoperability front of mind. Multi-Region Architecture: Implement and operate multi-region infrastructure across AWS and GCP for low-latency traffic management (shadowing, shifting) and disaster recovery, in partnership with development and data teams. Modernization & System Design: Support the transition from monoliths to microservices and align infrastructure with evolving application needs, promoting automation, scalability, and maintainability. Security & Compliance: Embed security best practices across the infrastructure (IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network policies, data protection) and ensure compliance with industry standards and internal governance. Engineering Platform & Operational Excellence: Improve CI/CD, observability (e.g. LGTM stack, GCP Monitoring), SLIs/SLOs, on-call and incident response, and post-mortems that reach systemic root cause; build reusable patterns and self-service tooling that shift DevOps from "Serve" to "Enable." Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship: Mentor teammates through code and architecture reviews, and support development teams via reusable patterns, documentation, and self-service capabilities rather than by fielding their questions directly. AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage GenAI tools and AI agents to accelerate common development and operational work so your time goes to the highest-impact engineering, reviewing and verifying output against production standards for reliability, security, cost, and maintainability, and coach teammates to do the same. 


Requirements


5+ years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience taking medium-to-large infrastructure projects. Strong analytical mindset to define complex problems, evaluate technical trade-offs, and independently navigate ambiguity to drive cross-system solutions to completion. Production expertise with containerization especially in Kubernetes environment, including deep familiarity with cluster lifecycle management, scaling strategies, resource optimization, and troubleshooting cluster and workload issues. Proven experience designing modular Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) and building secure, automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions). Proven track record of architecting and operating production environments on GCP and/or AWS, specifically leveraging managed services (e.g. GKE/EKS, Cloud SQL/RDS, Pub/Sub/SQS). Experience with multi-cloud/multi-region is a plus. Direct ownership of highly available systems, including on-call, incident response, and post-incident improvement. Proven experience with pillars of telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) and modern observability stacks (e.g LGTM stack, Datadog). Practical experience with SRE concepts and managing cardinality, retention, and cost at scale. Familiar and hands-on practice using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenCode) on real DevOps work (IaC, debugging, incident triage, post-mortems). Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, written and verbal. Must be able to explain technical decisions clearly in English, in writing, in design documents, and in live discussion. 


Bonus Points


Experience operating Service Mesh solutions (e.g. Istio, Linkerd) in complex microservices environments. Proven track record of tracing packet flow and optimizing end-to-end latency across multi-cluster, multi-region network topologies and cloud-managed service boundaries. ML Infrastructure Engineering: Hands-on experience architecting and operating production ML platforms. 


Why Join GeoComply:

☘ Hybrid working mode & Modern office at a prime location in District 1

☘ Professional development budget to support your growth

☘ 20 annual leave days, 5 sick leave days

☘ Premium health insurance (Bao Viet or Liberty)

☘ Social, unemployment, and health insurance contributions based on full salary
