title: Junior Sustainability Data & Geospatial Analyst
company: CÔNG TY TNHH EXPORT TRADING COMMODITIES VIỆT NAM
description:
Mô tả công việc
Job Title:
Junior Sustainability Data & Geospatial Analyst
Closing Date:
26/11/2026
Reports to:
Global Standards and Compliance Manager
Location:
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
ETG GROUP
Export Trading Group (ETG) has developed into a global player with a presence in 48 countries, spanning 6 continents. The Group has a diverse portfolio of expertise across various industries encompassing agricultural inputs, logistics, merchandising, food processing, energy, minerals & metals, technology, and supply chain optimization. We adapt and grow responsibly as a diversified enterprise creating a sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Over 10.000 employees contribute every day to achieve our vision and purpose and live our values of: Respect; Integrity; Pursuit of Excellence; Leadership and Meritocracy.
ETG COFFEE SUSTAINABILITY
ETG Coffee Sustainability teams are driving the positive social and environmental transition of ETG operations. Within the coffee department there are dedicated sustainability teams, supporting the commercial teams exporting and trading green coffee beans headquartered in the Netherlands and with sourcing operations in Africa, Asia and Latin America covering over a hundred thousand farmers. Our farmer level sustainability projects include interventions on agroforestry, carbon farming, living income, gender empowerment, and youth inclusion. We are also strengthening our direct sourcing network and supply chain transparency across origins through establishing relationships with our sourcing farmer groups and supporting them with digital farmer registration, geo-mapping and providing farmers access to support training and services.
JOB PURPOSE
The ETG Coffee Sustainability team is responding to the need for data analysis and verification and due diligence in response to our project reporting and emerging regulatory changes (e.g. EUDR, CSDDD).
The role fits in the impact oriented and energetic sustainability team of 15+ experts across 6 countries, that have already onboarded farmers digitally in dedicated surveying and assessment tools. The Junior Geospatial Data Analyst is responsible for cleaning, standardizing, validating, and maintaining farmer geospatial and traceability datasets, including famer information, coffee plot polygons, waypoints, and shipment-related information. The role supports regulatory compliance, supply chain transparency, and sustainability reporting through high-quality data management and analysis.
With a fast-changing context of regulatory requirement and sourcing developments, this role offers a dynamic environment for strategizing within an interdisciplinary team and bringing tangible results in inclusion and impact for smallholder farmers.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Data Cleaning & Validation
Clean, standardize, and validate datasets from multiple origins and systems.
Perform quality checks on geospatial and traceability datasets.
Investigate data quality issues and identify potential root causes.
Review farmer registration records and supporting documentation.
Support recurring data quality monitoring and improvement activities.
Maintain documentation of common issues, resolutions, and best practices.
Data Management
Import, update, and maintain data in MergData, including new records and corrections to existing datasets.
Conduct periodical review of plot polygons, waypoints, and associated attributes of direct sourcing origins to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Resolve and document basic geometry, topology, and attribute-related issues.
Maintain and update master farmer and geo datasets.
Conduct ad hoc data analysis as requested by clients and internal stakeholders.
Traceability & Compliance Data
Conduct desk-based geospatial assessments on new shipment-related datasets in line with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
Support the implementation of traceability systems in direct sourcing origins.
Support preparation of geolocation and traceability files for regulatory compliance and client reporting.
Validate data used for sustainability regulation, certification and customer reporting.
Assist with recurring compliance-related data requests from customers, authorities, certification bodies, and internal stakeholders.
Reporting & Dashboards
Support the development, maintenance, and refresh of dashboards and reporting tools.
Track data quality and data performance metrics.
Assist in identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality gaps.
Prepare recurring reports and supporting datasets for internal and external reporting requirements.
System & Team Support
Support testing and governance of surveys and data collection tools.
Help investigate issues raised by origin teams and support corrective actions.
Maintain documentation and data management procedures.
Contribute ideas for improving workflows and reducing manual work.

Yêu cầu công việc
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Required
• 1–2 years of experience working with data cleaning, harmonization, or data analysis, especially with larger datasets.
• Strong proficiency in Excel (PivotTable, Power Query).
• Hands‑on experience with geospatial datasets and/or Geo Information System (GIS) applications, such as ArcGIS and QGIS.
• Proficiency with PowerPoint and Word.
• Fluent English communication skills (B2+ level or equivalent), both written and spoken.
Nice To Have
• Basic knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
• Knowledge or working experience with programming language, such as Python, and querying language (SQL)
• Experience working with agricultural, traceability, sustainability, or supply chain datasets.
• Exposure to sustainability, agriculture or certification programs.
ABOUT YOU
• Highly accurate, analytical, attention to details, and process oriented
• Proactive and independent, whilst also having teamwork mentality
• Agile and stress resistant, being able to operate in fast paced business environment, and independently structure and prioritize tasks.
• Good communicator to solve issues and align processes in a multicultural setting with team members in Europe, Africa and Asia.
• An effective communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
• Curious and technology-minded, with enthusiasm for learning new systems and tools.
WHAT WE OFFER
An opportunity to support responsible coffee sourcing, regulatory compliance and digital transformation
Hands-on exposure to EUDR, certification, traceability, geospatial data and digital farmer-registration systems.
Competitive market-based compensation package
100% salary during the probation period
15 leave days per year
Year-end bonus.

1. Tham mưu chiến lược và quản trị CNTT
•	Đánh giá hiện trạng, nhu cầu và mức độ trưởng thành CNTT; tham mưu định hướng, kiến trúc và lộ trình CNTT – chuyển đổi số trung hạn, kế hoạch triển khai hằng năm phù hợp chiến lược Tập đoàn.

•	Phối hợp các Ban/Phòng và đơn vị đánh giá quy trình quản trị – điều hành, đầu tư, tài chính, nhân sự, quản lý dự án và hoạt động tại công trường để xác định bài toán ưu tiên số hóa.

6. Quản trị tổ chức, phối hợp và phát triển năng lực

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mô tả công việc
About the Role
Cake is a Vietnamese digital bank with over 6 million users, building toward becoming a NextGen AI Bank, where data and AI are at the core of every product and decision.
In this role you'll be embedded in the Lending team as their data partner. You'll dig into the data to help the team plan and solve problems, propose where machine learning can help, and drive those solutions to delivery. You'll learn predictive modeling on the job, with hands-on guidance from our senior data scientists.
What You'll Do
Analyze deeply, then propose the right solution.
Work with the Lending team to understand their goals and pain points. Run deep-dive analyses (funnel and conversion, customer behavior, portfolio and risk signals, product performance) to support their planning and problem solving. Turn the findings into clear recommendations, and where it makes sense, propose a suitable ML solution such as credit scoring, propensity, or recommendation.
Build and improve models, with guidance.
Develop, evaluate, and improve predictive models and segmentation alongside senior data scientists. You'll learn feature engineering, validation, and monitoring on real lending problems, and keep models interpretable for non-technical stakeholders.
Drive delivery.
Own projects from problem definition to delivery. Coordinate across Lending, Risk, Product, Data Engineering, and ML Engineering to align priorities, manage timelines, unblock dependencies, and make sure solutions reach production and create business impact.
You'll also share knowledge with the team and grow along a clear path from Data Analyst to Data Scientist to Senior DS / AI roles.

Yêu cầu công việc
What We're Looking For
Must-have
Background
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years in data analytics or a similar role, preferably in fintech, banking, lending, e-commerce, or tech.
Data-driven and problem-solving mindset
Turns vague business questions into structured, testable problems and knows when an answer is good enough to act on.
Is rigorous with data: checks quality, questions surprising results, and is honest about uncertainty.
Analytical and technical foundation
Strong in SQL, Python (pandas, numpy, visualization), and statistics, with basic knowledge of how predictive models are built and evaluated (AUC, precision/recall).
Has a track record of deep-dive analyses that changed a decision or plan, beyond reports and dashboards.
Business acumen
Understands how a digital business makes money and manages risk, and connects analysis to metrics like conversion, approval rate, and default rate.
Prioritizes problems by business value and can say when a model isn't the right answer.
Data storytelling
Turns analysis into a clear narrative that leads with the insight and ends with a concrete recommendation.
Adapts the message to the audience, from product teams to senior leadership, and explains models so non-technical stakeholders trust and act on them.
Getting things done
Owns work from problem definition through delivery, with strong project management and a bias for action.
Moves work across teams by aligning priorities and unblocking dependencies without relying on formal authority.
Nice-to-have (we'll train you)
Hands-on machine learning experience (scikit-learn or similar), including any predictive or scoring project.
Experience in lending, credit risk, or customer analytics.
Experience with big data tools or cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

title: AI Engineering (Vietnam) - English Speaking - Remote
description:
Mô tả công việc
We are building the software hotels use to serve, know and win back their guests. Our mission: evolve Japanese omotenashi through technology.
IFHA (Inbound-First Hospitality Alliance):
our alliance of 400+ hotels, ryokans and resorts across Japan, plus 15+ facilities in Vietnam.
Guest-facing SaaS:
GEM (guest engagement), MenyGo (mobile ordering) and Smartphone Concierge - 1.6M+ cumulative system users.
AI visibility:
AEO (answer-engine optimisation) audits, AI Profile - a machine-readable hotel data directory built for AI systems to cite - and the AI Learner Dashboard.
IT consulting:
DX strategy, system design and offshore development in Vietnam with JP/EN bridge engineering.
Why now.
Hotels have lost their guests three times: to OTAs (booking), to Google (discovery) and to COVID (the human touch went digital). The fourth shift is AI becoming the interface that decides who gets found at all. We are rebuilding company around it - tooling that lets one consultant serve many hotels, and an operations function run on agents.
The role
AI Engineering is the CIAO's (Chief AI Officer's) right hand and the builder-in-chief of our agent and automation stack. You will turn the CIAO's roadmap into shipped production systems - largely by directing AI coding agents rather than by hiring a large engineering team.
Just as important as shipping: you own the
standard
those agents work to. The instruction layer - AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, sub-agent definitions, skills, prompt libraries, review gates and evals - is a product in this company, and it is yours to build, version and keep healthy as models and tools change.
This is a deeply hands-on technical role, but we are not hiring output - we are hiring leverage. Your own code matters less than the difference you make to everyone else's: the engineer who ships twice as much because your instruction files are good, the consultant who stops doing a task by hand, the non-engineer who can safely run an agent. You will be judged on team throughput and quality, not personal commit count. That makes written and spoken communication a core technical skill here, not a soft extra: most of your leverage is delivered as writing that other people (and agents) act on.
Reports to:
Chief AI Officer (CIAO), Japan HQ
Works with:
Product & AI team, Ops, Sales, and client-facing consultants
Type:
Full-time, senior
Location:
Vietnam
What you'll do
1.
Build with AI coding agents, daily.
Design, prompt, review and ship production code - internal tools, data pipelines, integrations and client-facing products - using AI coding agents as your primary engineering workforce. We use Claude Code today and stay deliberately tool-agnostic: Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and whatever ships next are all fair game if they do the job better.
2.
Own and maintain the agent instruction layer.
Author and continuously maintain AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md and equivalent instruction files, repo conventions, sub-agent definitions, skills, slash commands, MCP tool wiring and scheduled jobs - so that any agent, on any tool, produces work to the same standard. Treat these as versioned, reviewed, tested assets, not scratch notes.
3.
Set and enforce the engineering standard for AI-built code.
Define how we write prompts, tests, evals, code review and guardrails; define what an agent may do unsupervised, what needs a human gate, and what is never automated. Keep a measurable bar (review pass rate, escaped defects, rework) rather than a vibe.
4.
Run the agent workflow as a system.
Design the handoff pipeline from requirement → scoped agent task → PR → review → deploy. Keep context hygiene, repo safety (pre-checks, reversibility, rollback), and destructive-operation policy explicit and followed.
5.
Scale the consultant.
Build the tooling that lets one our consultant serve many hotels - audits, reports, data structuring and delivery automation.
6.
Support AI Profile and AEO products.
Build and maintain the data pipelines, schema and feeds behind our hotel data products.
7.
Run the CIAO's execution.
Translate strategy into scoped projects, estimates and weekly delivery; report progress, cost and risk back to the CIAO.
8.
Measure and control cost.
Track model and token spend across tools, pick the right model and tool for each job, and keep unit economics healthy.
9.
Multiply the team.
Train engineers, consultants and non-engineers to work with AI tools safely and well; turn repeated work into reusable skills, templates and plugins; run short reviews and working sessions that raise the whole team's level instead of routing every hard task through you. Aim to make yourself removable from the critical path.
10.
Communicate across borders.
Write the specs, decision records, weekly updates and risk/blocker reports that keep Japan HQ, the Vietnam team and client-facing staff aligned - clearly enough that a non-engineer can act on them and a senior engineer can argue with them. Say plainly what is decided, what is open, and what needs the CIAO's call.
11.
Keep us current.
Evaluate new agents, models, MCP servers and workflow tools on a regular cadence; recommend adopt/trial/hold with evidence, migration cost and risk - not hype.

Yêu cầu công việc
3+ years in software engineering
Hands-on production experience with AI coding agents - you have shipped real systems this way, not just experimented. Any tool counts (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, custom agent loops). Be ready to walk us through a repo you built this way.
Evidence that you raise the standard, not just the output. Show us the instruction layer you wrote - AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, sub-agents, skills, prompt or eval libraries, review checklists - and explain how it changed quality, and how you maintained it as models changed.
Working knowledge of the modern agent toolset: project memory/instruction files, sub-agents, hooks, slash commands, skills, and MCP servers - at least deeply in one ecosystem, with the judgment to port the ideas across tools.
Strong fundamentals in at least one of TypeScript/Node or Python, plus SQL, REST/JSON APIs, Git and cloud deployment.
Experience building LLM applications: prompt design, tool use, evaluation, RAG or structured data extraction.
Judgment about when AI output is wrong - you review agent code as carefully as a senior engineer reviews a junior's.
Strong communication, in writing first. You can turn a messy discussion into a scoped spec, explain a technical trade-off to a salesperson and to an engineer on the same day, and give review feedback that people act on rather than resent. English writing that needs no cleanup before it goes to HQ or a client.
A track record of lifting a team, not just a codebase. Mentoring, enablement, standards or tooling you introduced that measurably changed how others worked - and evidence you can point to for it.
Security and data-handling discipline: secrets, access control, client data and licensing boundaries.
A bias for shipping: small team, fast cycles, clear written updates.
Language (required)
Business-level English is required.
You will work directly with the CIAO and leadership in Japan, write technical specs and status reports, and speak with international partners and clients - your written English should need no cleanup before it goes to HQ or a client. Vietnamese is a plus for working with local vendors and talent. Cantonese or Chinese is a plus. Japanese is not required.
Nice to have
Experience with agent SDKs or model APIs (tool use, prompt caching, managed/hosted agents)
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or equivalent.
Built or published MCP servers, agent skills, plugins or open-source agent tooling.
Experience running evals or regression suites over LLM/agent output.
Hospitality, travel, OTA or hotel-tech background.
Schema.org, structured data, SEO or AEO (answer-engine optimisation) experience.
Experience working with teams in Japan, Hong Kong or across Asia.
A public GitHub, portfolio or write-ups showing AI-first engineering work.
Location, terms and how to apply
-
Location:
Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi preferred), remote-first with occasional travel to Japan, potential to move to an office.
-
Hours:
Regular overlap with Japan working hours (JST is 2 hours ahead of Vietnam).

title: IT Support Technician
description:
Mô tả công việc
Position Summary
The
IT Support Technician
is responsible for
ensuring
the stability, security, and efficient
operation of the clinic's entire IT infrastructure and office equipment
. This role involves hands-on hardware and software troubleshooting, deploying network systems, managing IT assets, and
providing prompt technical support
to clinic staff to minimize operational downtime. Additionally, the position involves assisting with critical healthcare information systems (such as HIS, EMR, LIS, PACS) and overseeing facility safety compliance, specifically regarding Fire Fighting & Prevention (FFP) systems and documentation
Responsibilities:
1. Office Equipment Management, Repair, and Maintenance
• Inspect, diagnose, perform routine maintenance, and repair IT hardware and office appliances, including desktop PCs, laptops, printers, photocopiers, time attendance systems, and surveillance cameras.
• Execute installation and network configuration for printers, photocopiers, scanners, paper shredders, and projectors across clinic departments.
• Perform regular maintenance, internal cleaning, part replacements, and manage consumables (ink cartridges, paper, toner, and spare components).
• Swiftly diagnose and resolve technical issues such as paper jams, print defects, connectivity errors, or power issues on all office equipment.
2. IT Hardware, Software & Network Administration
• Assemble, install, upgrade, and repair computer hardware (PCs, laptops) and peripherals for office staff.
• Deploy and configure operating systems (Windows, macOS), productivity suites (Office, Microsoft 365), specialized business applications, and anti-virus software.
• Manage and maintain local network infrastructure (LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches) and basic user access credentials.
• Deploy, install, configure, and maintain network systems, modems, routers, and other network hardware.
• Install, maintain, and operate security cameras, PBX phone systems, and biometric time attendance machines.
• Onboard and configure equipment for new employees; handle proper offboarding and device retrieval.
3. User Support and System Operations
• Manage Helpdesk operations to promptly handle daily user requests (e.g., internet outages, software glitches, password resets, and corporate email issues).
• Provide end-user support and training on software usage, security regulations, and proper equipment operation.
• Assist in basic troubleshooting for healthcare information systems (HIS, EMR, LIS, PACS) following established protocols and checklists
4. Asset Management and IT Cost Optimization
• Manage the inventory of IT equipment, consumables, and replacement components.
• Execute the allocation, retrieval, stocktaking, and periodic reporting of IT assets.
• Procure supplies and equipment based on approved requests.
• Evaluate and propose plans for equipment repair, upgrade, or replacement based on cost-effectiveness.
• Research and recommend technical solutions to reduce operational, maintenance, and IT system investment costs.
5. Fire Fighting & Prevention (FFP) and Administration
• Conduct periodic inspections of the facility's FFP system, including fire extinguishers, fire cabinets, exit signs, emergency lights, smoke detectors, fire alarms, and related equipment.
• Monitor the operational status of the FFP system; promptly detect and report damages, safety hazards, or non-compliance with current regulations.
• Coordinate with maintenance units, suppliers, and authorities for the inspection, maintenance, and rectification of FFP deficiencies.
• Prepare monthly and quarterly FFP inspection reports, or as requested by the Board of Directors.
• Manage profiles, documents, inspection logs, and receipts related to FFP duties.
• Proactively prepare records and documentation for FFP inspections conducted by competent authorities in accordance with city regulations and current laws.
• Track deadlines for the maintenance, servicing, and inspection/certification of FFP equipment to ensure full operational and legal compliance.
• Coordinate the organization of FFP awareness sessions, guidance, and drills for staff according to the company's plan.
• Propose solutions to improve FFP safety, minimize fire risks, and protect company property.
• Assist in checking potential fire hazards related to electrical systems, IT equipment, UPS, server racks, server rooms, and technical areas.

Yêu cầu công việc
1. Experience & Background
• 1–3 years of proven experience
in IT Support, Helpdesk, or Technical Support roles, preferably in hospital, clinic, or corporate environments.
• Hands-on experience
in maintaining, diagnosing, and repairing office equipment such as computers, laptops, printers, photocopiers, and CCTV systems.
• Prior experience or basic understanding
of medical systems like
HIS, EMR, LIS, or PACS
is a strong advantage.
• Knowledge of Fire Fighting & Prevention (FFP)
procedures, legal regulations, and equipment inspection is highly preferred.
2. Technical Skills & Competencies
• System & Network Administration:
Proficient in installing and configuring Windows/macOS operating systems, office applications, LAN/Wi-Fi networks, routers, and modems.
• Hardware Maintenance:
Skilled in troubleshooting hardware faults, upgrading device components, and performing routine printer/photocopier maintenance (including ink refills).
• Administrative & Asset Management:
Strong organization skills to manage IT inventory, execute stocktaking, handle procurement requests, and maintain detailed FFP inspection logs/profiles.
• Problem-Solving:
A proactive approach to identifying potential system bottlenecks, minimizing user downtime, and proposing cost-effective technical upgrades.
3. Personal Attributes & Language
• Work Style:
High sense of responsibility, professional integrity, and the ability to work independently or handle high-pressure situations efficiently.
• Communication Skills:
Good communication and interpersonal skills to effectively guide clinic staff on IT guidelines and cooperate with external vendors or government inspectors.
• Language:
Basic professional English proficiency to read technical documentation, operate specialized software, and support international staff if required

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Solutions
company: Công Ty Cổ Phần Truyền Thông Square
description:
Mô tả công việc
JOB SUMMARY
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands-on, business-facing builder who sits at the intersection of AI and the agency business. Rather than building software in isolation, the FDE is embedded directly with the teams of Square Group's member companies - event, activation, production and digital communication - to understand how work is really done, identify where AI can create measurable value, and rapidly design, build and deploy AI-powered solutions (agents, automated workflows, integrations and internal tools) into daily operations.
The role holder combines the skills of an engineer, a solution consultant and a project lead: translating business pain points into working prototypes within days, taking proven solutions to production, driving user adoption, and turning successful one-off solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.
Prior experience in an agency / marcom environment is a significant advantage, as the FDE must speak the language of account, creative, production and finance teams as fluently as the language of code and data.
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Embed with Agency Teams & Discover Use Cases
- Work side-by-side with account, creative, production, finance and back-office teams of member companies to map workflows and identify high-impact AI opportunities.
- Define problem statements, success metrics and expected ROI with business owners, and prioritize the use-case backlog.
2. Build & Deploy AI Solutions
- Rapidly prototype with LLMs, AI agents, automation/low-code tools and custom code, then turn validated prototypes into reliable production solutions.
- Integrate AI into the tools teams already use (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, finance/project systems) with human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive outputs.
3. Data & Integration
- Structure and connect agency knowledge and data (rate cards, quotations, case studies, supplier lists, SOPs) via APIs, connectors and scripts, ensuring data confidentiality.
4. Governance & Security
- Work closely with Group IT to ensure every solution complies with the Group information security policy and personal data protection regulations (access control, data classification, approved tools).
- Document each production solution and agree on clear ownership and maintenance arrangements before handover, avoiding unmanaged "shadow IT" tools.
5. Adoption & Enablement
- Onboard and train users, build AI champions in each agency, and communicate results clearly to management and staff.
6. Measurement & Productization
- Track the impact of each deployment against agreed KPIs and turn proven solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.
- Indicative KPIs include: number of use cases taken to production per quarter, working hours saved, user adoption rate, and number of AI champions trained per member company.

Yêu cầu công việc
Must-have
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, Marketing/Communications or equivalent practical experience.
- Minimum of 3-5 years' experience in a hands-on technical role (software/full-stack, data, automation, AI or solution engineering), OR in a business/operations role with a proven track record of building automation and AI solutions.
- Proven portfolio of AI/Automation solutions that were actually deployed and used by real users (please share links, demos or case studies).
- Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (prompting, tool calling), Python or JavaScript, APIs and at least one automation platform (n8n, Make, Apps Script or similar).
- Good data skills (spreadsheets, SQL, data structuring) and working knowledge of Google Workspace / Microsoft 365.
- Consulting mindset and strong stakeholder management: able to turn business processes into clear solutions and present ROI convincingly to C-level in a fast-paced agency environment.
- Ownership, speed and curiosity about AI; high integrity and confidentiality; fluent Vietnamese and good English.
Nice-to-have
- Experience working in an agency - Marcom, event, activation, production or digital communication - (in-house or client-facing); understanding of the agency workflow (brief - pitch - quotation - production - execution - recap - billing, finance and back-office operations) is highly valued.
- Experience with RAG, MCP, vector databases or AI agents running in production.
- Experience training end users and driving adoption of new tools or processes.
WHAT WE OFFER
- The opportunity to shape AI transformation across 8 member companies of Square Group, with direct access to CEOs and senior leadership.
- Autonomy to choose tools and approaches, with a budget for AI tools and subscriptions.
- Competitive salary package commensurate with experience, and benefits in line with Group policy.
- Clear career path to Lead level as the Group AI capability grows.
SELECTION PROCESS
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a practical case: propose and demo a quick solution for a real agency workflow (e.g. turning a client brief into a draft quotation).

Competitive salary package commensurate with experience, and benefits in line with Group policy;
Đào tạo
Clear career path to Lead level as the Group AI capability grows.
Khác
Autonomy to choose tools and approaches, with a budget for AI tools and subscriptions;

title: Operations Analyst Automation & Data
description:
Mô tả công việc
About the role:
We're looking for a data-savvy analyst with an engineering mindset who sees a manual process and immediately thinks "I can automate that." You'll sit between our customer-facing teams (Sales, Customer Success) and our data and tech stack. Your job is to build the tools, pipelines and workflows that make those teams faster, more accurate and more data-driven.
What you'll do:
Automation & Systems (~50%):
● Design, build and maintain automated workflows for revenue operations: sales reporting, commission calculation, target tracking, lead routing, renewal and retention triggers.
● Replace manual spreadsheet processes with reliable scripts (Python / Google Apps Script) and integration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or similar).
● Integrate internal systems (CRM/Salesforce, payment, learning platform, communication tools) via REST APIs and webhooks.
● Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that feed reporting and dashboards.
● Own the reliability of what you build, including documentation, monitoring, error handling and alerts.
● Explore practical uses of AI/LLMs in operations workflows.
Data Analysis & Insights (~30–40%):
● Analyse the performance of customer-facing teams (Sales, CS) on service quality, conversion, retention, renewal and referral, and turn findings into concrete actions.
● Support the teams' day-to-day operations: sales reports, commission calculation, target setting and tracking.
● Analyse lead and sales data (lead source, quality, conversion history, rep capacity and performance) to design and run the lead allocation rules for sales staff, then review and adjust them regularly.
● Build dashboards that track service quality, retention, renewal and referral performance.
● Use SQL and Python to analyse user behaviour and surface insights that drive revenue, engagement and renewals.
Process Optimisation:
● Map existing SOPs, find bottlenecks, and prioritise automation opportunities by impact (time saved, error reduction, revenue).
● Work with Sales, CS, Finance and Product/Engineering to turn business requirements into technical solutions.

Yêu cầu công việc
Must have:
● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering (Software / Industrial / Systems), Mathematics/Statistics or a related field.
● 2+ years in automation, data engineering, BizOps/RevOps engineering, or a software or technical analyst role.
● Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python (or JavaScript) for scripting, data processing and API calls.
● Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks and JSON, plus at least one automation platform (Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, Apps Script…).
● Comfortable with BI tools (Looker Studio, Metabase, Power BI, Tableau…) and advanced spreadsheets.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate messy business problems into clean systems.

Nice to have:
● Salesforce / HubSpot administration or API experience.
● Git, cloud (GCP/AWS), Airflow or dbt.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Nghiên cứu và định hình trải nghiệm
Chủ động tìm hiểu hành vi, nhu cầu và khó khăn của người dùng thông qua phỏng vấn, kiểm thử khả dụng, phản hồi khách hàng và dữ liệu sử dụng sản phẩm.
Xác định vấn đề trải nghiệm, xây dựng giả thuyết và đề xuất hướng giải quyết dựa trên bằng chứng, mục tiêu sản phẩm và các ràng buộc nghiệp vụ.
Thiết kế các hành trình như mở tài khoản, eKYC, đặt lệnh, theo dõi danh mục và sử dụng margin; làm rõ các bước, trạng thái, thông báo và tình huống ngoại lệ.
Thiết kế trải nghiệm cho giao diện có mật độ dữ liệu cao hoặc thông tin cập nhật theo thời gian thực, giúp người dùng nhận biết trạng thái và hiểu hệ quả của các thao tác quan trọng.
Thiết kế giao diện và phát triển Design System
Thực hiện quá trình thiết kế từ user flow, wireframe, prototype đến giao diện hoàn chỉnh cho ứng dụng di động và nền tảng web.
Xây dựng, mở rộng và chuẩn hóa Design System, bao gồm component, design token, nguyên tắc tương tác và hướng dẫn sử dụng.
Phối hợp với đội ngũ Frontend để đảm bảo các thành phần giao diện có thể triển khai, tái sử dụng và được áp dụng nhất quán.
Chuẩn bị tài liệu thiết kế và theo sát quá trình phát triển để đảm bảo sản phẩm được triển khai đúng với mục tiêu trải nghiệm đã thống nhất.
Phối hợp triển khai và cải tiến sản phẩm
Làm việc trực tiếp với Product Owner, Engineering và các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để làm rõ yêu cầu, đánh giá tính khả thi và phản biện giải pháp.
Phối hợp với các đơn vị có thẩm quyền về nghiệp vụ và tuân thủ để thể hiện đầy đủ các thông tin, cảnh báo và bước xác nhận cần thiết trên giao diện.
Tham gia kiểm tra trải nghiệm trước khi phát hành; nhận diện và xử lý các khác biệt quan trọng giữa thiết kế và sản phẩm thực tế.
Theo dõi chỉ số sử dụng, thu thập phản hồi sau triển khai và chủ động đề xuất các vòng cải tiến tiếp theo.
Trình bày cơ sở của quyết định thiết kế với các bên liên quan; nêu sớm những rủi ro có thể ảnh hưởng đến trải nghiệm người dùng hoặc tiến độ triển khai.

Yêu cầu công việc
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS, CAPABILITIES AND SKILLS
Có 3–5 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí UX Designer, Product Designer, UI/UX Designer hoặc vai trò tương đương; đã tham gia thiết kế sản phẩm web và mobile được đưa vào sử dụng.
Thành thạo Figma; có khả năng xây dựng user flow, wireframe, prototype và giao diện hoàn chỉnh cho các luồng tương tác phức tạp.
Có kinh nghiệm tham gia xây dựng, mở rộng hoặc vận hành Design System trong môi trường làm việc cùng đội ngũ sản phẩm và kỹ thuật.
Biết cách sử dụng nghiên cứu người dùng, kiểm thử khả dụng và dữ liệu sản phẩm để xác định vấn đề, đánh giá giải pháp thiết kế.
Có khả năng thiết kế giao diện nhiều dữ liệu, nhiều trạng thái và ràng buộc nghiệp vụ mà vẫn giữ trải nghiệm rõ ràng, nhất quán.
Chủ động dẫn dắt phần việc được giao từ khi xác định vấn đề đến khi đánh giá kết quả, thay vì chỉ bàn giao bản thiết kế.
Có khả năng trình bày và bảo vệ quyết định thiết kế bằng lập luận rõ ràng; phối hợp hiệu quả với các bên liên quan về sản phẩm, kỹ thuật và nghiệp vụ.
Có portfolio thể hiện vai trò cá nhân, quá trình giải quyết vấn đề và kết quả thực tế của sản phẩm, không chỉ tập trung vào hình thức giao diện.
Đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên môn bằng tiếng Anh.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS, CAPABILITIES AND SKILLS
Từng thiết kế sản phẩm chứng khoán, fintech, ngân hàng số hoặc sản phẩm có quy trình phức tạp và yêu cầu tuân thủ cao.
Hiểu các nghiệp vụ cơ bản như loại lệnh giao dịch, danh mục đầu tư, tài khoản margin và KYC/eKYC; hoặc có khả năng nhanh chóng nắm bắt các nghiệp vụ này.
Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế bảng giá, màn hình đặt lệnh, biểu đồ hoặc giao diện hiển thị dữ liệu tài chính theo thời gian thực.
ABOUT US
Công ty Cổ phần Chứng khoán HD (HDS) hoạt động trên thị trường chứng khoán Việt Nam từ năm 2006. HDS cung cấp các dịch vụ chứng khoán và tư vấn tài chính, đồng thời phát triển sản phẩm và nền tảng số phục vụ khách hàng.
Đối với sản phẩm tài chính, trải nghiệm tốt không chỉ là thao tác thuận tiện. Người dùng cần nhìn thấy thông tin chính xác, hiểu trạng thái giao dịch và biết điều gì sẽ xảy ra khi đưa ra quyết định. Đây là những bài toán HDS chú trọng khi phát triển sản phẩm số.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Đội ngũ thiết kế trải nghiệm làm việc cùng Product Owner, Engineering và các đơn vị nghiệp vụ để phát triển sản phẩm trên ứng dụng di động và nền tảng web. Công việc bắt đầu từ việc hiểu vấn đề của người dùng, tiếp tục qua thiết kế và triển khai, rồi được kiểm chứng bằng trải nghiệm thực tế sau phát hành.
Ở vị trí này, bạn có trách nhiệm đóng góp góc nhìn UX vào các quyết định sản phẩm. Bạn sẽ cân bằng nhu cầu người dùng với khả năng kỹ thuật, yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và các quy định áp dụng — đồng thời giữ cho trải nghiệm cuối cùng rõ ràng, nhất quán.
WHAT WE OFFER
Thu nhập thỏa thuận theo năng lực và kinh nghiệm; thưởng theo hiệu quả công việc và chính sách của HDS.
Cơ hội tham gia vào quá trình xây dựng và cải tiến sản phẩm số, đóng góp ý kiến chuyên môn trong các quyết định về trải nghiệm người dùng.
Môi trường làm việc phối hợp giữa các đội ngũ sản phẩm, công nghệ và nghiệp vụ; tiếp cận những bài toán UX đặc thù của lĩnh vực chứng khoán.
Các chế độ bảo hiểm, chăm sóc sức khỏe và phúc lợi theo chính sách Công ty.

title: IT Manager
description:
Mô tả công việc
JOB PURPOSE
Lead and oversee UOA Vietnam’s corporate IT strategy and operations, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient and cost-effective IT environment that supports business objectives and organisational growth. The IT Manager is responsible for IT planning, policies, budgeting, cybersecurity, risk management, vendor oversight and coordination with Group IT, while ensuring IT readiness for new office buildings and company premises.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Business Alignment and IT Planning
Identify business needs and translate them into appropriate technology solutions, considering business value, risk, compliance, security, scalability and available resources.
Develop and manage annual and multi-year IT plans, investment roadmaps and budgets; monitor expenditure, control costs and explain budget variances.
Provide IT and security advice when evaluating, selecting and procuring technology solutions.
Establish and maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and governance frameworks aligned with business needs and Group requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality and business processes through technology.
2. Infrastructure and Systems Management
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability and security of IT infrastructure and services, including network, server, cloud and connectivity services.
Oversee Microsoft 365, business and project applications, LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi networks, servers, endpoints, identity and access management, and local IT services.
Manage IT system maintenance, upgrades, configuration and documentation, ensuring appropriate system and asset records are maintained.
Oversee backup, disaster recovery and IT business continuity arrangements, ensuring recovery plans are documented, tested periodically and updated as required.
Monitor infrastructure capacity and performance, identify potential issues and implement preventive and corrective measures.
3. User Support and IT Service Management
Lead IT service delivery, user support, incident management, problem resolution and escalation to ensure timely and effective service.
Establish and monitor service levels, response times and service quality against agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), where applicable.
Handle major incidents, complex technical issues and escalations while delegating routine support activities to the IT Executive or external service providers.
Identify recurring issues and implement improvements to reduce downtime and enhance the user experience.
Maintain appropriate IT service documentation, procedures and user support guidelines.
4. Cybersecurity, Risk Management and Data Protection
Oversee cybersecurity, identity and access controls, endpoint protection, data protection and information security in accordance with Group policies and applicable Vietnamese laws and regulations.
Develop, implement and maintain local IT security policies, standards and procedures aligned with Group requirements.
Conduct regular IT security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
Establish and maintain security incident response procedures; coordinate and lead responses to cybersecurity incidents and data breaches, including escalation and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
Promote information security awareness through employee training and communication on cybersecurity best practices.
Evaluate and recommend security tools and technologies to strengthen the company’s overall security posture.
Ensure appropriate controls are in place for data backup, recovery, access management and the secure handling of company information.
5. Vendor, IT Asset and License Management
Manage IT vendors and service providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, service delivery, costs, performance and compliance with agreed service levels.
Manage the IT asset register and oversee hardware lifecycle management, software licenses and subscriptions.
Ensure appropriate software licensing, asset tracking, renewal planning and cost-effective use of IT resources.
Monitor vendor performance and resolve service or contractual issues in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
6. Group IT and Headquarters Coordination
Work closely with Group IT and relevant headquarters teams to align local IT operations with Group strategy, standards, policies and security requirements.
Coordinate the implementation, maintenance and support of Group IT systems, applications and infrastructure.
Provide timely IT updates, reports, risk assessments and other information required by Group IT or headquarters.
Coordinate local IT requirements, changes and escalations with Group IT to ensure effective service delivery and compliance.
7. IT Readiness for New Building Projects
Define corporate IT requirements for new office buildings and company premises, including network infrastructure, internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, workstations, meeting rooms, server rooms and communication spaces, as applicable.
Coordinate with Project, Building Management, consultants, contractors and building engineering teams to ensure IT requirements are incorporated into design, construction, testing, commissioning and handover activities.
Review and coordinate the connectivity and integration requirements between corporate IT networks and building systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS), CCTV, access control and fire alarm systems, where applicable.
Ensure appropriate network segregation, cybersecurity controls, technical documentation and handover records are in place for relevant interfaces with corporate IT.
Coordinate IT testing, readiness checks and issue resolution before office occupancy or project handover.
Building engineering systems, including BMS, CCTV, access control and fire alarm systems, remain under the operational and maintenance responsibility of Building Management and its appointed contractors. The IT Manager’s responsibility is limited to corporate IT infrastructure, network connectivity, cybersecurity and agreed integration interfaces.
8. Team Leadership and Management
Lead, coach and develop the IT Executive to ensure effective IT service delivery and continuous professional development.
Set priorities, allocate workloads and monitor task completion, service quality and individual performance.
Establish clear responsibilities, provide constructive feedback and support capability development.
Promote accountability, collaboration, service orientation and adherence to company policies and procedures.

Yêu cầu công việc
1. Education
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.
2. Experience
At least 7 years of relevant IT experience, including 2–3 years in a team lead or IT management role, preferably in a small to mid-sized organisation.
Experience in infrastructure and systems management, cybersecurity, IT service delivery, budgeting and vendor management.
Experience in real estate, construction, property management or a multinational/foreign-invested company is an advantage.
3. Technical Knowledge
Solid knowledge of IT networking, infrastructure, servers, cloud services, email and collaboration platforms.
Experience with endpoint management, identity and access management, cybersecurity fundamentals, backup and disaster recovery.
Understanding of IT governance, risk management, IT budgeting, vendor contracts and software licensing.
Familiarity with interfaces between corporate IT networks and building systems is preferred. Hands-on operation or maintenance of building engineering systems is not required.
4. Language
Good written and spoken English for reporting, documentation and regular communication with Group IT, headquarters and external vendors.
5. Core Competencies
Strategic and operational planning, with sound budget and cost-control discipline.
Strong cybersecurity awareness, risk assessment and problem-solving skills.
Vendor management, contract negotiation and stakeholder coordination.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
People leadership, coaching and workload management.

Chăm sóc sức khoẻ
Healthcare insurance
Nghỉ phép có lương
14 annual leave/ year
Đào tạo
Internal and External training

title: AI Enablement/ Business Applications Engineer
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN DỊCH VỤ KỸ THUẬT LND
description:
Mô tả công việc
Job Summary
The AI Solutions Engineer is responsible for designing and delivering practical AI-enabled tools that directly support business operations. The role focuses on turning business requirements into usable AI solutions that automate workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making across engineering, estimating, and reporting functions. Success in this role is measured by working tools delivered, adoption by users, and measurable productivity improvement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Requirement Analysis & AI Use Case Definition:
Activities involving understanding business needs and translating them into AI‑enabled solutions:
• Work closely with stakeholders (Engineering, Estimating, Operations, Management) to identify high-impact use cases suitable for AI adoption.
• Analyze current workflows and pain points to define clear functional and technical requirements.
• Propose AI solutions aligned with business value, feasibility, and data availability.
• Prioritize initiatives based on ROI, scalability, and operational impact.
2. AI Solution Design & Development:
• Design, develop, and deploy custom AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Azure AI services to support real business workflows.
• Build and maintain AI‑powered tools integrated with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and the Power Platform, to improve productivity and information flow
• Implement and optimize prompt engineering, conversation design, and orchestration logic to ensure accurate, reliable, and business‑ready AI outputs.
• Design scalable conversation flows and agent behaviors aligned with business rules, data context, and user experience.
• Validate AI agent performance with end users and continuously refine prompts, logic, and integrations based on feedback and observed outcomes.
3. User Enablement & Collaboration:
• Act as a trusted advisor to business teams on how AI can support their daily work.
• Train users on adopted AI tools, including proper usage and interpretation of outputs.
• Gather user feedback and continuously refine tools to better meet operational needs.
• Collaborate with engineering, IT, and management teams to ensure alignment with company strategy.
4. Quality, Governance & Tooling:
• Ensure AI solutions follow company standards for quality, security, and documentation.
• Maintain clear documentation for AI tools, workflows, prompts, and data dependencies.
• Support governance practices to ensure responsible and ethical use of AI within the organization.
5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation:
Activities improving processes, tools, and ways of working:
• Proactively research emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications relevant to the business.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by proposing enhancements to existing AI tools and workflows.
• Share lessons learned, best practices, and success stories across the organization.
• Support management in shaping the long‑term AI roadmap for the company.

Yêu cầu công việc
Qualifications and Skills
Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
• Fluent English (minimum TOEIC score 700 or equivalent).
• 3+ years of experience applying AI, automation, or data‑driven solutions to real‑world business problems.
• Strong understanding of applied AI concepts, including:
✓ Large Language Models (LLMs)
✓ Prompt engineering
✓ Information extraction and document processing
✓ Automation and workflow integration
• Ability to translate business needs into practical, usable technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
• Clear communication skills to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
Preferred:
• Familiarity with tools such as:
✓ Python / scripting for automation
✓ AI APIs or platforms (e.g., LLM frameworks, OCR, vision models)
✓ Low‑code / no‑code automation platforms
• Experience working with global teams and diverse business stakeholders.
• Strong curiosity, hands‑on mindset, and willingness to experiment and iterate.
• Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), and Azure AI services.
• Experience designing enterprise‑grade conversational AI or AI agents with strong focus on quality, governance, and user adoption is an advantage.

Thưởng
Performance-based bonuses, with performance reviews conducted twice a year
Chăm sóc sức khoẻ
Annual Health Check
Nghỉ phép có lương
Annual leave and public holidays in accordance with applicable regulations

title: [SPA] - IT - Chuyên gia Vận hành hạ tầng CNTT
company: Công ty TNHH Hàng không Mặt trời Phú Quốc

Mô tả công việc

- Tiếp nhận, phân loại, phân tích và phối hợp xử lý incident/request liên quan đến hạ tầng theo quy trình; thực hiện escalation khi vượt ngưỡng nhằm bảo đảm thời gian phản hồi và khôi phục dịch vụ.

- Tham gia đánh giá readiness hạ tầng trước go-live, bao gồm môi trường production, connectivity, security baseline, backup, monitoring, DR, access, certificate và support model.

- Cập nhật và duy trì SOP vận hành hạ tầng, checklist kiểm tra, escalation matrix, maintenance calendar, DR checklist, backup checklist và tài liệu hỗ trợ L1/L2.
- Tham gia phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ đối với các sự cố hạ tầng nghiêm trọng, sự cố lặp lại hoặc sự cố ảnh hưởng đến hệ thống trọng yếu; theo dõi và đôn đốc các hành động khắc phục sau RCA.
- Phối hợp với ITSM Specialist tổng hợp báo cáo vận hành hạ tầng, bao gồm availability, incident, request, SLA, capacity, backup, DR, issue tồn đọng và các khuyến nghị cải tiến.
- Đề xuất cải tiến công cụ giám sát, rule cảnh báo, tự động hóa vận hành, tối ưu tài nguyên, nâng cao độ sẵn sàng và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn dịch vụ hạ tầng.
- Lưu trữ, cập nhật và quản lý hồ sơ vận hành hạ tầng, log xử lý sự cố, báo cáo kiểm tra, biên bản maintenance, DR test evidence, backup evidence và tài liệu bàn giao theo quy định.

- Kinh nghiệm làm việc: Có tối thiểu 4–6 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực Infrastructure Operations, Network/System Operations, Cloud Operations, Endpoint Operations, NOC, IT Operations hoặc vận hành hạ tầng doanh nghiệp.
- Kiến thức: Có kiến thức về network, server, cloud, endpoint, storage, backup/restore, monitoring, observability, DR/BCP, certificate, DNS, firewall, VPN, load balancer, patching, security baseline, SLA/OLA và vận hành production.
- Năng lực/Kỹ năng:Có khả năng phân tích sự cố hạ tầng, theo dõi availability/capacity/performance, đọc log/cảnh báo, xác định nguyên nhân và phối hợp xử lý sự cố trong môi trường production.
- Trình độ ngoại ngữ: Tiếng Anh đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật, error message và trao đổi công việc cơ bản với nhà cung cấp.
- Trình độ tin học: Thành thạo công cụ văn phòng, ITSM/ticketing, monitoring/dashboard và công cụ kỹ thuật liên quan.
- Các yêu cầu khác: Cẩn thận, trách nhiệm, chủ động theo dõi đến khi công việc được đóng và tuân thủ quy trình production.

title: IT Executive
description:
Mô tả công việc
MỤC ĐÍCH:
- Hỗ trợ người dùng về công nghệ thông tin: máy tính, email, in ấn, các phần mềm và phần cứng.
- Giám sát, vận hành và bảo dưỡng các thiết bị văn phòng như máy in, máy chiếu, camera, tổng đài IP, máy chấm công, v.v.
